article.articleHeadline: Canada taking new border measures in response to Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Ebola border measures implemented by Canada. Effective July 20, 2026, the Public Health Agency of Canada bans entry to foreign nationals who have been in the Democratic Republic of the Congo within the past 21 days. Canadian citizens, permanent residents, and people registered under the Indian Act who have been in DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan in the previous 21 days may still enter, but must undergo a health assessment on arrival and complete a 21-day quarantine. The policy aims to reduce importation and transmission risk and to safeguard travelers including returning humanitarian workers. The measures, alongside existing orders, run through August 29, 2026. PHAC reported no travel-related Ebola cases in Canada to date. This aligns with ongoing mitigation while focusing on high-risk exposure windows and border processing.

triage.headline_ja: カナダ、エボラ出血熱の発生に対応して新たな国境措置を実施
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC・ウガンダ・南スーダンに拡大し、カナダが入国制限措置を実施するなど国際的な対応が進行しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はカナダの国境措置に関する内容だが、感染症イベントの実際の発生地はDRC（およびウガンダ、南スーダン）。ウガンダ・南スーダンは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。カナダも対象国外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 加拿大实施新入境限制措施 严防埃博拉疫情输入
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Canada imposes new entry restrictions to prevent the importation of the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak-related entry restrictions: Canada, citing low current risk to Canadians and no travel-related cases to date, has imposed new temporary measures. As of 11:59 p.m. Eastern Time on July 20, 2026, foreign nationals who have visited the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) within the previous 21 days are barred from entering Canada. Airlines must also refuse boarding to these travelers under aviation law. The precautionary move follows PHAC's ongoing efforts; Canada previously announced a 90-day entry ban starting May 27, 2026, targeting residents of the DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan, and paused visa applications from those countries. No broader Canadian outbreak escalation is reported, but authorities emphasize vigilance amid the Ebola situation in Africa, with ongoing monitoring and containment at the border.

triage.headline_ja: カナダ、エボラ出血熱流行の入国阻止のため新たな入国制限措置を実施
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ出血熱流行に対し、カナダが入国制限措置を講じたことは国際的拡大リスクと渡航制限の両方に該当し、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事はカナダの入国制限措置を主題としているが、根本的な感染症イベントはDRCで発生しているエボラ出血熱流行。ウガンダ・南スーダンは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。カナダも対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda: Điểm sáng chống dịch Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda: A bright spot in the fight against the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Uganda reports its last Ebola patient tested negative, is healthy, and discharged, with a case fatality rate under 10%. WHO representative Kasonde Mwinga praises the response; under WHO rules, Uganda can declare end 42 days after the last confirmed non-infectious case, leaving about six weeks for formal notification as of July 20, 2026. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, the outbreak is accelerating, with 2,011 confirmed cases and 754 deaths. WHO Director-General Tedros warns the spread is faster than any prior outbreak; undetected infections may be 2–4 times higher. About 80% of new cases in eastern DRC have unknown transmission. Violence and displacement hinder response; ADF attacks in North Kivu's Beni have killed at least 20 and disrupted access. WHO notes only 40% of the $115 million needed; a $69 million shortfall threatens surveillance, contact tracing, and risk communication; Africa CDC calls it the fastest outbreak yet.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ：エボラ流行対策における明るい兆し
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）でエボラ流行が過去最速のペースで拡大しており、確定2,011例・死亡754例、感染経路不明が80%に及ぶなど深刻かつ異常な状況で、国際的な資金・支援不足も明記されているため。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダでの終息傾向を主題としつつ、DRCでの深刻な流行拡大を報告。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。DRCの状況（資金不足、暴力による対応阻害、史上最速の拡大）がPICKUP判定の主要因。

article.articleHeadline: Canada taking new border measures in response to Ebola outbreak | New Straits Times
article.articleSummary: Ebola prompts Canada to impose temporary border controls. The Public Health Agency of Canada (PHAC) announced measures to curb Ebola entry and spread, effective Monday. Any foreign national who has been in the Democratic Republic of the Congo within the past 21 days is prohibited from entering Canada. Canadian citizens, permanent residents, and those registered under the Indian Act who have been in the DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan in the prior 21 days may still enter but must undergo a health assessment on arrival and complete a 21-day quarantine. Returning humanitarian workers are included in the scope of processing for travellers. The rules, part of the existing Order in Council, remain in effect until August 29. PHAC noted there have been no travel-related Ebola cases in Canada to date.

triage.headline_ja: カナダ、エボラ出血熱流行を受けて新たな国境管理措置を実施
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱流行を受け、カナダが入国制限・検疫措置を導入しており、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCで発生しているエボラ出血熱流行とそれに対するカナダの渡航制限措置。ウガンダ・南スーダンも発生地域として言及されているが対象国リストに含まれず、カナダも対象国外のため除外。DRC国内の症例数・死亡者数などの詳細情報は本記事からは不明。

article.articleHeadline: We are determined not to leave communities alone." How CARE DRC continues to fight Ebola amid funding cuts
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), centered in North Kivu and Ituri provinces, has surpassed 2,000 cases, with the World Health Organization warning the spread is faster than any previous outbreak. As of 2026-07-20, more than 210,000 people have been reached with prevention messages, though this is only a fraction of the millions at risk. CARE DRC reports funding cuts weakening health systems and the humanitarian response, while deploying over 500 community health workers for door-to-door outreach to educate communities and combat misinformation. Delivery of medical supplies faces rainfall-related delays through muddy, flooded routes; a recent Ituri shipment included new hospital beds to strengthen a CARE-supported facility. CARE calls for immediate, expanded funding and technical support to sustain community engagement, psychosocial support, data collection digitization, and services for women and girls who bear the brunt of gaps.

triage.headline_ja: 「私たちはコミュニティを見捨てない」―資金削減の中でCARE DRCがエボラ対策を継続する方法
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が2,000症例を超え、WHOが過去最速の拡大ペースと警告しており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクがあるため、フルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: WHOが過去最速の拡大速度と警告している点、資金不足による対応能力低下が懸念材料。北キブ・イトゥリ州が中心。

article.articleHeadline: OVO JE ALARMANTNO! Broj potvđenih slućaja od EBOLE prešao 2.000!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: THIS IS ALARMING! The number of confirmed Ebola cases has surpassed 2,000!
article.articleSummary: As of July 20, 2026, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has reached 2,267 confirmed cases and 893 deaths. Government data, cited by Reuters, show 86 new cases and 29 additional fatalities for the Thursday–Friday period. The outbreak poses a significant challenge for Congolese health authorities, who report a shortage of adequate treatment centers hindering patient care and outbreak control. Complicating response is resistance from parts of local communities to strict hygiene and epidemiological measures, fueled by distrust and non-acceptance of some health recommendations. Health services continue to monitor the situation and implement measures to curb further transmission. Ebola is a severe viral disease with potential for rapid spread, particularly in regions with limited access to healthcare.

triage.headline_ja: これは警戒すべき事態だ！エボラ確定患者数が2,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ確定2,267例・死亡893例と大規模化し、致死率も高く、治療体制不足やコミュニティの抵抗が拡大リスクを増大させているため、フルRRAへ進めるべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 致死率約39%と非常に高く、治療センター不足やコミュニティの不信感が制御の障害となっている点は重大な懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: 防灾减灾救灾一线见闻 | 基层疾控人员灾区防疫的一天
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Frontline Observations on Disaster Prevention, Mitigation, and Relief | A Day in the Life of Local CDC Personnel in Disaster Areas
article.articleSummary: Flood-response operations in Guangxi’s Hengzhou (a district under Nanning City) mobilized over 500 personnel from the Nanning CDC to three flood-affected areas: Hengzhou, Yunbiao Town, and Bin Yang Gantang, to conduct post-disaster sanitation and disease prevention. On July 18, teams moved by foot along mud-laden roads to Dengxu Village and Wangbaotun, delivering disinfection spray and health education to about 140 households. They emphasized simple, correct mixing of chlorine disinfectants (one cap concentrate to one cap water) and wearing gloves and masks due to irritant disinfectants. Health education extended to village cadres to multiply reach. Officials warned that 7–15 days after flooding is a high-risk window for intestinal, respiratory, and vector-borne diseases; in addition to spraying, authorities will conduct mosquito/larval control and follow-up sanitation until all affected households are covered, then return to Nanning.

triage.headline_ja: 防災減災救災の現場から | 被災地における基層疾病予防管理職員の一日
triage.triage_reason: 洪水後の通常の公衆衛生対応（消毒・衛生教育）を報じる内容であり、特定の疾患発生や異常な公衆衛生事象は確認されていない。
triage.notes: 記事は洪水被災地における予防的公衆衛生活動（消毒・害虫駆除・衛生教育）の紹介であり、具体的な疾病発生事例の報告ではない。疾患名は「Unknown Illness」と分類されているが、実際には特定の感染症イベントを示す内容ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Từ vụ 4 trẻ mắc Adenovirus ở hồ bơi, bác sĩ nhi khoa chỉ ra 5 nơi dễ lây chéo bệnh truyền nhiễm nhất cho trẻ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: From the case of four children infected with Adenovirus at a swimming pool, a pediatrician identifies the five places where cross-infection of infectious diseases is most likely to occur among children.
article.articleSummary: Four children contracted Adenovirus after swimming together at a public pool in Hanoi, triggering concerns about transmission in public venues. At the Central Pediatrics Hospital, hundreds of children presented with conjunctivitis, sore throat, and respiratory infections linked to Adenovirus; four cases were cross-infected at the same pool. Pediatrician Tran Duc Hau, head of Pediatrics at Tam Anh General Hospital Hanoi, identifies five high-risk touchpoints for cross-infection among children: indoor ball pits; stuffed toys and costumes; cinema, activity gyms, and dressing rooms; public swimming pools; and public restrooms. Contaminated surfaces and inadequate hygiene can spread respiratory, ocular, and gastrointestinal pathogens including Adenovirus, Coxsackie (hand-foot-mouth), RSV, Rotavirus, Norovirus, and HPV-related warts; risk increases with crowding and insufficient cleaning. Emphasizes disinfection, keeping sick children away, and vaccination to reduce outbreaks in schools and communities.

triage.headline_ja: プールでの4人の子どものアデノウイルス感染事例から、小児科医が子どもの間で交差感染しやすい5つの場所を指摘
triage.triage_reason: 公共施設での小児感染症予防に関する一般的な健康啓発記事であり、深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威や異常な流行を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 記事はハノイの公共プールでのアデノウイルス感染事例を起点とした、子どもの交差感染予防に関する一般的な医療アドバイス記事。特定のアウトブレイクの規模や深刻度についての詳細情報はなく、季節性の一般的な小児感染症に関する啓発内容。

article.articleHeadline: 175 Prajurit TNI Diberangkatkan ke Kongo, Ada Ancaman Ebola di Zona Operasi yang Harus Diwaspadai - Zona Jakarta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 175 Indonesian National Armed Forces soldiers dispatched to the Congo; there is an Ebola threat in the zone of operations that must be monitored - Jakarta Zone.
article.articleSummary: 175 Indonesian National Armed Forces soldiers from three branches were deployed on 17 July 2026 to the Democratic Republic of the Congo for the United Nations MONUSCO peacekeeping mission. The departure ceremony occurred at Lapangan Prima, TNI Headquarters, Jakarta, with Panglima TNI General Agus Subiyanto represented by Asisten Operasi Letjen Bobby Rinal Makmun. The contingent, Satgas Kizi TNI Konga XX-W, is a Kompi Zeni (engineer company) focusing on construction, maintenance, repair, and technical support rather than direct combat. In the field, they will undertake infrastructure projects to enable MONUSCO operations. The mission contends with armed conflict and Ebola risk in parts of the Congo, prompting explicit orders to enforce strict health protocols and uphold safety, quality, and accountability. Output from their work is expected to influence overall mission effectiveness in a demanding operational zone with limited infrastructure.

triage.headline_ja: TNI兵士175人がコンゴへ出発、警戒すべき任務地域でのエボラの脅威
triage.triage_reason: 記事はインドネシア国軍のコンゴPKO派遣に関するもので、エボラは派遣先での一般的なリスクとして言及されているのみ。具体的な発生状況（症例数、地域、時期等）の情報が一切なく、新規の感染症イベントとしての実体がない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はインドネシア軍のコンゴ派遣であり、エボラは既知の一般的リスクとして注意喚起されているのみ。具体的なエボラ発生の詳細（発生地域、症例数、時期）が記載されておらず、DRCにおける新規または既存のエボラアウトブレイクの実態を確認できない。地理的な出発地（ジャカルタ）は疾患発生地ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Caso de gripe aviária no Noroeste gaúcho não afeta status sanitário do RS, garante o governo do Estado - Jornal O Sul
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Case of avian influenza in northwestern Rio Grande do Sul does not affect the state's sanitary status, the state government assures - Jornal O Sul.
article.articleSummary: First backyard poultry case of avian influenza reported in Coqueiros do Sul, Northwestern Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil. State authorities reaffirm that Rio Grande do Sul and Brazil remain free of Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza (HPAI); the outbreak does not affect sanitary status or poultry trade, and consumption of meat or eggs remains non-transmissible. Samples were collected July 14 by Seapi’s Department of Vigilance and Sanitary Defense and sent to the Federal Laboratory of Agricultural Defense in Campinas, São Paulo, a reference lab for the World Organisation for Animal Health, which confirmed the diagnosis. The Rio Grande do Sul Official Veterinary Service (SVO-RS) will survey properties within a 10-km radius of the focus and conduct sanitary education. More details will be posted at agricultura.rs.gov.br. Suspected avian influenza cases should be reported to the Agriculture Secretariat via the nearest Inspectorate or WhatsApp at (51) 98445-2033.

triage.headline_ja: ヒオ・グランデ・ド・スル州北西部での鳥インフルエンザ発生は州の衛生ステータスに影響しない、と州政府が保証
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル南部の裏庭養鶏での鳥インフルエンザ感染が確認されたが、人への感染報告はなく、州政府は貿易・衛生ステータスへの影響がないと明言している。動物間感染事例として継続的な監視が必要だが、現時点でパブリックヘルスへの深刻な影響は認められない。
triage.notes: 人への感染は報告されておらず、裏庭養鶏（非商業）での単発事例。州獣医局が10km圏内の調査を実施予定であり、続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: US, Congo Ebola Travel Restrictions May Hamper Humanitarian Aid Response
article.articleSummary: US and Congolese travel restrictions aimed at preventing cross-border Ebola transmission draw warnings from aid organizations and medical experts, who say the measures could undermine the humanitarian response to what is described as the world's fastest-growing Ebola outbreak. The restrictions target cross-border movement connected to Congo's Ebola response, raising concerns that crucial aid deliveries, field investigations, and surveillance activities could be impeded in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and neighboring regions. Critics warn that restricted movement across borders may slow outbreak containment, hinder timely reporting of suspected cases, and complicate coordination with international partners. The tensions between border-control measures and urgent public health needs are highlighted in the article as of 2026-07-20.

triage.headline_ja: 米国とコンゴのエボラ関連渡航制限、人道支援活動を妨げる可能性
triage.triage_reason: 「世界最速で拡大するエボラ流行」と表現され、渡航・貿易制限が既に実施されており、国際的対応にも影響が出ているためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 米国は感染発生国ではなく渡航制限措置の当事国であるため対象国リストに含めず除外。DRCでのエボラ流行拡大と国際対応への影響が主題。

article.articleHeadline: 加拿大实施新入境限制措施 严防埃博拉疫情输入
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Canada Imposes New Entry Restrictions to Prevent Ebola Importation.
article.articleSummary: Canada's Public Health Agency announced temporary entry restrictions to reduce the risk of importing Ebola into Canada and preventing domestic transmission. Beginning July 20, 2026 at 11:59 p.m. local time, any foreign national who has visited the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) in the past 21 days will be refused entry to Canada, and airlines must not allow such travelers to board Canada-bound flights under aviation law. Officials say the current Ebola risk to Canadians remains low and no travel-associated Ebola cases have been reported domestically; the measures are precautionary. This follows May 26, 2026 actions banning residents of the DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan from entering Canada for 90 days beginning May 27 and suspending visa approvals for those nationals. The new rule specifically targets recent DRC travel among foreign nationals.

triage.headline_ja: カナダ、エボラ出血熱の流入防止のため新たな入国制限措置を実施
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）で発生中のエボラ出血熱に対し、カナダが渡航制限措置を新たに導入したことは、IHR基準（国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限）に複数該当し、フルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はカナダの入国制限措置だが、その背景にあるDRCでのエボラ出血熱発生が実質的な感染症イベントである。ウガンダ・南スーダンも過去に制限対象となっているが、本記事の直接的対象はDRCのみであり、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。カナダも対象国リスト外。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Kaltim perkuat Integrasi layanan medis, tekan kasus kematian DBD
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: East Kalimantan Health Office strengthens integration of medical services, curbs dengue deaths.
article.articleSummary: East Kalimantan's Health Office strengthens integration of medical services to curb dengue fatalities. The Dinas Kesehatan coordinates cross-facility care from community health centers (puskesmas) to district hospitals, emphasizing early detection, rapid and precise patient management, and shared case evaluations as learning tools. The move follows recent dengue deaths in Samarinda City and Paser Regency. By ensuring integrated, responsive service across facilities, no patient should experience delays in treatment. Current data show 1,530 dengue infections in East Kalimantan, with two deaths recorded in Mahakam Ulu and Kota Bontang, illustrating a relatively low case fatality rate amid ongoing transmission. The approach aims to safeguard residents by strengthening collaboration between primary care and referral hospitals.

triage.headline_ja: 東カリマンタン州保健局、医療サービスの連携を強化しデング熱死亡例を抑制
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア東カリマンタン州でデング熱の継続的な感染・死亡例が報告されているが、地方保健当局による通常の対応策の範囲であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは認められない。デング熱は地域流行病であり異常性は低いが、継続的な感染拡大の可能性から経過観察対象とする。
triage.notes: デング熱は東南アジアで季節的に流行する疾患であり、本記事は地方保健当局による医療連携強化の取り組みを報じるもので、致死率は低いとされている。国家レベルでの緊急対応や国際支援要請の言及はない。

article.articleHeadline: Virus SAT-1 nguy hiểm với ngành chăn nuôi gia súc như thế nào?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: How dangerous is the SAT-1 virus to the livestock farming industry?
article.articleSummary: SAT-1 foot-and-mouth disease virus poses heightened risk to Vietnam’s livestock industry due to its epidemiology: higher carrier persistence, with nearly 90% of infected animals becoming carriers compared with ~50% for SAT-2/3; longer viral shedding; shorter incubation but silent circulation in small herds. A study indicates SAT-1 can sustain transmission in herds of about 400 animals, far less than SAT-2/3 which require 2,000–10,000. If introduced to Vietnam, SAT-1 could persist in modest-sized herds, increasing prolonged outbreaks and control challenges, especially since most Vietnamese cattle are not immune to SAT-1. SAT-1 circulates mainly in Africa and can affect all susceptible species, including pigs; seven serotypes exist with no cross-immunity, so vaccines must match SAT-1. Clinical signs resemble existing FMD serotypes, complicating detection. Authorities should curb animal movement, enhance surveillance, rapid serotype testing, and targeted quarantines.

triage.headline_ja: SAT-1ウイルスは畜産業にどれほど危険か？
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムでの実際の発生ではなく、SAT-1型口蹄疫ウイルスの特性とリスクに関する解説・注意喚起記事であり、現時点で具体的な発生事例は報告されていない。
triage.notes: 記事はSAT-1型FMDウイルスの疫学的特徴（キャリア化率の高さ、小規模畜群での持続感染可能性）を解説する予防的・教育的内容であり、ベトナムでの実際の発生を報じたものではない。アフリカが主な流行地域とされるが、対象国リストの範囲外（大陸単位）。ベトナムへの侵入リスクへの注意喚起にとどまり、実際の発生事例は確認されていないため verified_locations は空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Việt Nam làm gì để chủ động ngăn ngừa chủng virus FMD chủng SAT-1?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What is Vietnam doing to proactively prevent the SAT-1 serotype of the FMD virus?
article.articleSummary: Vietnam is proactively preparing against Foot-and-Moot Disease (FMD) SAT-1 after its appearance in China and Mongolia, noting that SAT-1 has not previously circulated in Vietnam and the country’s tens of millions of cattle are highly vulnerable if introduced. Current risk is assessed as medium, but authorities follow WOAH/FAO guidance for early action. Two priority pillars: tighten quarantine for imported animals and animal products from SAT-1–affected or at-risk countries; and strengthen cross-border cattle movement controls with China, Laos, Cambodia and regional transit routes. Vaccine preparedness is critical, with vaccine selection based on antigenic similarity to circulating SAT-1 strains and coordination with international labs for emergency use. Surveillance is enhanced through active and passive monitoring at border provinces, border points, markets, and slaughterhouses. The government issued a SAT-1 response plan on April 23, 2026, and PM Directive No. 35 on April 25, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムはFMDウイルスSAT-1株の侵入を未然に防ぐために何をしているか？
triage.triage_reason: 中国・モンゴルで新たなFMD SAT-1株が確認され、ベトナムが予防的対応を進めているという内容だが、実際の発生詳細（症例数・被害規模など）が不明であり、ベトナム国内での発生は確認されていないため続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 本記事は動物疾病（家畜FMD）の予防対応が主題であり、ヒトへの直接的な公衆衛生影響は認められない。中国・モンゴルでの新株出現に関する具体的な発生規模情報が不明なため、続報確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ngăn chặn virus lở mồm long móng chủng SAT-1: Kinh nghiệm từ quốc tế
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Preventing the SAT-1 strain of foot-and-mouth disease: International experiences.
article.articleSummary: SAT-1 serotype of foot-and-mouth disease, historically confined to Southern Africa, is expanding into the Middle East, Europe, and East Asia. Facundo Romero of Biogénesis Bagó notes a worrying spread, with the first non-African detection in a Qatar quarantine station in 2023. By early 2025 SAT-1 appeared in Kuwait, Bahrain, Iraq, Turkey, and Egypt; early 2026 it reached Lebanon, Iran, Israel, and Azerbaijan, with the outbreak lineage Topotype III linked to Turkish strains and up to 99.5% similarity with the BOT/1/77 vaccine strain. In March 2026, SAT-1 was detected in China, marking East Asia’s first appearance; Vietnam is considered high risk due to little herd immunity. FAO and WOAH are aiding Southeast Asia in surveillance, risk assessment, and emergency planning. Vaccination is important but challenging, requiring high-protection vaccines and strict biosafety; containment relies on surveillance, rapid response, and coordinated public-private action.

triage.headline_ja: SAT-1株の口蹄疫ウイルス拡大を防ぐ：国際的な経験
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫SAT-1株が南部アフリカ起源から中東・欧州を経て2026年3月に中国（東アジア初）で検出され、越境的な拡大と貿易制限リスクが高く、FAO/WOAHの国際支援も動いているためフルリスク評価に進めるべき。
triage.notes: 本イベントは家畜の口蹄疫（動物疾病）であり、直接的なヒトへの公衆衛生影響はないが、越境拡大と貿易・畜産業への影響が大きく、FAO/WOAHが東南アジアの監視・リスク評価を支援している。ベトナムは『高リスク』とされるが実際の発生確認は記事上なく、確定発生国は中国（東アジア初検出）のみと判断した。

article.articleHeadline: AP gears up to combat Omicron RF.5
article.articleSummary: As of 20 July 2026, Andhra Pradesh authorities have issued an all-district alert after a sporadic rise in Covid-19 cases. Four fatalities, all with severe pre-existing comorbidities. Omicron RF.5, a natural evolutionary sub-lineage of SARS-CoV-2 Omicron (descending from JN.1, LF.7, PY.1.1.1), was detected in Kadapa district and confirmed by the National Institute of Virology in Pune. Health Minister Y Satya Kumar Yadav announced the finding and led a telephonic review. Dr. Vishnuvardhan stated RF.5 is not recombinant. The variant has surged in Singapore and Southeast Asia; WHO maintains routine genomic surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: アンドラ・プラデーシュ州、オミクロンRF.5への対応を強化
triage.triage_reason: 新たなオミクロン亜系統RF.5がインドで検出され散発的な症例増加が報告されているが、WHOは定常的なゲノムサーベイランスの対象としており、重症度・国際的拡大の深刻さは現時点で不明確。続報を注視すべき。
triage.notes: RF.5は非組換え型の自然進化系統とされ、死亡例4件は重篤な基礎疾患を有する患者。シンガポール・東南アジアでの増加が報告されているが、対象国リストにシンガポールは含まれないため除外。WHOは通常のゲノムサーベイランス対応としている。

article.articleHeadline: US, Congo Ebola Travel Restrictions May Hamper Humanitarian Aid Response
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo remains the fastest-growing epidemic, with 2,344 confirmed cases and 930 deaths reported by the National Institute of Public Health as of Sunday. At least 119 health workers have been infected, 36 dying. The 21-day incubation period means transmission begins with symptoms; a June incident involved a physician from Alima who returned to France with Ebola, illustrating cross-border exposure. US and Congo travel rules aim to curb importation risk: the US requires 21 days outside Congo for citizens returning on commercial flights; Congo requires travelers leaving Ebola-affected areas to stay inside the country for three weeks before international travel. Overlap could force volunteers to wait up to six weeks, hindering deployment/rotation of clinicians. WHO favors risk-based exemptions; Canada imposed similar measures; MSF requires 21 days self-monitoring after Ebola deployments.

triage.headline_ja: 米国とコンゴのエボラ渡航制限が人道支援対応を妨げる可能性
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で急速に拡大するエボラ出血熱の流行（2,344例、930死亡）であり、医療従事者への感染や国境を越えた感染例（フランス）も確認され、複数国が渡航制限を導入しているためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 米国・フランス・カナダは渡航制限や輸入例の文脈で言及されており、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: Tiêu thụ hơn 250 tấn lợn nhiễm bệnh, 6 đối tượng bị khởi tố
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 250 tons of infected pigs consumed; six suspects charged.
article.articleSummary: Six suspects are charged with food-safety violations in a Quang Tri province case tied to African swine fever (ASF). Investigators, under case file 0526H, uncovered a large network that bought, transported, slaughtered, and sold ASF-infected pigs, totaling over 250 tons from February to May 2026. On 15 July 2026, the police indicted: Mai Van Quang (1973) and Ha Van Nghia (1978) of Nga Son commune, Thanh Hoa; Tran Thi Ngoc Hien (Hoa Chau) (1964) of Dong Ha ward, Quang Tri; Hoang Thi Mong Truyen (Nuong) (1972); Truong Van Quoc (1973); Tran Ngoc Bac (1971) of Nam Dong Ha ward, Quang Tri. They face charges under Article 317 of the Penal Code for violating food-safety regulations; the investigation remains open for further action. Related reports note ASF-control efforts in Ha Tinh.

triage.headline_ja: 感染した豚250トン以上を消費、6名を起訴
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はアフリカ豚熱（ASF）感染豚の不正流通に関する食品安全法違反の刑事事件であり、ヒトの公衆衛生への直接的な影響や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: ASFは豚などの動物に感染する疾病であり、ヒトへの感染性はないため公衆衛生リスクは限定的。本件は感染豚肉の不正流通・販売に対する刑事訴追が主題であり、疫学的シグナルとしての意義は低い。発生地域として記載された『Tỉnh Hà Tĩnh』は本文の主題（Quang Tri省・Thanh Hoa省の事件）とは異なり、関連情報として言及されているのみのため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 中國新冠又回來了 南方出現高峰 變異株正快速傳播 | 新冠病毒 | 南方地區 | 感染高峰
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 is back in China; a peak has emerged in the south; variants are spreading rapidly | COVID-19 | Southern region | infection peak
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 is back in China, with a southern regional wave peaking in July 2026. Fever clinics in Guangzhou, Changsha, and other southern cities report rising numbers of patients, presenting with sore throat, fever, cough, fatigue, and runny nose. Personal anecdotes from Guangzhou and Changsha illustrate household and workplace transmission after travel. National CDC data show June’s mainland total: about 79,000 laboratory-confirmed cases, 130 severe cases, and 1 death; influenza-like illness reports total 592,906. In July, 6–12 July sentinel surveillance found SARS-CoV-2 positivity among influenza-like illness patients at 11.9%, with a five-week rising trend and higher positivity in the south. Domestically, June cases were overwhelmingly Omicron NB.1.8.1 and sublineages (over 95%). Outside the mainland, Hong Kong and Macau are rising as well, dominated by NB.1.8.1 and subline PQ.16.1.1. On July 19, online chatter highlighted renewed concern that the virus has not disappeared.

triage.headline_ja: 中国でCOVID-19が再流行、南部で感染ピーク　変異株が急速に拡大
triage.triage_reason: 中国南部でCOVID-19新規変異株(NB.1.8.1系統)による感染ピークが確認され、ヒト-ヒト感染拡大と社会的関心の高まりが見られるため、WPRO基準を満たしフルRRAでの確認が望ましい。
triage.notes: COVID-19の季節性再流行で、重症化率・死亡率は低い（6月：約79,000例中重症130例、死亡1例）。香港・マカオも同様の傾向で中国に含めた。既知病原体の変異株拡大であり異常性は低いが、感染拡大とネット上の関心の高まりからWATCH〜PICKUP境界。続報での重症度・拡大範囲の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Diabetes patients face higher risk of severe dengue, says study
article.articleSummary: Thiruvananthapuram, India—Type 2 diabetes patients are at significantly higher risk of severe, potentially life-threatening dengue complications. A review slated for publication in the International Journal of Diabetes & Technology (IJDT) advocates integrating dengue vaccination into routine diabetes care to shield vulnerable populations from seasonal dengue outbreaks in endemic regions. The paper, led by Dr Jothydev Kesavadev, was presented at the 14th JPEF Annual Global Diabetes Convention in Kovalam (Uday Samudra), with the IJDT publication released by Health Minister K Muraleedharan. Authors emphasize that diabetics are among the most vulnerable during dengue outbreaks and that vaccination within diabetes management could reduce severe illness and hospitalisation; they call for further clinical research to optimize vaccination strategies for this high-risk group.

triage.headline_ja: 糖尿病患者は重症デング熱のリスクが高いと研究が指摘
triage.triage_reason: 研究発表・提言に関する記事であり、新規の感染症発生や異常な流行を示す情報ではないため、シグナルとして取り扱う必要はない。
triage.notes: 記事は糖尿病とデング重症化リスクに関する学術研究の紹介であり、特定の発生・流行イベントの報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Từ vụ nhiều trẻ mắc Adenovirus ở hồ bơi, bác sĩ cảnh báo 5 nơi dễ lây nhiễm chéo bệnh truyền nhiễm
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Following an Adenovirus outbreak among many children at a swimming pool, a doctor warns of five places where cross-infection of infectious diseases is likely.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-07-20, four children in Hanoi, Vietnam contracted Adenovirus after swimming at a public pool, prompting warning from Dr. Tran Duc Hau, head of pediatrics at Tam Anh Hanoi General Hospital, that cross-infection risk is high in crowded leisure venues when cleaning is inadequate. He cites five high-risk areas: (1) bounce houses; (2) public toilets; (3) public pools and shared water-related surfaces; (4) cinemas, photo booths, and activity zones with shared textiles and gear; (5) plush toys and costumes that can harbor droplets and pathogens. Beyond adenovirus causing respiratory illness, risks include conjunctivitis, diarrhea, ear infections, hand-foot-mouth disease, influenza, RSV, chickenpox, and hepatitis A, with global outbreaks of hepatitis A linked to contaminated water in pools or hot tubs. Prevention emphasizes rigorous cleaning, ventilation, crowd control, hand hygiene, and vaccination (influenza, measles, varicella, hepatitis A, meningococcal, pneumococcal, RSV, Rotavirus).

triage.headline_ja: プールでのアデノウイルス集団感染を受け、医師が交差感染しやすい5つの場所を警告
triage.triage_reason: 少数の小児（4名）がプールでアデノウイルスに感染した事例に基づく一般的な感染予防の注意記事であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常性、国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は医師による一般的な感染予防に関する啓発内容が中心で、疫学的な集団発生の規模や重症度に関する情報はほぼ不明。

article.articleHeadline: VMC intensifies mosquito control surveillance
article.articleSummary: Three malaria and two dengue cases have been reported in 2026 in the NTR district, including Vijayawada Municipal Corporation (VMC) limits. With monsoon creating ideal breeding conditions, VMC has intensified anti-larval operations, fogging, Indoor Residual Spraying in affected areas, and weekly Dry Day campaigns ahead of the peak rainy season. Surveillance tested 227,084 blood samples for malaria and 2,342 for dengue. In 2025, malaria and dengue numbered 41 and 23; 2024 saw 36 malaria and 50 dengue cases, with Jakkampudi Colony recording the highest incidence within VMC limits. Dr Pranit Kumar of Government General Hospital notes that malaria and dengue share fever and body aches; malaria can progress to cerebral malaria, while dengue may cause bleeding, low blood pressure and a sharp drop in platelets. Primary prevention focuses on sanitation and eliminating breeding sites; secondary prevention includes mosquito nets, repellents and prompt medical attention for fever or body pain.

triage.headline_ja: VMC、蚊媒介感染症対策の監視を強化
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のマラリア・デング熱の少数例と通常の予防的対策活動を報じる内容で、異常な拡大や重症化の兆候はなく、過去数年と同程度の発生規模である。
triage.notes: 地方自治体（VMC）による通常の蚊媒介感染症サーベイランスと予防対策の報告であり、例年比で症例数増加も見られない。

article.articleHeadline: Fresh diarrhoea outbreak in city, 14 hospitalised
article.articleSummary: Diarrhoeal outbreak in Giripuram, Vijayawada, hospitalising 14 residents from two lanes on July 18 after vomiting and loose motions. Cases confined to two lanes serving about 850 residents; Giripuram overall has roughly 3,000. The Vijayawada Municipal Corporation (VMC) and Health Department intensified surveillance with door-to-door checks, water-quality testing, and sample collection. Preliminary results showed no contamination and satisfactory residual chlorine; samples have been sent to the Institute of Preventive Medicine (IPM), Guntur for detailed analysis, with reports due on Sunday. All patients are stable; only a few remain under observation. Authorities are inspecting private RO water plants for compliance with testing and record-keeping, and will act on irregularities. The incident follows a major outbreak in New Rajarajeshwari Rao Pet months earlier, where 275 recovered and 42 remained under treatment before containment.

triage.headline_ja: 市内で新たな下痢症の集団発生、14人が入院
triage.triage_reason: インドの一地区で下痢症の小規模な集団発生があり、患者は安定・調査中だが、過去にも同様の発生があり水質管理の懸念が継続しているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 水質検査結果は現時点で汚染なしとされ、詳細分析結果は追加で報告される予定。以前の大規模発生（New Rajarajeshwari Rao Pet）との関連性や再発パターンに注意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 高端分享EV71疫苗布局 越南藥證開啟東南亞市場 | 全球中央 | 中央社 CNA
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Premium insights into EV71 vaccine deployment; Vietnam's drug approvals open up the Southeast Asian market
article.articleSummary: Taiwan’s High-end Vaccine achieves a milestone for Enterovirus 71 (EV71) vaccines as Vietnam grants its first import drug license for EV71 vaccine, following Taiwan’s launch nearing three years. A multi-country, multi-center Phase III trial of the EV71 vaccine across Taiwan and Vietnam underpins international regulatory acceptability, with results published in The Lancet. The company has begun regulatory submissions in Malaysia, Thailand, and the Philippines, signaling Southeast Asia market expansion. The 2026 Asia Biotech Fair highlighted a Target First development approach, emphasizing early alignment of clinical design, regulatory strategy, and commercialization. Beyond EV71, High-end announced a multi-type enterovirus vaccine program deemed an IDX by the CDE and TFDA drug project advisory mechanism, aiming to accelerate testing and review. Five core factors include precise targets, appropriate platform, robust quality systems, credible clinical data, and country-specific regulatory plans.

triage.headline_ja: 高端がEV71ワクチン展開を発表、ベトナムの薬事承認で東南アジア市場へ進出
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はEV71ワクチンの薬事承認・市場展開に関する企業広報的な内容であり、実際の感染症発生や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を報じるものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチンの薬事承認・商業展開に関する内容で、実際のEV71感染拡大や流行を報じていないため、感染症イベントとしてのトリアージ対象外と判断。

article.articleHeadline: U.S., Congo Ebola travel restrictions may hamper humanitarian aid response
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo is described as the world’s fastest-growing outbreak. In response, the United States imposes a 21-day period outside the U.S. for citizens/nationals who have been in Congo before returning on commercial flights, while the Democratic Republic of Congo requires people leaving Ebola-affected areas to remain inside the country for three weeks before international travel. The restrictions follow a June case in which a physician from humanitarian group ALIMA contracted Ebola and returned to France. Aid organizations and medical experts warn the measures could slow deployment and rotation of doctors, nurses and other specialists needed to contain the epidemic, potentially undermining humanitarian response and outbreak containment across borders.

triage.headline_ja: 米国とコンゴのエボラ渡航制限が人道支援対応を妨げる可能性
triage.triage_reason: 世界最速拡大とされるコンゴ東部のエボラ流行に対し、米・DRC双方が渡航制限を導入し、国際的な人道対応・支援活動に支障が出ている点でIHR基準・WPRO基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 米国・フランスは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。渡航制限が支援活動に与える影響が主題であり、DRCでのエボラ流行そのものが核心的事象。

article.articleHeadline: Supporting surveillance and response priorities for the 2026 DRC Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak -- Tshopo cohort, Rapid Release (17 July 2026)
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) centers on Kisangani, Tshopo Province, as a high-connectivity mobility hub for surveillance. A rapid release using anonymised mobile operator data from three Kisangani health zones (up to 8 June 2026) shows strong links to Kinshasa and Congo River river-port towns, with notable connectivity to Ituri, Maniema, Nord-Kivu, Bas-Uele, and Haut-Uele, and lesser ties to Lubumbashi/Haut-Katanga. As of 13 July 2026, there are 4 confirmed Ebola Bundibugyo cases in Tshopo, underscoring cross-regional transmission risk. The report cautions about cross-border spread toward the Republic of Congo via Congo River border sites, and notes Bondo HZ in Bas-Uele with crossings to CAR. Among top 50 connected health zones, 15 are in Kinshasa province, emphasizing urban importation risk and the need for prioritized surveillance and response in mobile-healthy regions.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年DRCエボラ（ブンディブジョ株）流行に対するサーベイランスと対応優先事位の支援 -- ツショパ県コホート、迅速リリース（2026年7月17日）
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ（ブンディブジョ株）の確認症例が発生し、キサンガニを中心に国内複数州および周辺国への越境拡大リスクが指摘されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事は移動データを用いたサーベイランス強化のための報告であり、確認症例数は13日時点で4例（ツショパ州）。コンゴ共和国及び中央アフリカ共和国への越境リスクが指摘されているが、両国での確認症例は記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: 高端腸病毒疫苗越南出貨在即，流感疫苗季底交貨，H2營收拚跳高轉盈
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Premium enterovirus vaccine shipments to Vietnam are imminent; influenza vaccine deliveries at the season’s end; H2 revenue to jump and turn profitable.
article.articleSummary: High-End Vaccines (6547) expects EV71 enterovirus vaccine shipments to Vietnam soon, with a TFDA export batch release anticipated by end-August and shipments to begin. Vietnam’s newborns total about 1.36 million annually, ten times Taiwan’s, underpinning demand. EV71 export to Vietnam is under a Southeast Asia deal with Sutarma Biological covering Vietnam, Thailand, Malaysia, Singapore, and Indonesia; other markets are pursuing vaccine approvals. To meet demand, High-End is adding a second filling line and plans a new plant in the Hsinchu Biotech Park, targeting 2028 commercial operation. A second-generation multivalent EV vaccine project has been designated an IDX by the Center for Drug Evaluation and has TFDA project consultation clearance. On influenza, 388,010 doses of public-funded trivalent vaccine have been allocated; production has begun and deliveries are expected by the end of Q3, contributing to a second-half revenue uptick toward profitability.

triage.headline_ja: 高端腸病毒疫苗越南出貨在即，流感疫苗季底交貨，H2營收拚跳高轉盈
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はワクチンメーカーの企業業績・出荷計画に関する内容であり、実際の感染症流行や公衆衛生上の異常事態を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はEV71ワクチンおよびインフルエンザワクチンの製造・出荷・企業業績に関する経済ニュースであり、実際の疾病発生や流行状況は報告されていない。ベトナム・タイ・マレーシア・シンガポール・インドネシアはワクチン輸出先市場として言及されているのみで、感染症発生地域ではない。

article.articleHeadline: 〈焦點股〉高端腸病毒疫苗開發計畫獲CDE、TFDA指標案件 走揚拚站回季線 | 鉅亨網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Focus Stock: Advanced Enterovirus Vaccine Development Program Secures CDE and TFDA Milestone Designations, Rises as It Aims to Retake the 3-Month Moving Average
article.articleSummary: On 2026-07-20, Advanced Vaccine (6547-TW) announced its multivalent enterovirus vaccine program was designated by CDE as a center milestone project (IDX) and secured TFDA Pharmaceutical Project Consultation and Guidance qualification, potentially boosting development of the second-generation multivalent vaccine. The stock rose in early trading, opening at NT$47.15, briefly reaching NT$48.30 (up >4%), before retreating to around NT$47.30 at midday (up >2%) with turnover above 1,000 shares. The company expects the program to advance through early pharmacology consultations, clinical development strategy discussions, and CMC-related communications to improve regulatory review and efficiency. The second generation will build on the EV71 vaccine platform, clinical experience, PIC/S GMP cell-culture manufacturing facilities, and CMC capabilities. In Taiwan, the EV71 vaccine already accounts for over 95% of the self-paid enterovirus vaccine market with nearly 600,000 doses sold; EV71 recently received marketing authorization in Vietnam in March.

triage.headline_ja: 〈焦点株〉高端腸病毒ワクチン開発計画がCDE・TFDAの重点案件指定を獲得、上昇し季線回復を目指す
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は企業の株式市況・ワクチン開発の規制承認に関する内容であり、感染症の発生や公衆衛生上のイベントを報じるものではない。
triage.notes: 台湾は対象国リストに含まれず、また記事内容は感染症発生ではなく製薬企業の株式・ワクチン開発ニュース。ベトナムでのEV71ワクチン承認言及があるが、これも感染症発生報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: 13-Year-Old Girl Tests Positive for COVID-19 in Vijayawada
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 case in Vijayawada: A 13-year-old girl from Tiruvuru in NTR district tested positive for COVID-19 at Government General Hospital (GGH) in Vijayawada on Monday. The girl, identified as Mahalakshmi, was shifted to the hospital's dedicated COVID ward for treatment. Hospital officials said her condition is stable and she is being closely monitored by a team of doctors. The report confirms a single confirmed case and provides no further details on other infections or exposure. No information on symptoms beyond stability is provided. This update is dated 2026-07-20.

triage.headline_ja: ヴィジャヤワダで13歳の少女がCOVID-19陽性反応

article.articleHeadline: Dukung Percepatan Penanggulangan Tuberkulosis, Bhabinkamtibmas Turun Kawal Tracing TBC - Suara Merdeka Banyumas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Support the Acceleration of Tuberculosis Control, Bhabinkamtibmas Take to the Field to Oversee TB Contact Tracing - Suara Merdeka Banyumas
article.articleSummary: TB control acceleration in Banyumas Regency, Indonesia, with community policing officers (Bhabinkamtibmas) joining cross-sector teams to conduct integrated tuberculosis contact tracing and Free Health Check (CKG) across Sumpiuh, Kemranjen, Purwojati, Lumbir, Kembaran, Sumbang, Wangon, Purwokerto Utara, Karanglewas, and Rawalo. Activities include accompaniment, tracing, screening, and monitoring of patients and close contacts; health checks, distribution of sputum sample bottles, household contact investigations, and follow-up laboratory sputum testing and chest radiography for those suspected of TB. In Kemranjen, tracing targets 100 residents; in Karanglewas, 100 individuals suspected of TB are screened with health checks, sputum testing, and chest X-rays. Police involvement supports the national program to accelerate TB elimination by improving tracing, raising awareness to seek testing, and ensuring early diagnosis and treatment adherence. Event took place July 17, 2026, with reporting on July 20, 2026.

article.articleHeadline: МИД сообщил о желании Африки купить российскую вакцину от Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Foreign Ministry reported Africa's desire to purchase a Russian Ebola vaccine.
article.articleSummary: Russia’s Foreign Ministry says African countries are expressing interest in a Russian vaccine against a new Ebola virus strain. Anatoly Bashkin, director of the MFA’s African States Department, notes DR Congo and Uganda are expected to purchase the modified vaccines as African partners. He recalled that during the Guinea–Sierra Leone Ebola outbreaks, vaccines were developed in a laboratory in Guinea, and past research helped quell the epidemic, though viral mutations demanded new medicines. A global race for vaccine effectiveness is ongoing, and the Russian drug is expected to be in demand due to regular outbreaks. Sergey Lavrov previously confirmed Russia’s readiness for serial production. The DR Congo reportedly recorded 956 Ebola cases. Domestic Russian health developments against the new strain were highlighted by Mikhail Murashko, with Gennady Onishchenko pledging rapid vaccine creation.

article.articleHeadline: У переболевших COVID выявили новое последствие инфекции
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New complication of COVID-19 infection identified in recovered patients.
article.articleSummary: Recovered COVID-19 patients are reported to have a new complication: eye nerve damage, including reduced corneal nerve fiber density and impaired pupil light reflex, cited in international medical journals. Researchers hypothesize chronic inflammation of the nervous system after COVID as a possible cause. The condition may be missed in routine ophthalmologic exams, yet sufferers may experience years of photophobia, rapid eye fatigue, blurred vision, headaches, and computer-work discomfort. The study sample was small, leaving prevalence unknown and no proven treatment currently. Context: COVID-19 emerged in Wuhan in December 2019; WHO declared a pandemic in March 2020. In Russia, as of July 20, 2026, there have been 23,014,969 confirmed cases, 22,458,308 recoveries, 400,023 deaths; 156,638 active cases, with none in critical condition.

article.articleHeadline: HIV After Tattoo? Kanpur Woman's Case Puts Delhi Tattoo Needle Under Scanner
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-07-20, a 32-year-old woman from Kanpur tested HIV-positive weeks after receiving a tattoo at a Delhi parlour. Doctors at Ganesh Shankar Vidyarthi Memorial Medical College (GSVM) suspect transmission via a contaminated or unsterilised tattoo needle; initial genital infection appeared about two weeks post-tattoo. HIV was laboratory-confirmed; Hepatitis B was negative. The patient has been admitted to a government hospital for free antiretroviral therapy (ART). Officials caution that unhygienic or unregulated tattoo establishments pose risks of blood-borne pathogen transmission, including HIV and Hepatitis B, and that substandard tattoo inks can cause skin reactions, with red and green pigments carrying higher risk. A full investigation to confirm the infection source is ongoing.

article.articleHeadline: 嘉市首例境外移入登革熱 有越南旅遊史
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chiayi City's first imported dengue fever case with travel history to Vietnam.
article.articleSummary: Chiayi City reports its first imported dengue fever case of the year, a male Taiwanese with travel history to Vietnam. Symptoms began July 15 (fever, headache, retro-orbital pain); he sought medical care July 16 and dengue was confirmed by PCR. On July 20, authorities carried out emergency vector control within a 100-meter radius of the patient’s residence, plus health education and monitoring of travel companions. Nationally, Taiwan had 97 confirmed dengue cases by July 20, with 90 imported and 7 locally transmitted cases. Hot, humid weather may boost mosquito breeding. Preventive actions include regular inspection and removal of standing water, using light-colored long sleeves/pants, government-approved repellent, and checking screens. Returnees with dengue-like symptoms should mask and visit one of 41 NS1 rapid-test clinics in Chiayi City, informing doctors of travel history for potential NS1 testing.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Canada își închide frontierele pentru străinii care au călătorit recent în RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Canada closes its borders to foreigners who have recently traveled to the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Canada imposes an entry ban on foreign nationals who have recently traveled to the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) amid the Ebola outbreak. From Monday, any foreigner who has lived or traveled in DRC within the last 21 days will be refused entry; Canadians and permanent residents are exempt but must quarantine for 21 days on arrival if they traveled to DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan in the preceding 21 days. The measures run through August 29 and are described as precautionary since risk is low and no traveler-associated cases have been reported in Canada. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned the outbreak in the DRC is spreading faster than prior epidemics. As of July 15, the WHO reported 2,124 cases and 828 deaths in DRC; officials suggest the true scale could be 2–4 times higher than official estimates.

article.articleHeadline: Mengenal Ciri-Ciri Penyakit Kusta dan Cara Mencegahnya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Understanding the signs of leprosy and how to prevent it.
article.articleSummary: Leprosy (Hansen’s disease) remains prevalent in North Sulawesi, Indonesia, with 179 new cases reported in the first half of 2026 and 411 cases in 2025. The infection is caused by Mycobacterium leprae and mostly affects the skin and peripheral nerves, but can involve the eyes and upper respiratory tract. Common signs include chronically discolored skin patches (white, red, or brown) that do not heal, numbness or loss of sensation within patches, tingling in hands and feet—especially fingers—enlarged nerves at the elbows, wrists, behind the knees, or neck, and non-healing injuries to hands or feet due to numbness. Additional features include difficulty closing the eyes, thinning eyebrows, and facial changes. Transmission occurs via droplets from an untreated patient during prolonged close contact; however most people have natural resistance, so spread is not as easy as commonly assumed. Early detection and treatment are crucial to prevent disability.

article.articleHeadline: NOA urges vigilance against Ebola threat - Peoples Gazette Nigeria
article.articleSummary: Bundibugy o Ebola Virus Disease outbreak remains under international alert as the World Health Organization declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern in May, with rising cases and deaths in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. Nigeria reports no confirmed cases but remains on high alert. In Enugu, NOA urged vigilance, citing Nigeria’s extensive travel, porous borders, and busy airports, including Akanu Ibiam International Airport, as risk factors for importation. Transmission occurs via direct contact with blood, body fluids, or contaminated materials from infected persons; fruit bats, monkeys and chimpanzees are animal reservoirs. Incubation is 2–21 days; symptoms include fever, fatigue, headache, muscle pain, sore throat, vomiting, diarrhoea, abdominal pain, rash, unexplained bleeding, and shock. No approved vaccine or specific treatment exists for Bundibugyo Ebola; prevention is key. NCDC activated National Emergency Operations Centre and enhanced surveillance nationwide; seek medical care after travel or exposure.

article.articleHeadline: Một xã ở Nghệ An tiêu hủy gần 18.000 con gia cầm dương tính cúm H5N1
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A commune in Nghệ An Province culled nearly 18,000 poultry that tested positive for H5N1 avian influenza.
article.articleSummary: An avian influenza outbreak attributed to A/H5N1 has been detected in Hung Châu Commune, Nghe An Province, Vietnam. The initial case appeared June 20, 2026 in a family duck flock at Truong Thanh hamlet; testing confirmed A/H5N1. Authorities culled 1,420 ducks (976 kg). By July 9, another sample from Hoang Xuan Loc’s flock in Yen Ly Dong hamlet tested positive; 725 ducks and 50 chickens (323 kg) were culled. By July 15, seven positive samples were confirmed after surveillance of nine poultry-rearing households with sick or dead birds. Overall, 17,840 poultry across seven households have been culled, including 50 chickens, 17,410 ducks, and 380 geese, weighing 19,440 kg. Difficulties include carcasses drifting in rivers and frequent duck movement across fields, complicating outbreak boundaries. Measures include stopping live-poultry trade, sanitation, and vaccination/support: 8,000 vaccine doses and two rounds of disinfectants from Nghệ An Department of Livestock and Veterinary.

article.articleHeadline: Takeda gets DCGI nod for dengue vaccine QDENGA
article.articleSummary: DCGI granted market authorization to Takeda's dengue vaccine QDENGA for use in India, making it the first dengue vaccine approved in the country. It is indicated for individuals aged 4–60 years and can be administered without prior dengue exposure testing; a 0.5 ml subcutaneous dose is given as two injections three months apart. Since its 2022 launch, QDENGA has been approved in 43 countries with over 32 million doses distributed. Seven-year data show protection against dengue infection and hospitalization across all four serotypes. The Indian approval rests on Takeda’s global programme (19 Phase 1–3 trials, over 28,000 participants) and a Phase III trial in Indian participants (DEN-302) evaluating safety and immunogenicity. WHO recommends QDENGA in endemic settings and it has WHO prequalification, enabling procurement via UNICEF and PAHO. India bears a substantial dengue burden with all four serotypes circulating, accounting for about one-third of the global burden.

article.articleHeadline: Կանադան էբոլա վիրուսի պատճառով սահմանափակումներ է մտցնում Կոնգո այցելած օտարերկրացիների համար
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Canada imposes restrictions on foreigners visiting Congo due to the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: Canada announced on July 19 a temporary border measure denying entry to any foreign national who has been in Congo within the previous 21 days, aimed at preventing Ebola virus spread. The Public Health Agency of Canada said restricting entry could reduce public health risks for Canadians. Earlier, Canada suspended immigration documents for residents of Congo, Uganda and South Sudan. The World Health Organization has urged countries not to restrict travel or trade with Congo, noting that Ebola spread is not linked to nationality or ethnicity and the international risk is low. Ebola primarily transmits through direct contact with bodily fluids of an infected person. As of July 15, Congo had more than 2,100 Ebola cases and 828 deaths; Uganda and South Sudan had reported no new cases recently. The policy references affected districts and aims to address stigma.

article.articleSummary: Chiayi City, Taiwan reports the year's first imported dengue fever case. The patient, a Taiwanese national with travel history to Vietnam, developed fever on July 15 accompanied by headache and retro-orbital pain, with PCR confirmation on July 18. In response, the Chiayi City Health Bureau implemented emergency vector-control around the residence within a 100-meter radius, intensified mosquito surveillance, and conducted indoor/outdoor chemical spraying to prevent local transmission. Nationally, as of July 20, Taiwan has 97 confirmed dengue cases, of which 90 are imported and 7 locally acquired. Authorities warn dengue season is ongoing, with hot, humid conditions favoring Aedes mosquitoes. Public should patrol, drain, clean, and brush to remove standing water; wear light-colored long sleeves and use government-approved repellent; check screens. Returning travelers from dengue-endemic areas with fever or dengue-like symptoms should wear a mask and seek care at one of 41 NS1 rapid-dengue clinics, informing clinicians of travel history.

article.articleHeadline: Virologe Steininger: "Große Dunkelziffer" an Ebola-Infektionen in DR Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Virologist Steininger: "Large undercount" of Ebola infections in DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Central Africa) is described as severely undercounted by virologist Christoph Steininger on ORF's ZiB 2. In the interview, Steininger cites a weak health system and insufficient hygiene measures as the main barriers to containment. The report notes 2,100 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases and more than 860 deaths, underscoring a high‑fatality outbreak in the region. No laboratory confirmation details or infection sources are provided, but the remarks emphasize systemic public health gaps rather than isolated incidents. The discussion highlights the risk of underreporting and ongoing transmission, with the implication that current case counts may underestimate the true burden of Ebola in Central Africa, as of 20 July 2026.

article.articleHeadline: Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh: 5 người tử vong vì bệnh dại trong 6 tháng đầu năm
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ho Chi Minh City: 5 people died of rabies in the first six months of the year.
article.articleSummary: Rabies deaths rise in Southern Vietnam in early 2026. Ho Chi Minh City records 5 rabies fatalities in the first six months of 2026, with Long Hai commune (3), Cu Chi (1), and Hoa Hiep (1) as the affected areas; all victims were unvaccinated and had not received rabies immunoglobulin, and 40% involved improper wound care. A highlighted case: a man bitten while exercising who used a folk venom-extraction remedy and died months later. Across the Southern region, 20 rabies deaths occurred January–June 2026, about half of the total for 2025. Medical experts stress there is no evidence for traditional remedies, and once the virus reaches the nervous system, fatality nears 100%. Preventive guidance urges washing wounds with soap under running water for at least 15 minutes, disinfecting with 70% alcohol, keeping wounds open, and seeking urgent vaccination and immunoglobulin at healthcare facilities. Health authorities promote vaccination campaigns and strengthened surveillance of roaming/unvaccinated dogs and cats; over the past two weeks, more than 51 individuals sought rabies post-exposure prophylaxis at a vaccination center.

article.articleHeadline: الطاعون.. خطر قائم كما كان في العصور الوسطى
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Plague: A Present Threat Just as It Was in the Middle Ages.
article.articleSummary: Plague, caused by Yersinia pestis, persists globally in three forms: bubonic (flea-borne, painful lymphadenopathy), septicemic, and pneumonic (airborne; possible human-to-human transmission). About 3,000 cases are reported worldwide annually (Robert Koch Institute). The Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda, and Madagascar are the most affected today, with Madagascar seeing roughly 250–500 cases per year and its last major outbreak in 2017; sporadic infections also occur in the western United States. A case in Oregon illustrates diagnostic challenges when plague is not considered promptly. Historically, the Black Death killed about 25 million in Europe (1347–1353). The bacterium dates back over 5,500 years, and the ymt gene enabled flea transmission, fueling pandemics. Rapid diagnosis and antibiotics save lives; delays, including drug access issues in Madagascar, can be fatal, especially pneumonic plague within 48 hours. Genomic analyses at the Robert Koch Institute aid strain differentiation and travel-related surveillance.

article.articleHeadline: 什么是布病？如何预防？全文一次性讲清
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What Is Brucellosis? How to Prevent It? The Full Explanation in One Go.
article.articleSummary: Brucellosis, a zoonotic infection caused by Brucella bacteria, is a Category B infectious disease under China’s Law on the Prevention and Control of Infectious Diseases. Primary sources are livestock, especially sheep, goats, and cattle; other animals such as pigs, camels, dogs, horses, deer, and yaks may carry Brucella. High‑risk groups include veterinarians, herders, livestock handlers, slaughterhouse workers, milking staff, fur and meat processors, and veterinary inspectors; general exposure to contaminated animals or dairy/meat products also poses risk. Transmission occurs via direct contact with infected animals or contaminated environments (skin/mucous membranes), ingestion of unpasteurized dairy products or undercooked meat, and inhalation of contaminated aerosols in abattoirs or fur facilities. Incubation is 1–4 weeks; early symptoms are non-specific, with fever, night sweats, fatigue, weight loss, headaches, and musculoskeletal pain; untreated cases can become chronic. Prevention emphasizes PPE, hygiene, thorough cooking, avoiding raw dairy and cross-contamination; human-to-human transmission is extremely rare. Beijing CDC.

article.articleHeadline: МИД сообщил о намерении предотвратить завоз Эболы в Россию
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Foreign Ministry announced its intention to prevent the import of Ebola into Russia.
article.articleSummary: Russia's Foreign Ministry aims to prevent Ebola importation from Africa, relying on domestic vaccines to curb spread from the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. Diplomats warn that without prompt action, imported cases could occur, as seen in France. Anatoly Bashkin, director of the MFA's Department for African States, stressed timely response, noting about 1.8 thousand people infected in Congo and Uganda as of early July 2026. Although the current outbreak is smaller than past waves, Ebola remains highly contagious. By early July 2026, Congo's confirmed cases had surpassed 1.7 thousand. Russian researchers, including Alexander Gintsburg of the Gamaleya Center for Epidemiology and Microbiology, say the threat of a large-scale outbreak in Russia is excluded. African countries have expressed interest in Russian vaccines against a new Ebola strain, with Moscow hopeful vaccines can curb spread.

article.articleHeadline: Из-за вируса Эбола Канада вводит ограничения для иностранцев, посещавших Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Canada imposes restrictions on foreigners who have visited Congo due to the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: Canada announced on July 19, 2026, that it will deny entry to any foreign national who has been in Congo within the previous 21 days, as part of temporary border measures to curb Ebola transmission. The Public Health Agency of Canada says restricting entry for travelers from Congo may reduce health risks to Canadians, and Canada had previously suspended issuing immigration documents to residents of Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan. The move follows coverage by Reuters via Armenpress and comes despite WHO guidance advising against travel or trade restrictions, noting a low international risk of Ebola spread and stressing that transmission occurs through direct contact with bodily fluids. As of July 15, the Congo outbreak surpassed 2,100 cases with about 828 deaths; Uganda reported no new cases since last month, and South Sudan had no confirmed cases.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスのため、カナダはコンゴを訪問した外国人に対する入国制限を導入
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で2,100人超の感染者・828人の死亡者を出すエボラ出血熱の大規模流行が継続しており、カナダが渡航制限を導入するなど国際的な対応が生じているため、IHR基準の複数項目に該当しフルRRAへの移行が必要と判断した。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・南スーダンも発生地域として挙げられているが、記事本文では両国とも新規感染者なし・確認例なしとされており、対象国リストにも含まれないため除外。カナダは対象国リスト外のため除外。WHOは国際的リスクを低いと評価し渡航制限に反対している点は留意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Takeda's QDENGA becomes first dengue vaccine approved in India
article.articleSummary: India's drug regulator has approved Takeda Pharmaceutical's dengue vaccine QDENGA, the first dengue vaccine cleared for use in the country. The approval was announced by Takeda's Indian unit on July 20, 2026. The report provides no details on dosing regimens, target populations, rollout plans, price, procurement, or distribution, and includes no information on dengue case counts, local outbreaks, laboratory confirmation, infection sources, or imported/exported cases. The Indian unit indicated the vaccine has been approved, marking a milestone for dengue prevention in India; however, the article does not disclose indications, dosing intervals, or age guidance. The piece cites Reuters reporting by Rishika Sadam and editing by Janane Venkatraman.

article.articleHeadline: सावधान! मानसून में बढ़ रहा बीमारियों का खतरा, जीएमसी जम्मू ने लोगों के लिए जारी की स्वास्थ्य एडवाइजरी - gmc jammu issues monsoon health advisory amid rising disease risk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Caution! The risk of diseases is increasing during the monsoon; GMC Jammu has issued a health advisory for the public.
article.articleSummary: Monsoon in Jammu elevates risk of water- and mosquito-borne infections as humidity, waterlogging, and contaminated water promote bacteria, viruses, and fungi. The Government Medical College Jammu issued an advisory listing diseases most commonly observed during the season: typhoid, cholera, hepatitis A, gastroenteritis, dengue, malaria, chikungunya, viral fever, and various fungal infections. To mitigate risk, the college recommends boiling or purifying drinking water, consuming fresh food, maintaining hand hygiene, using mosquito nets and repellents, and avoiding waterlogged areas. Emphasizing home ventilation and moisture control to reduce skin and respiratory problems, including heat rash, fungal infections, and asthma aggravation. Symptoms requiring medical care include high fever, persistent vomiting or diarrhea, and breathing difficulty; mild symptoms may be managed at home for a day, but professional consultation with a family physician is advised for any severe signs.

article.articleHeadline: Число жертв вспышки лихорадки Эбола в ДР Конго превысило 900
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The death toll from the Ebola fever outbreak in the DR Congo has surpassed 900.
article.articleSummary: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues with 2,344 confirmed cases and 930 confirmed deaths across five provinces, according to a July 18 briefing by the National Institute of Public Health (INSP) cited by RIA Novosti. There have been 466 recoveries. The death toll has surpassed 900, underscoring the sustained, high-mortality transmission of the outbreak. The report confirms laboratory-verified cases, highlighting the ongoing public health challenge. In a separate note, media reported that Ebola patients fled a hospital following a mob attack, illustrating security and access challenges in outbreak response. Overall, the update indicates persistent, active transmission and significant mortality in DR Congo, with figures focused on confirmed cases, deaths, and recoveries as of mid-July 2026.

article.articleHeadline: 學生至越南旅遊確診登革熱　嘉市首例境外移入
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Student who traveled to Vietnam diagnosed with dengue fever; Chiayi City's first imported case.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever in Chiayi City, Taiwan: a student who had vacationed in Vietnam is the year's first imported dengue case. After returning home, the patient developed fever, headache, and retro-orbital pain on July 15 and sought care; dengue was laboratory-confirmed by PCR on July 18. In response, Chiayi City Health Bureau conducted emergency vector-control operations around the residence within a 100-meter radius, intensified mosquito-density surveys, and cleared breeding sources. The health authority also provided education to the patient and contacts. With dengue still in season and hot, humid weather promoting Aedes mosquitoes, residents were urged to stay vigilant, practice the 4Ts (patrol, dump, clean, brush), wear light-colored long sleeves and use government-approved repellent, and check doors and windows for gaps to reduce transmission risk. No local transmission report; focus on imported case and preventive measures.

article.articleHeadline: फ्लू का बढ़ा खतरा, अस्पतालों में पहुंच रहे मरीज; डॉक्टरों ने दी सतर्क रहने की सलाह
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Increased risk of influenza as patients arrive at hospitals; doctors urge vigilance.
article.articleSummary: Influenza cases are rising in New Delhi, India, amid monsoon-driven weather changes, with patients presenting with cough, cold, sore throat and fever at hospitals. While most viral fever cases involve influenza A, about 50% test positive for Swine Flu (H1N1) and around 25% for H3N2; the rest are influenza B. Swine flu infections have required hospitalization in several cases, predominantly among people aged over 50; one COVID-19 case has also been admitted. In some patients, infection has reached the lungs, prompting pneumonia and admission. Symptoms of swine flu and COVID-19 overlap, including cough, fever, headache and malaise. High-risk groups include children, the elderly, pregnant women, and those with diabetes, hypertension, kidney disease, heart disease, asthma or cancer. Prevention emphasizes isolation for at least three days after symptom onset, hand hygiene, hydration, nutritious meals, steam inhalation if needed, avoiding crowds, and mask use; seek medical advice promptly.

article.articleHeadline: टाकेडा को डेंगू-रोधी टीका 'क्यूडेंगा' के लिए डीसीजीआई की मंजूरी मिली
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Takeda gets DCGI approval for dengue vaccine 'Qdenga'.
article.articleSummary: Dengue vaccine Qdenga receives DCGI approval in India, marking the first dengue-prevention vaccine sanctioned in the country. Takeda BioPharmaceuticals India Private Limited announced India's authorization to market Qdenga for dengue prevention in individuals aged 4 to 60 years, applicable regardless of prior dengue infection, with no pre-vaccination testing required. The approval, announced in New Delhi on July 20, 2026, expands dengue-control options in India where dengue remains a public health concern. Takeda notes that since its global rollout in 2022, Qdenga has secured approvals in 43 countries and has distributed over 32 million doses worldwide. The Indian approval represents a significant step to strengthen dengue prevention efforts domestically, leveraging a vaccine with broad age eligibility and flexible prior infection status.

article.articleHeadline: U.S. Caps Congo Ebola Travel Access
article.articleSummary: On 2026-07-20, the CDC tightened U.S. travel rules, barring Americans who have been in Congo (DRC), Uganda, or South Sudan from boarding U.S.-bound flights, with humanitarian or law-enforcement exemptions possible. The move, aimed at curbing cross-border Ebola transmission amid rising cases and a growing Kinshasa outbreak, notes that public risk remains low. The policy enforces a 21-day post-Congo travel period before returning on commercial flights, and Congo requires a 21-day outbound stay; the CDC has also extended screening. Critics warn it may slow deployment/rotation of healthcare workers and hinder outbreak response, while officials stress case-by-case exemptions. Operationally, rules could shift duties to neighboring countries and elevate air-bridge logistics. Expect further tightening as case numbers fluctuate and Kinshasa’s outbreak evolves, with exemptions remaining pivotal for humanitarian missions.

article.articleHeadline: At least 930 people have died in Congo's Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: 930 deaths among 2,344 confirmed Ebola cases in Congo’s eastern outbreak, with 37 new deaths in the previous 24 hours — one of the highest single-day totals reported. The outbreak, declared May 15 in eastern Congo, is the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak on record. It is driven by Bundibugyo virus, a less common Ebola species, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment. Health authorities in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continue to monitor transmission in the east, including Bunia, where the report originates. The absence of an approved vaccine or antiviral options underscores the need for intensified public health measures to contain spread and prevent further deaths.

triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）の大規模流行で死者930人、確定例2344人、承認済みワクチン・治療法がなく、史上最速の拡大速度と報告されており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: ワクチン・治療法未承認のブンディブギョ株による流行で、史上最速拡大とされる重大アウトブレイク。フルRRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 대만 코로나19 응급실 환자 2800명 넘어... 휴가철 국내 유입 우려
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Taiwan's COVID-19 emergency department patients exceed 2,800, raising concerns about domestic influx during the holiday season.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan reports 2,811 outpatient and emergency department visits for COVID-19 in the 27th week (July 5–11), up 34.4% from the prior week. Domestic severe complications rose to 17 new cases last week, with no new deaths. Since October 2025, cumulative COVID-19–related severe complications reach 136 cases, including 18 deaths; 72.1% of severe cases are aged 65+, 83.8% have chronic disease, and 94.9% of severe patients did not receive this season’s vaccine. Globally, positivity rates are rising, with outbreaks expanding in neighboring China, Hong Kong, Japan, and Singapore; circulating lineages include NB.1.8.1, JN.1, and XFG. Taiwan urges vaccination, noting studies that seasonal vaccines reduce emergency visits by 48–50% and hospitalizations by 53–55%. Free vaccination for residents aged 6 months+ extended through July 31, 2026 amid travel season. Korea has secured 2026–2027 vaccines (XFG strain): 4.84 million doses (Pfizer 2.91m, Moderna 1.93m).

article.articleHeadline: Japanese drugmaker Takeda's QDENGA becomes first dengue vaccine approved in India - CNBC TV18
article.articleSummary: India's drug regulator approved Takeda's dengue vaccine QDENGA, making it the first dengue vaccine authorized in the country. The tetravalent live-attenuated vaccine protects against all four dengue virus serotypes and can be given regardless of prior dengue exposure, with no pre-vaccination testing required. The approval comes as reported dengue cases in India have risen 11-fold over the past two decades, and India accounts for nearly one-third of the global dengue burden. Takeda, partnering with Biological E in 2024, plans to build production capacity to 50 million doses annually in India, supporting a goal of 100 million doses per year worldwide by decade's end. Since its 2022 launch, QDENGA has been approved in 43 countries with more than 32 million doses distributed, and long-term data show sustained protection against dengue and related hospitalisation.
