article.articleHeadline: МИД: Россия рассчитывает предотвратить завоз вируса Эбола из Африки
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Foreign Ministry: Russia aims to prevent the importation of the Ebola virus from Africa.
article.articleSummary: Russia aims to fully prevent importation of the Ebola virus from Africa, stated Anatoly Bashkin, director of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MFA) department for Sub-Saharan African States. He warned that without timely containment the risk of cross-border spread remains high and expressed hope that vaccines will help curb transmission. The current Ebola outbreak is centered in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda, with about 1,800 infections reported. This is far smaller than past outbreaks in Guinea and Sierra Leone, which reached tens of thousands of cases, though the Moscow official cautioned the hotspot remains dangerous as the virus spreads readily. As of 15 July 2026, 754 confirmed cases were reported, with the outbreak expanding into two additional provinces. The World Health Organization called it the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak, noting the true scale may be 2–4 times higher than official counts.

triage.headline_ja: 外務省：ロシアはアフリカからのエボラウイルス流入を防ぐことを目指す
triage.triage_reason: DRC・ウガンダで拡大中のエボラ出血熱がWHOにより「最速拡大」と評価され、複数州への拡大や国際的な懸念（ロシア外務省の言及）が確認されるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事はロシア外務省の発言を中心に構成されているが、実際のエボラ発生地はDRCとウガンダ。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。WHOは真の感染者数が公式発表の2〜4倍に達する可能性を指摘しており、公衆衛生上の懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Côte d'Ivoire : " Aucun cas détecté sur le territoire ", rassure le directeur général de l'INHP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ivory Coast: "No case detected on the territory," reassures the Director General of the INHP.
article.articleSummary: Ivory Coast reports no Ebola virus cases on its territory as of July 20, 2026, according to INHP Director-General Prof. Ekra Kouadio Daniel. While an Ebola outbreak is ongoing in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri province) since mid-May, with spread to neighboring Uganda, Ivory Coast has established a surveillance and detection system to prevent importation. The main objective is early detection. At Félix Houphouët-Boigny International Airport, temperature screening via thermal cameras, hand sanitizer, and rapid isolation/quarantine arrangements are in place; land borders also have temperature checks and hygiene stations, with training for regional and local health authorities to ensure rapid case management. The INHP coordinates surveillance through an Emergency Health Operations Center; Côte d’Ivoire can identify the Ebola virus type in circulation. Diagnostic kits are provided by the Pasteur Institute, with WHO collaboration providing information and training.

triage.headline_ja: コートジボワールのエボラ：「国内で感染者は検出されていない」とINHP事務局長が安心を表明
triage.triage_reason: DRC(イツリ州)で進行中のエボラ流行がウガンダへも拡大しており、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められるためIHR基準2つ以上に該当する。記事自体はコートジボワールでの非発生確認だが、背景の流行状況は継続的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はコートジボワールでの感染者ゼロ確認だが、背景として言及されるDRC(イツリ州)のエボラ流行およびウガンダへの拡大は既知の進行中アウトブレイクであり、対象国リストに含まれるDRCのみをverified_locationsに記載。ウガンダ・コートジボワールは対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: At least 930 dead in Ebola outbreak after worst day yet
article.articleSummary: 2,344 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases and 930 deaths were reported in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) as of Saturday night, in the Bundibugyo-virus outbreak described as the fastest-growing on record. The outbreak began in mid-May 2026 and was officially declared on May 15, 2026, with transmission across the DRC and neighboring Uganda. The Bundibugyo virus is a rarer Ebola strain; there is no approved vaccine or treatment. Ebola symptoms typically start with fever, fatigue, muscle aches, sore throat, and can progress to vomiting, diarrhea, impaired kidney and liver function, and bleeding. Transmission occurs through direct contact with blood or other bodily fluids of infected, symptomatic people. The article notes 37 new deaths in the previous 24 hours, highlighting ongoing, severe impact.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行で少なくとも930人死亡、これまでで最悪の日
triage.triage_reason: DRCで承認済みワクチン・治療法のないブンディブギョ・エボラウイルスが急速に拡大し、死者930人・確定例2344人、ウガンダへの越境伝播も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため、DRCのみをverified_locationsに記載。ワクチン・治療法未承認の稀少株（ブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス）による史上最速拡大の流行とされ、極めて重大な公衆衛生上の脅威。

article.articleHeadline: Deaths in Congo's Ebola outbreak surge to over 900
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo health ministry reports 930 deaths from an Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo, with 2,344 laboratory-confirmed cases as of Saturday. In the prior 24 hours, 37 deaths were recorded, marking one of the highest single-day totals. Declared in eastern Congo on May 15, the Bundibugyo virus–driven outbreak is described as the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak on record. The Bundibugyo virus, though less common than other Ebola strains, has driven this rapid surge. There is no approved vaccine or treatment for this strain. The report underscores ongoing transmission and a high mortality burden amid limited therapeutic options, noting that this outbreak is the fastest-growing Ebola event to date.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行、死者900人超に急増
triage.triage_reason: エボラ（ブンディブギョ株）による死者930人、確定例2344件と重大な公衆衛生影響があり、最速拡大のアウトブレイクとされ国際的拡大リスクも高いためIHR基準複数該当。
triage.notes: 承認済みワクチン・治療薬が存在しないブンディブギョ株による流行で、致死率・拡大速度ともに過去最速とされる重大イベント。フルRRAでの詳細評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Kanpur HIV Tattoo Case: दिल्ली में टैटू बनवाना पड़ा भारी, कानपुर की महिला पाई गई HIV पॉजिटिव; जांच के घेरे में टैटू की सुई
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kanpur HIV Tattoo Case: Getting a tattoo in Delhi proved costly; a woman from Kanpur tested HIV positive; tattoo needle under investigation.
article.articleSummary: As of July 20, 2026, a 32-year-old woman from Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh, developed HIV after getting a tattoo at a Delhi parlor a few weeks earlier. GSVM Medical College dermatology specialists preliminarily attribute transmission to a contaminated or non-sterile tattoo needle, though full source confirmation awaits further tests. HIV infection was confirmed; hepatitis B was negative. She has been registered at a government hospital ART center, where free antiretroviral therapy has begun. Health authorities warn against unlicensed or dirty parlors and low-quality ink, which can also pose risks for hepatitis B/C and skin reactions, especially with red and green pigments. Guidance urges verifying hygiene and safety protocols before tattooing and avoiding inexpensive, informal parlors. The case underscores infection-control concerns in tattoo services and ongoing investigations into the source.

triage.headline_ja: カンプールHIVタトゥー事件：デリーでのタトゥーが高くついた、カンプールの女性がHIV陽性反応、タトゥー針が調査対象に
triage.triage_reason: 単一の個人症例であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大のリスクは見られない。個別の衛生管理不備事案として扱うべき事例。
triage.notes: 単一症例の個別報道であり、感染症の集団発生・アウトブレイクではない。タトゥー施設の衛生管理問題として地域保健当局が対応中。

article.articleHeadline: Κονγκό: Αυξάνονται τα διεθνή μέτρα κατά του Έμπολα - Ο Καναδάς κλείνει τα σύνορα σε ταξιδιώτες - Στους 828 οι θάνατοι
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo: International measures against Ebola are increasing; Canada closes its borders to travellers; death toll reaches 828.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak continues in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with more than 2,100 cases and 828 deaths reported as of July 15. Transmission is mainly via direct contact with bodily fluids of infected individuals. WHO says travel or trade restrictions are not warranted and risk stigma, noting international spread remains low. Canada will bar entry of foreign nationals who have been in the Congo in the previous 21 days, effective July 20 at 11:59 p.m. ET, aligning with U.S. measures; Canada had previously suspended immigration documents for Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan. In the United States, Americans who were in the Congo within 21 days are blocked from entering on commercial flights; seven humanitarian workers in Kenya are in quarantine there. The European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC) advises against travel bans.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ:エボラに対する国際的措置が拡大 - カナダは渡航者の国境を閉鎖 - 死者数828人に
triage.triage_reason: DRCで2100人超の感染者・828人の死者を出す大規模エボラ流行が継続中で、複数国が渡航制限措置を導入しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはUnited States, Sudan, Kenya, Uganda, Canadaが含まれているが、これらは渡航制限措置や検疫対応の実施国であり、実際の発生国はDRCのみ。WHOは渡航・貿易制限を推奨していないが、カナダ・米国は独自に入国制限を実施している点で travel_trade_restriction をYesと判定した。

article.articleHeadline: Brote de ébola en República Democrática del Congo deja más de 930 muertos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo leaves more than 930 dead.
article.articleSummary: In the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo around Bunia, Ebola has killed at least 930 people and infected 2,344 confirmed cases, according to the DRC Ministry of Health. In the last 24 hours, 37 deaths were added. Declared on May 15 in eastern Congo, this outbreak is described as the fastest-growing in history. The causative agent is Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a less common Ebola strain, and there are currently no vaccines or approved treatments available for Bundibugyo Ebola. The report notes ongoing transmission with a high daily death toll as authorities monitor the evolving situation. This update is as of July 20, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行、死者930人超に
triage.triage_reason: 致死者930人超・感染2,344人と規模が大きく、ワクチン・治療法未承認のブンディブジョ株による急速拡大が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: ワクチン・治療薬未承認のブンディブジョ・エボラウイルス株による流行で、史上最速の拡大速度と報告されている。国際的な支援・監視が必要な深刻な公衆衛生上の緊急事態。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Ausbruch im Kongo: Über 930 Tote - und kein Impfstoff in Sicht
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Congo: More than 930 dead — and no vaccine in sight.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, ongoing since mid-May, is driven by the rare Bundibugyo virus variant. As of the night of Monday, at least 930 people have died and more than 2,300 infections have been confirmed. The rapid spread poses a major challenge to containment and public health responses in the affected region. There is no licensed vaccine or approved treatment for the Bundibugyo variant, complicating patient care and outbreak control. The report highlights the severity of this wave and the urgent need for effective countermeasures, enhanced surveillance, and international support to curb transmission in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ出血熱流行：死者930人超、ワクチンの見通しなし
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で稀なブンディブギョ株によるエボラ流行が拡大し、死者930人・感染者2300人超と重大な公衆衛生上の影響があり、ワクチン未承認という異常性・拡大リスクも高いためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株は稀な変異株であり、承認されたワクチン・治療法が存在しないため、感染拡大と対応の遅れが懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: At least 930 people have died in Congo's Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: As of July 20, 2026, Congo's eastern Ituri province is experiencing the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak on record, caused by the Bundibugyo virus. The Ministry of Health reports 2,344 confirmed cases and 930 deaths, with 37 new deaths recorded in the previous 24 hours. There is no approved vaccine or treatment for this strain, complicating containment. Safety concerns have hampered response efforts in Ituri, where at least 12 attacks have targeted health facilities and teams since mid-May. Many health workers have walked off duties amid payment protests, and at least 36 infected health workers have died. The ministry notes 724 patients are currently in isolation in hospitals as response activities are intensified across affected health zones.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行、死者少なくとも930人に
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ・イツリ州で過去最速の拡大速度を示すエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)流行が発生し、承認されたワクチン・治療法がなく、医療施設への攻撃や医療従事者のストライキで対応が困難となっており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的関心が高い事案。
triage.notes: ワクチン・治療法未承認のブンディブギョ株による過去最速拡大の流行。治安悪化と医療従事者の離脱により対応が著しく阻害されており、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Pemkot Tangsel Perkuat Gerakan RW Bebas TBC, Libatkan Masyarakat Putus Rantai Penularan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: South Tangerang City Government Strengthens the TB-Free RW Movement, Involving the Community to Break the Transmission Chain.
article.articleSummary: South Tangerang City strengthens the TB-Free RW movement to break the airborne transmission of tuberculosis (TB). Led by the Dinas Kesehatan, the RW Bebas TBC program mobilizes government, health workers, cadres, community leaders, and residents to foster a local environment that promotes early TB symptom recognition, encourages those with prolonged cough to seek care, and supports patients to complete treatment to cure while reducing stigma. Mayor Benyamin Davnie emphasizes that TB elimination requires broad community involvement and cross‑sector collaboration to optimize prevention, case finding, and treatment support. The initiative expands health education, contact tracing, and cadre capacity, with coordination across local government down to RT/RW levels as part of a promotive and preventive strategy. Ongoing efforts aim to accelerate TB elimination in the city, as of July 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 南タンゲラン市政府、TBフリーRW運動を強化し、地域住民を巻き込んで感染連鎖を断つ
triage.triage_reason: 既知の疾患である結核に対する既存の地域公衆衛生プログラムの強化に関する内容であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 地方自治体による既存の結核対策プログラムの強化を伝える通常の公衆衛生活動報道であり、シグナルとしての緊急性はない。

article.articleHeadline: Congos Ebola Crisis Deepens Death Toll Crosses 930 as Outbreak Spreads Rapidly
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo surges with at least 930 deaths and 2,344 confirmed cases, including 37 fatalities in the last 24 hours, as of 20 July 2026. The crisis is driven by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment; control hinges on early detection, isolation, contact tracing, and supportive care. Security challenges impede response, with attacks on health facilities and aid workers disrupting containment and limiting access to affected communities. International health agencies are monitoring the situation and providing support to curb fatalities. Authorities urge prompt symptom reporting and cooperation with healthcare teams to stem transmission. The outbreak continues to spread rapidly, representing a sustained public health risk for the region.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ危機深刻化、死者930人超え、急速に拡大
triage.triage_reason: 死者930人超・確定例2,344人と大規模なエボラ流行が急速拡大しており、ワクチン未承認のブンディブギョ株であること、治安悪化により対応が阻害されている点から公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株によるエボラ流行で、治安問題（医療施設・援助者への攻撃）が対応を阻害しており、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Confirmed Ebola cases in DR Congo top 2,000
article.articleSummary: As of 20 July 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 2,011 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases and 754 deaths, with 366 recoveries and 753 patients in isolation. The outbreak spans five provinces: Ituri (epicenter), North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele and Tshopo. Transmission remains intense in Ituri, confirming it as the main hotspot, while new cases in Haut-Uele indicate geographic spread and a need to strengthen surveillance, diagnostic capacity and operational preparedness. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus and was declared on 15 May. Health authorities describe the situation as sustained transmission with a rapid rise in cases since the beginning. A photo from Bunia shows a healthcare worker at the Evangelical Medical Center, a site linked to Ebola clinical trials scheduled for July 2026.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ確定患者数が2,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 5州にわたる大規模エボラ流行で確定2,011例・死亡754例に達し、致死率が高く地理的拡大も継続しているため、深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスクの複数のIHR基準に該当する。
triage.notes: Bundibugyoエボラウイルスによる流行で、2026年5月15日に宣言。イトゥリ州が主要な流行地であり、Haut-Uele州への拡大が確認されている。臨床試験の実施予定あり。既にWHO等による大規模な国際対応が進行中と推測される。

article.articleHeadline: Canada își închide granițele pentru călătorii veniți din Congo: epidemia de Ebola se extinde alarmant
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Canada closes its borders to travelers arriving from Congo: the Ebola epidemic is spreading alarmingly.
article.articleSummary: Canada imposes an entry ban on foreign nationals who have recently travelled to the Democratic Republic of the Congo due to the spreading Ebola epidemic in the region. The restriction targets anyone who has lived or travelled in DRC within the past 21 days and takes effect on Monday, lasting until August 29. Canadian citizens and permanent residents are exempt but must quarantine for 21 days on arrival if they traveled to DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan in the prior 21 days. Public Health Agency of Canada calls it a precautionary measure, noting the risk to Canada is low and no travel-associated cases have been reported to date. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warns the outbreak in DRC is expanding faster than previous Ebola outbreaks. As of July 15, DRC reported 2,124 Ebola cases and 828 deaths; authorities caution that true numbers could be 2–4 times higher, prompting other states to adopt travel precautions.

triage.headline_ja: カナダ、コンゴからの入国者に対する国境閉鎖：エボラ流行が警戒すべき速さで拡大
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ大規模流行（2,124例、828死亡、過去のアウトブレイクより速い拡大）とカナダによる渡航制限措置が実施されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域にウガンダ・南スーダン・カナダが含まれるが、記事の主題はDRCでのエボラ流行とそれに対するカナダの渡航制限措置。ウガンダ・南スーダンは検疫対象国として言及されているのみで、当該国での発生自体は本文で確認できず、また対象国リストにも含まれないため除外。カナダも対象国リスト外。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉防疫　加拿大禁3週內到過剛果外籍人士入境
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola prevention measures: Canada bars entry for foreign nationals who have been to the Democratic Republic of the Congo within the last three weeks.
article.articleSummary: Canada imposes a temporary entry ban on foreign nationals who have visited the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) within the last 21 days, as part of Ebola outbreak response. The restriction takes effect July 20 at 11:59 p.m. Eastern Time (July 21 at 11:59 a.m. Taiwan time). Ebola spreads mainly through direct contact with infected bodily fluids. As of July 15, the DRC reported over 2,100 confirmed Ebola cases and 828 deaths. WHO opposes travel bans, warning such restrictions can stigmatize affected communities and impede outbreak control, given the low likelihood of international spread. Canada’s Public Health Agency says the risk to Canadians is low, but violations carry penalties up to CAD 150,000 for individuals and CAD 1.5 million for organizations. Canada had paused immigration processing for the DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan; Uganda reports no new cases, and South Sudan has no confirmed cases.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ防疫措置：カナダ、過去3週間以内にコンゴ民主共和国を訪問した外国人の入国を禁止
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が2,100例超・死亡828例と深刻化し、カナダが渡航制限を実施するなど国際的対応が生じているため、IHR基準を複数満たしフルRRAへの移行が適切。
triage.notes: WHOは渡航制限に反対し国際的拡大リスクは低いと評価しているが、カナダの実際の入国禁止措置は渡航・貿易制限基準に該当する。ウガンダ・南スーダンは新規/確認例なしのため対象国リストにも含まれず除外。

article.articleHeadline: "Ganz dramatische Auswirkungen": Virologe Steininger warnt in der ZiB 2 vor Ebola-Krise
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "Very Dramatic Consequences": Virologist Steininger Warns About an Ebola Crisis on ZiB 2
article.articleSummary: As of July 20, 2026, Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo are likely far larger than official counts, according to virologist Christoph Steininger, due to an overwhelmed health system, scarce resources, and inadequate hygiene measures. He cites a large undetected burden and notes that many patients are not brought to hospitals, fueling rapid spread. Funeral practices—families washing the deceased—are a notable infection source. Gaps in medicines and vaccines exist; although effective tools for a related Ebola strain were developed 10–15 years ago, the circulating variant is rare and not substantially different from other Ebola variants, with new vaccines and drugs in development but uncertain timelines. The outbreak has been declared a public health emergency of international concern, unlocking more resources, though US funding cuts threaten logistics in a region with long supply chains. A May Ebola suspicion in Upper Austria was ruled out.

triage.headline_ja: 「非常に深刻な影響」：ウイルス学者シュタイニンガー氏がZiB 2でエボラ危機を警告
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行は公式発表を大幅に上回る規模とされ、PHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）が既に宣言されており、資金不足により対応能力にも懸念があるため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: オーストリア（上部オーストリア州）でのエボラ疑い例は5月に否定されており、実際の発生国はDRCのみ。米国の資金削減が長い供給網を持つ地域のロジスティクスに脅威を与えている点も注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Congo Ebola Outbreak Kills 930, No Approved Vaccine as Crisis Escalates
article.articleSummary: Congo’s eastern Ebola outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo virus, has at least 930 deaths among 2,344 confirmed cases as of Saturday, with 37 new fatalities in the last 24 hours. Declared May 15, the outbreak is described as the fastest-growing Ebola event on record. There is no approved vaccine or treatment. Safety fears have restricted the response in Ituri province, the worst-affected area. The health ministry reports 724 patients in isolation across hospitals and facilities. At least 12 attacks on health facilities and response teams have occurred since mid-May, and many health workers have quit amid payment protests; 36 health workers have died from infection. The crisis underscores significant challenges in containment, including limited access, security risks, and strained health systems in Congo.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ流行、死者930人 承認済みワクチンなく危機拡大
triage.triage_reason: 史上最速の拡大を見せるエボラ流行で死者930人、承認ワクチン・治療法がなく、治安悪化により対応が制限されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: Ituriはコンゴ国内の州であり、発生地域として国レベルではDRCのみをverified_locationsに記載。ワクチン・治療薬未承認、医療施設への攻撃、医療従事者の離脱・感染死亡など、対応能力に深刻な課題があり、国際的な支援ニーズが高い。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de ébola na RDCongo causa 930 mortes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo causes 930 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), centered in the eastern Ituri province, has reached 2,344 confirmed cases and 930 deaths as of 2026-07-20, with 37 deaths in the last 24 hours. Declared May 15, the outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo Ebola virus, a less common strain for which no vaccine or approved treatment exists. Security concerns have impeded response in Ituri, amid at least 12 attacks on health facilities and teams since mid-May. Healthcare workers have protested over nonpayment, with at least 36 infected professionals succumbing to the virus. The Ministry of Health reports 724 patients in isolation and hospitalization, and says response efforts are being intensified in affected health zones to curb transmission and provide care.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の流行、930人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRCで2,344例・930人死亡（致死率約40%）に達する大規模エボラ流行が継続中で、ワクチン未承認のブンディブギョ株が原因、治安悪化により対応が困難な状況にあり、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株はワクチン・承認治療法が存在せず、治安悪化により医療施設への攻撃が12件以上発生、医療従事者の未払い問題も発生している。国境を越えた拡大リスクについては記事内に明示的記載がないため国際拡大の判断は状況を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Wabah Ebola Bundibugyo di Republik Demokratik Kongo Kian Ganas, 800 Orang Meninggal
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo grows more deadly; 800 people dead.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo intensifies, with 2,124 confirmed cases and 828 deaths as of July 15, 2026. Since July 3, 664 new cases and 376 deaths were reported, expanding across 46 health zones in five provinces. A laboratory-confirmed Bundibugyo Ebola case in a U.S.-based humanitarian worker evacuated to Germany was reported on July 13, highlighting international spread. Uganda reports no new cases since June 21; the latest patient was discharged July 16 after two negative tests, and a 42-day intensified surveillance period is under way. Bundibugyo Ebola virus has no approved vaccine or therapy. WHO Director-General Tedros declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17, 2026. Authorities in Uganda and DRC, with WHO and partners, continue extensive response efforts, mobilizing international action.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のブンディブジョ・エボラ流行が悪化、死者800人に
triage.triage_reason: PHEIC宣言済み、国際的な拡大（米国人医療従事者がドイツへ搬送）、承認済みワクチン・治療薬なしという重大な公衆衛生上の懸念が複数のIHR基準・WPRO基準に該当する。
triage.notes: 米国とドイツは感染者の搬送先であり発生国ではないため対象国リストに含まれず、除外。ウガンダは新規感染ゼロで対象国リスト外のため除外。DRCが主たる発生国として唯一該当。WHOはすでにPHEICを宣言済みであり、フルRRA継続が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus DBD di Garut Meningkat Signifikan, 869 Orang Positif dan 3 Meninggal Dunia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue Fever Cases in Garut Increase Significantly, 869 People Test Positive and 3 Die
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever cases in Garut, West Java, climbed significantly from January through July 2026, with 869 people testing positive for the Aedes aegypti-transmitted virus and 3 deaths reported. The Garut Health Office attributes the rise to unsettled weather and inadequate community environmental cleanliness, noting most cases occur in rural settlements. Unpredictable conditions during the dry season accelerate Aedes larval development into adults. Health authorities are countering with vector-control measures, including fogging in endemic areas and routine larval checks at homes, especially water-storage containers. Residents are urged to practice 3M (drain, cover, bury)—maintain clean living, and participate in mosquito-breeding source reduction. The campaign also promotes One House One Jumantik to empower communities to monitor their surroundings.

triage.headline_ja: ガルットでデング熱感染者が急増、869人が陽性、3人死亡
triage.triage_reason: 西ジャワ州ガルットでデング熱症例が増加し死者も出ているが、季節性の地方風土病的増加であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いため、続報を注視するレベルと判断。
triage.notes: デング熱はインドネシアの風土病であり、乾季の気候変動によるベクター増加が主因とされる季節的な増加。地方保健当局が防蚊対策（フォギング、幼虫調査、3M運動）で対応中で、外部支援の必要性は明示されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Kanada berlakukan langkah perbatasan baru merespons wabah Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Canada imposes new border measures in response to the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Canada's Public Health Agency (PHAC) announced new border measures in response to an Ebola outbreak, effective July 20, 2026. Foreign nationals who have recently been in the Democratic Republic of the Congo within the preceding 21 days are barred from entering Canada. Canadians, permanent residents, and those registered under the Indian Act who have traveled to the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan in the past 21 days may enter but must undergo health screenings on arrival and complete a 21-day quarantine. The rules, along with other measures under an earlier Order in Council, will remain in place through August 29, 2026. PHAC reports that, to date, there have been no travel-related Ebola cases in Canada. The measures aim to reduce the risk of Ebola entering and spreading domestically and to streamline processing of travelers, including returning humanitarian workers.

triage.headline_ja: カナダ、エボラ出血熱流行への対応として新たな国境措置を実施
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の流行を受けてカナダが入国制限・検疫措置を導入しており、国際的拡大リスクおよび渡航制限の基準に該当するため。DRCでのエボラ流行はIHR基準に複数該当する重大な公衆衛生事案である。
triage.notes: 記事はカナダの国境措置に関する内容だが、根本的な感染源はDRCのエボラ流行。ウガンダ・南スーダンも渡航歴対象国として言及されているが、対象国リストにウガンダ・南スーダンは含まれないため除外。カナダも対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCのエボラ流行の詳細（症例数・死亡数等）は本記事には記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Kanada verhängt wegen Ebola Einreisestopp für Kongo-Reisende
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Canada imposes Ebola-related entry ban on travelers from Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues, with over 2,100 cases and 828 deaths reported as of July 15. Canada has imposed a temporary entry ban on foreign nationals who have been in the DRC within the prior 21 days, effective July 20 at 23:59 local time (July 21, 05:59 CEST). The measure aims to reduce domestic health risk, per Ottawa’s public health authority, despite WHO guidance against travel or trade restrictions. Ebola is primarily transmitted through direct contact with bodily fluids of infected individuals. The UN agency notes the international spread risk is low. The United States had similar measures last week, barring entry of U.S. citizens who had been in the DRC in the preceding 21 days.

triage.headline_ja: カナダ、エボラを理由にコンゴからの渡航者に入国禁止措置
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ出血熱流行は2,100人超の感染者・828人の死者を記録する大規模流行であり、カナダ・米国が渡航制限を課すなど国際的な政治対応が生じているため、フルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: WHOは国際的拡大リスクを低いと評価しているが、複数国が渡航制限を導入している事実から社会的・政治的関心は高い。米国・カナダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: 暑假赴越南旅遊染疫返台　嘉義市出現今年首例境外移入登革熱
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Infected on a summer trip to Vietnam and returned to Taiwan; Chiayi City reports this year's first imported dengue fever case.
article.articleSummary: Chiayi City reports Taiwan's first imported dengue fever case this year. The patient, a student, traveled to Vietnam during summer break and returned home; fever, headaches, and retro-orbital pain appeared on July 15; medical visit on July 16; dengue virus PCR positive on July 18. Post-diagnosis, authorities conducted vector control around the residence and completed indoor/outdoor chemical spraying within 100 meters on July 20. The patient's travel companions are well; no symptoms yet. With dengue season, authorities urge residents to practice 'survey, drain, cover, and flush', reduce standing water, wear light clothing, use government-approved repellent, and check screens. Nationwide dengue cases total 97 as of July 20: 90 imported, 7 domestic. People returning from dengue-endemic areas with fever, headache, retro-orbital pain, or myalgia/joint pain should wear masks and visit one of 41 NS1 rapid dengue test clinics in Chiayi City, informing doctors of travel history.

triage.headline_ja: 夏休みにベトナム旅行で感染し台湾に帰国、嘉義市で今年最初の輸入性デング熱症例確認
triage.triage_reason: 台湾における単発の輸入デング熱症例であり、ベクター対策も実施済みで二次感染の報告なし。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低く、社会的関心も限定的。
triage.notes: 台湾は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ベトナムは感染源地として言及されているが、実際の感染はベトナム国内での曝露と考えられるため参考として記載。ただし対象国リストにベトナムが含まれるため一応記載したが、記事の主題は台湾国内の輸入例管理であり、ベトナム国内の流行状況についての情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: От Эболы в ДР Конго погибли 930 человек, 466 пациента выздоровели
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in DR Congo: 930 dead, 466 recovered.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo continues, with 2,344 confirmed cases, 930 deaths, and 466 recoveries reported as of July 20, 2026. Five provinces are affected: Upper Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, and Tshopo. About 724 patients are in isolation or hospitalized. Case fatality rate stands at 39.7%, while contact tracing coverage is 85.8%. Medical teams are intensifying epidemiological surveillance, clinical care, and contact tracing to curb transmission. Response efforts focus on reinforcing measures in the affected regions to control the outbreak, support affected communities, and limit further spread. The report highlights ongoing public health actions by Congolese authorities to monitor cases, manage care, and trace contacts amid the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱、死者930人、回復者466人
triage.triage_reason: DRCで2,344例確認、930人死亡（致死率39.7%）という大規模なエボラ流行が継続しており、複数州に拡大し人的被害が深刻であるため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: 記事中のTshopo、South Kivu、Ituriなどの州はいずれもDRC国内の行政区分であり、DRC一国として集約した。致死率が高く、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が継続している。

article.articleHeadline: Епидемија у Конгу све тежа: више од 2.300 потврђених случајева еболе
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Epidemic in the Congo is getting worse: more than 2,300 confirmed Ebola cases.
article.articleSummary: 2,344 confirmed Ebola cases and 930 deaths in the Democratic Republic of Congo as of Monday, 20 July 2026, 09:21 local time. The outbreak is worsening, with the WHO warning that the true total could be two to four times the official count due to limited treatment centers and community resistance to strict hygiene measures. Medical staff staged protests outside the Ebola Treatment Center. Officials say response is hampered by insufficient facilities and local opposition to control measures. Chikwe Ihekweazu, Executive Director of the WHO Ebola Emergency Response Programme, said that based on analysis and models the real burden is at least twofold, possibly fourfold the confirmed cases. No further details on symptoms, laboratory confirmation timelines, infection sources, or imported/exported cases are provided.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行が悪化：確定患者2,300人超
triage.triage_reason: エボラの確定患者2,344人・死亡930人と大規模で、WHOが実際の規模は2〜4倍との見解を示すなど公衆衛生への深刻な影響とヒト-ヒト感染拡大の懸念があり、社会的関心（医療従事者の抗議）も確認されるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: WHOは実際の感染者数が公式発表の2〜4倍に達する可能性を指摘。医療従事者の抗議や住民の衛生対策への抵抗が対応を阻害している。

article.articleHeadline: 大巨蛋變「毒窟」？網友崩潰「我在咳嗽了」　疾管署早已示警了
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Taipei Dome Turns Into a 'Toxic Cave'? Netizens Panicked, 'I'm Coughing' — the CDC Had Warned Long Ago.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan's Taipei Dome, a venue for sports and concerts, is drawing attention after social-media posts describe attendees developing coughs, sore throats, and cold symptoms following events, fueling fears of an indoor ‘toxic cave.’ In response, Taiwan's Centers for Disease Control (CDC) on July 14 warned that domestic COVID-19 activity continues to rise and urged vaccination with this season's COVID-19 shot, as well as self-protection measures; masking is advised in crowded or poorly ventilated spaces, and those with fever or respiratory symptoms should rest at home and limit outings. For the week of July 5–11, COVID-19 outpatient visits reached 2,811, a 34.4% increase WoW. Globally, positivity is rising; East Mediterranean shows a decline, while China, Hong Kong, Japan, South Korea, and Singapore report increases. Dominant global lineages are NB.1.8.1, with JN.1 and XFG also circulating.

triage.headline_ja: 台北ドームが『毒窟』に？ネットユーザー動揺『咳が出ている』―疾病管理署はすでに警告していた
triage.triage_reason: 台湾でのCOVID-19季節的増加とSNS上の懸念が報じられているが、重症度や医療体制への影響に関する情報が不足しており、通常の季節的流行の範囲内とみられるため継続監視が適切。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は台湾・台北ドームでのCOVID-19流行に対するSNS上の懸念と台湾CDCの警告。中国・香港・日本・韓国・シンガポールは世界的な感染増加傾向の一部として言及されているのみで、対象国リストのうち中国のみ具体的な増加傾向が記載されているため含めた。台湾・日本・韓国・香港・シンガポールは対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 新冠又来了_手机网易网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 is back - NetEase Mobile
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 rebounds in southern China as of 2026-07-20. China's CDC reports rising SARS-CoV-2 activity: the positive rate among influenza-like illness outpatients rose to 11.9% (July 6–12), up from 1.1% in April, 2.0% in May, and 6.4% in June. June nationwide saw 79,000 new lab-confirmed cases, with 130 severe cases and 1 death (in a patient with underlying conditions). The virus shows no major mutation; June sequences were Omicron NB.1.8.1 and sublineages, accounting for over 95%. Experts characterize COVID-19 as endemic with waves driven by waning immunity, antigenic drift, and behavioral factors like indoor air conditioning. WHO has monitored NB.1.8.1 since May 2025 and finds no evidence of greater severity. Mainland vaccines targeting NB.1.8.1 are unavailable; in Hong Kong, boosters using LP.8.1 provide strong protection, with high-risk groups offered vaccination every six months. Ordinary adults are advised to treat it like influenza and seek care if symptoms worsen.

triage.headline_ja: 新型コロナウイルスが再燃
triage.triage_reason: 中国でCOVID-19の季節的な再流行が報告されているが、変異株に大きな変化はなく重症度も低いため、現時点ではフルリスク評価には至らないが動向を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 中国CDCによる定例的なサーベイランス報告で、Omicron NB.1.8.1系統が主流。重症化率・死亡率は低く、WHOも重症度増加の証拠なしと評価。季節性の流行として想定内。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemija ebole u Africi. Umrlo je najmanje 930 ljudi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola epidemic in Africa. At least 930 people have died.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri Province) has killed at least 930 people and infected 2,344 confirmed cases, with 37 new deaths reported in the last 24 hours as of 2026-07-20. Declared May 15 in eastern Congo, it is the fastest-growing Ebola epidemic on record, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rarer strain with no approved vaccine or specific treatment. Security challenges in Ituri hinder field teams, including at least 12 attacks on health facilities and personnel since mid-May. Health workers have protested over unpaid wages, contributing to reduced staffing. The Ministry of Health reports 724 patients currently in isolation in hospitals and emphasizes intensified efforts in affected zones to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカでエボラ流行、死者少なくとも930人
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イツリ州で急速拡大するエボラ流行（死者930人、感染2344人）であり、ワクチン未承認株、治安悪化、医療者ストライキも重なり公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 史上最速拡大とされるエボラ流行で、承認ワクチン・治療法がないBundibugyo株が原因。治安問題や医療従事者の賃金未払いによるスタッフ不足が対応を阻害している。

article.articleHeadline: बिहार में कोरोना की दस्तक: 65 वर्षीय बुजुर्ग संक्रमित, दो डोज लेने के बाद भी रिपोर्ट पॉजिटिव; स्वास्थ्य विभाग अलर्ट
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 makes inroads in Bihar: 65-year-old man infected, still tests positive after two doses of the vaccine; Health Department on alert.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 re-emerges in Bhagalpur district, Bihar, with a 65-year-old man testing positive despite receiving two vaccine doses. The patient, resident of Lalu-chak, reported seven days of fever, cold, cough, weakness, and breathing difficulty, and was admitted to Myaganj Hospital (JLNMCH) ICU. Initial oxygen saturation 72% but gradually improving. Doctors say this is the year’s first case, with a sample sent for genome sequencing to identify the variant. Family members had visited in the preceding 15 days; authorities say no panic is warranted as infection rates are monitored. The hospital will re-confirm with RT-PCR in its own lab. Bhagalpur’s COVID-19 history includes the first case in April 2020, totaling about 29,580 infections and 366 deaths by July 2022. By August 31, 2022, more than 2.057 million people in Bhagalpur district had received vaccines with Covishield, Covaxin, or Covovax.

triage.headline_ja: ビハール州でコロナが再来：65歳男性が感染、2回接種後も陽性反応；保健当局が警戒
triage.triage_reason: 単発の重症例（1名）で今年最初の症例と報告されているが、地域的拡大や集団発生の証拠はなく、続報（ゲノム解析結果等）を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: COVID-19は既に世界的に流行が確立した疾患であり、単発の重症例報告のみで新規シグナルとしての重要性は低いが、地域の「今年初の症例」としてゲノム解析中であり、変異株の可能性を含め続報を注視する。

article.articleHeadline: Urgent: Ebola death toll in DR Congo exceeds 900
article.articleSummary: Headline reports Ebola death toll in DR Congo exceeding 900. The article body shifts to a Namibian event: on 17 July 2026, Katima Mulilo in the Zambezi Region hosted a one-day consultative meeting on the Namibia Space Science and Technology Bill, with National Steering Committee member Sepo Kamwayamunzi presenting at the Zambezi Regional Council auditorium. The published date is 2026-07-20. No clinical details, outbreak status, laboratory confirmation, infection source, or information on imported/exported cases for Ebola in DR Congo are provided in the body. The piece juxtaposes a major Ebola outbreak headline with a domestic policy briefing in Namibia, without an explicit link between the topics. Keywords: Ebola, DR Congo, Namibia, Katima Mulilo, Zambezi Region, Space Science and Technology Bill, July 2026, public health vs policy.

triage.headline_ja: 緊急：DRコンゴでのエボラ死者数が900人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 見出しでDRコンゴにおけるエボラ死者数900人超という重大な公衆衛生上の懸念が示されているが、本文はナミビアの政策会議に関する内容で裏付け情報が欠如しているため、続報確認とフルRRAでの検証が必要。
triage.notes: 見出しと本文の内容が一致しておらず、エボラに関する臨床的詳細・発生状況・確認情報が本文に一切記載されていない。記事の信頼性・最新性に疑問があり、DRコンゴでのエボラ流行状況について公式情報源での確認が必要。ナミビアのザンベジ地域（Zambezi Region）はナミビア国内の行政区であり、ザンビア（Zambia）とは無関係のため対象国リストには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: India approves its first dengue vaccine QDENGA after DCGI clearance
article.articleSummary: India's Drug Controller General has authorized Takeda's dengue vaccine QDENGA for ages 4–60, marking the country's first dengue vaccine approval. The shot is given as two 0.5 ml subcutaneous injections, three months apart, without required pre-vaccination dengue screening. Indian approval draws on Takeda's seven-year data showing protection against dengue infection and dengue-related hospitalisation for all four serotypes, based on 19 Phase I–III trials involving over 28,000 participants, including the Phase III DEN-302 study conducted in India. WHO recommends QDENGA for dengue-endemic regions and supports inclusion in public immunisation programs without pre-screening; QDENGA has WHO prequalification, enabling procurement by UNICEF and PAHO. India bears a large dengue burden with all four serotypes circulating in many areas; vaccination complements vector control, surveillance and public health measures. Since 2022, QDENGA has been approved in 43 countries with over 32 million doses distributed.

triage.headline_ja: インドがDCGIの承認を受け、初のデング熱ワクチン「QDENGA」を承認
triage.triage_reason: デング熱ワクチンの承認に関する政策・薬事ニュースであり、新規アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す内容ではないため、シグナルとして識別しない。
triage.notes: 本記事はワクチン承認に関する報道であり、デング熱の流行状況やアウトブレイクそのものを報じるものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Mosquito control measures to be carried out around Wynn Macau after guest with dengue fever recently stayed
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever case linked to a guest who stayed at Wynn Macau triggers mosquito-control operations around the Wynn Macau integrated resort in Macau. The Health Bureau, after receiving notification from mainland authorities about the visitor, will work with Wynn management in the coming days to implement control measures in the risk area surrounding the hotel. Control efforts target a 100-meter radius around known breeding sites corresponding to the Aedes mosquito activity zone. Dengue virus transmission occurs via bites from infected Aedes mosquitoes and is not transmitted directly between people; a mosquito that bites a dengue patient remains infectious for life. The initiative aims to reduce local mosquito populations and transmission risk in the hotel vicinity.

triage.headline_ja: ウィン・マカオに滞在した客がデング熱と判明、周辺で蚊駆除対策を実施
triage.triage_reason: ホテル宿泊客1名のデング熱輸入例に対する通常の蚊駆除対応であり、異常性・重大性・拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 単発の輸入例に対する現地保健当局主導の予防的蚊駆除措置であり、地域内発生拡大や社会的関心の高まりを示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Canada Defies UN Advice, Bans Visitors From Congo Amid Ebola Outbreak
article.articleSummary: Canada will deny entry to foreign nationals who have visited Congo in the past 21 days as a temporary border measure to curb Ebola transmission. The policy, effective July 20 at 11:59 p.m. EDT, contradicts WHO guidance that discourages travel or trade restrictions during Congo's large Ebola outbreak and warns such measures fuel stigma and hamper epidemic control. Ebola, primarily spread through direct contact with bodily fluids of the infected, has surged in Congo, with more than 2,100 cases and 828 deaths reported as of July 15. WHO says international spread risk is low. The U.S. has similarly restricted entry for Americans who have been in Congo in the previous 21 days. Seven American aid workers assisting Congo's outbreak response are quarantining in Kenya. Canada did not immediately comment beyond the PHAC statement.

triage.headline_ja: カナダはUNの勧告に反し、エボラ出血熱流行のコンゴからの入国者を禁止
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で2,100例超・828人死亡という大規模エボラ流行が継続しており、カナダ・米国がWHOの勧告に反して渡航制限を実施するなど国際的な対応・関心が高まっているため。
triage.notes: 米国・カナダ・ケニアは流行地ではなく、渡航制限措置や援助者隔離の対応国であるため、発生地域としてはDRCのみを検証済み地域とした。

article.articleHeadline: Gia Lai dựng lá chắn phòng bệnh lở mồm long móng chủng SAT-1
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Gia Lai builds a shield against the SAT-1 strain of foot-and-mouth disease.
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-mouth disease SAT-1 risk in Gia Lai, Vietnam, triggers urgent prevention measures by the provincial Department of Agriculture and Environment. SAT-1, historically Africa-based, has recently caused outbreaks in the Middle East and West Asia, with China reporting outbreaks since April 2026; Vietnam has not yet confirmed SAT-1 but faces high import risk via cross-border livestock and products. Domestic vaccines cover types O, A and Asia1, not SAT-1. Gia Lai, home to over 789,000 cattle and buffalo and more than 1.72 million pigs, is particularly vulnerable. Measures include accelerating the first 2026 vaccination round, enhanced surveillance, prompt reporting and testing of suspected cases, and strict handling of diseased animals. Authorities will tighten transport and trading controls, curb illicit animal movement, coordinate with border forces, and promote biosafety. Targeted sampling and gene sequencing will monitor high-risk zones and markets and update the animal disease information system.

triage.headline_ja: ザーライ省、口蹄疫SAT-1株の防疫体制を構築
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム（ザーライ省）ではSAT-1株の確定例はまだなく、中国での発生を踏まえた予防的措置の段階であるため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 本件は動物疾病（口蹄疫SAT-1株）であり、ヒトへの直接的な公衆衛生影響は確認されていない。中国での発生報告を受け、ベトナム・ザーライ省が予防的な監視・防疫措置を強化している段階。ヒト感染や国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報はなく、主に畜産・貿易分野への影響が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Canada: Áp dụng biện pháp kiểm soát phòng dịch Ebola mới tại biên giới
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Canada: Implement new Ebola prevention and control measures at the border.
article.articleSummary: Canada announced temporary border controls to curb Ebola importation. Starting July 20, foreign nationals who have resided in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) within the previous 21 days are barred from entering Canada. Canadians, permanent residents, and individuals registered under the Indian Act who have been in the DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan in the past 21 days may enter but must undergo arrival health screening and a 21-day quarantine. The measures, along with existing orders, run through August 29. PHAC reports no suspected Ebola-related entries in Canada to date. In the DRC, Ebola outbreaks exceed 2,000 infections with 798 deaths. Regional coordination efforts by Southern African Development Community (SADC) members, Africa CDC, and WHO are underway, with South Africa contributing about USD 5 million to Africa CDC and preparations discussed at a SADC summit in Malawi.

triage.headline_ja: カナダ:国境における新たなエボラ出血熱予防・管理措置を実施
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国(DRC)でのエボラ出血熱流行が2,000人超の感染・798人の死亡に達し、カナダが国境管理措置を実施するなど国際的な対応が進んでいるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCでのエボラ流行とそれに対するカナダの国境管理措置。ウガンダ・南スーダン・マラウイ・カナダ・南アフリカは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCの流行規模（2,000+感染、798死亡）が主要な公衆衛生上の懸念事項。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو الديمقراطية: ارتفاع إصابات فيروس إيبولا إلى 2344 حالة.. بينها 930 وفاة - بوابة الشروق
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo: Ebola virus infections rise to 2,344 cases, including 930 deaths - Shorouk Portal
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus infections in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have risen to 2,344 confirmed cases, with 930 deaths, as of July 18, according to Reuters. The World Health Organization warned the outbreak is spreading at a faster pace than any previous Ebola flare-up. Since the outbreak was declared about two months ago, more than 2,000 cases have been confirmed, including 796 deaths, making it the third-largest Ebola outbreak on record. The surge is driven by the rare Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no licensed vaccine or approved treatment. Despite intensified response efforts, WHO notes that over 80% of new infections are occurring among individuals not listed in known contact tracers, suggesting transmission chains remain untracked.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラウイルス感染者2,344人に増加、うち930人死亡 - シュルーク・ポータル
triage.triage_reason: WHOが過去最速の拡大ペースと警告する大規模エボラ流行で、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、社会的関心も高いためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: 希少なブンディブギョ株による流行で、承認済みワクチン・治療法が存在しない点、新規感染の80%超が既知の接触者リスト外で発生している点が特に懸念される。史上3番目の規模のエボラ流行とされる。

article.articleHeadline: Епидемија на ебола во Африка, најмалку 930 починати
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola epidemic in Africa, at least 930 dead.
article.articleSummary: Ebola epidemic in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has killed at least 930 people with 2,344 confirmed cases as of 2026-07-20. In the last 24 hours, 37 deaths were reported—among the highest daily tallies since the outbreak began on May 15. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain, a rare variant for which there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment. Security problems hinder field response in Ituri province, including at least 12 attacks on health facilities and teams since mid-May. Health workers have protested unpaid salaries, contributing to staffing shortages; at least 36 health workers have died. The Ministry of Health reports 724 patients currently in isolation or in hospital, as authorities intensify efforts to contain spread in affected zones.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカでエボラ出血熱が流行、死者少なくとも930人
triage.triage_reason: DRCイツリ州で承認済みワクチン・治療法のない稀な株（ブンディブギョ株）によるエボラ流行が拡大し、死者930人・確定例2344例に達しており、治安悪化と医療者不足が対応を阻害している重大事案。
triage.notes: ワクチン・治療薬未承認の稀な株、治安問題による対応困難、医療者の死亡・給与未払いによる人員不足など、国際支援が急務な状況。フルRRAへの移行を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Епидемија на ебола во Африка, најмалку 930 луѓе починаа
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Africa, at least 930 people have died.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Congo, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, is centered in eastern Congo with Ituri province hardest hit. As of 20 July 2026, at least 930 deaths and 2,344 confirmed cases have been reported. In the last 24 hours, 37 deaths were recorded—the highest daily toll since the outbreak began on May 15—marking it as the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak to date. The Bundibugyo virus has no approved vaccine or specific treatment. Security constraints in Ituri hinder field teams, with at least 12 attacks on health facilities and staff since mid-May. Health workers have protested due to unpaid salaries, and at least 36 healthcare workers have died from the disease. The Ministry of Health reports 724 patients currently in isolation or hospital and is intensifying efforts in affected zones to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカでエボラ流行、少なくとも930人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ東部でエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）が急速拡大し、死者930人・症例2,344人に達する重大な公衆衛生危機であり、ワクチン未承認・治安上の障害・医療従事者の死亡も報告されているため、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株のエボラ流行はこれまでで最も急速な拡大とされ、承認済みワクチン・治療薬が存在しない点、医療施設への攻撃や医療従事者の未払い問題など対応能力に重大な懸念がある。

article.articleHeadline: Congo's Ebola outbreak deaths mount to 930
article.articleSummary: Congo's Ebola outbreak in Ituri province continues to surge: 930 deaths among 2,344 confirmed cases as of Saturday, with 37 new deaths in the prior 24 hours. Declared May 15 in eastern Congo, the outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo virus, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment. Safety concerns have hampered response, with at least 12 attacks on health facilities and teams since mid-May and reports of health workers leaving due to nonpayment; 36 infected health workers have died. About 724 patients are in isolation in hospitals, as authorities intensify response efforts in affected health zones to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱、死者930人に達す
triage.triage_reason: DRCイツリ州でのエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）流行が拡大し、死者930人・確定例2344人に達し、承認済みワクチン・治療薬が存在せず、治安悪化により対応が阻害されている重大な公衆衛生危機。
triage.notes: 承認済みワクチン・治療薬がないブンディブギョ株による流行であり、医療施設への攻撃や医療従事者への未払いにより対応が困難化している。致死率が高く（約40%）、724人が隔離治療中。国際的な支援と監視の継続が必要。

article.articleHeadline: High blood sugar could make Dengue more dangerous for Type 2 diabetes patients, warn new study
article.articleSummary: Dengue poses a higher risk for people with Type 2 diabetes, especially when blood sugar is poorly controlled. New Delhi-based researchers say chronic hyperglycaemia weakens antiviral immune responses and damages blood vessels, increasing the likelihood of severe dengue manifestations such as dengue haemorrhagic fever, dengue shock syndrome and multi-organ involvement. Diabetes can reduce white blood cell effectiveness, raise chronic inflammation and oxidative stress, and promote vascular leakage, a key feature of severe dengue. Well-controlled blood glucose appears to lower risk, though studies vary; a 2024 review suggested HbA1c targets do not consistently predict severe dengue. Given rising dengue outbreaks in tropical regions, clinicians should monitor diabetic patients more closely, advise early medical care if symptoms appear, ensure hydration, and avoid self-medicating with NSAIDs like ibuprofen to reduce bleeding risk.

triage.headline_ja: 高血糖は2型糖尿病患者にとってデング熱をより危険にする可能性、新研究が警告
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は特定のアウトブレイクではなく、2型糖尿病患者におけるデング重症化リスクに関する研究レビューであり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や新規発生事象を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は研究知見の紹介であり、特定地域での具体的なデング熱発生・流行を報じるものではないため、地域検証の対象外と判断した。

article.articleHeadline: India Approves First Dengue Vaccine QDENGA For Ages 4-60, No Pre-Vaccination Tests Required
article.articleSummary: India grants market authorization to Takeda's QDENGA dengue vaccine for ages 4–60, enabling vaccination without pre-screening or prior infection testing. DCGI approval follows WHO recommendation and prequalification, and permits procurement via UNICEF/PAHO. QDENGA has been approved since 2022 in 43 countries with over 32 million doses distributed, and seven-year data show protection against dengue infection and dengue-related hospitalization across all four serotypes. Indian Phase III DEN-302 data, plus Takeda's global programme involving more than 28,000 participants, supported the decision. Four dengue serotypes circulate in India, and QDENGA provides protection regardless of prior exposure. Takeda plans India manufacturing expansion with Biological E to 50 million doses annually, contributing to a global target of 100 million doses per year by decade's end. Dengue cases in India have risen 11-fold over two decades, highlighting prevention needs as of 20 July 2026.

triage.headline_ja: インドがQDENGA デング熱ワクチンを4~60歳向けに初承認、接種前検査は不要
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はデングワクチンの承認・普及に関する規制ニュースであり、感染症の異常発生や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: デング熱の症例数増加自体は言及されているが、本記事の主題はワクチン承認であり、アウトブレイク情報ではないためDISMISSと判定。

article.articleHeadline: Canada bans foreigners who visited Congo in last 21 days over Ebola fears
article.articleSummary: Canada imposes new border rules barring foreign nationals who had visited the Democratic Republic of Congo within the previous 21 days from entering, effective July 20, 2026 at 11:59 p.m. EDT, in response to the Ebola outbreak ongoing in Congo. The Public Health Agency says the import ban aligns with measures in the United States and Mexico, despite WHO guidance advising against travel restrictions to Congo due to stigma and potential hindrance to outbreak response. The European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control cautions similar. Fines for non-compliance reach up to CAD 150,000 for individuals and CAD 1.5 million for corporations. Congo had reported over 2,100 Ebola cases and at least 828 deaths as of July 15; Ebola spreads mainly via direct contact with bodily fluids. The measure accompanies other border steps and follows reports of US aid workers quarantined in Kenya after Congo exposure.

triage.headline_ja: カナダ、エボラ感染懸念によりコンゴを過去21日以内に訪問した外国人の入国を禁止
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で2,100例超・828人死亡の大規模エボラアウトブレイクが継続し、複数国が渡航制限を実施するなど国際的な影響が明確であるため、IHR基準に複数該当しフルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: アウトブレイクの発生地はコンゴ民主共和国。カナダ・米国・メキシコは渡航制限措置を導入した国であり、発生国ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。ケニアでの米国人援助者隔離報道もあるが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。WHO及びECDCは渡航制限がスティグマや対応阻害につながる可能性を懸念している点も留意。

article.articleHeadline: Y tế Điện Biên giữ gìn môi trường, ngăn sốt rét trở lại
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dien Bien Department of Health safeguards the environment, preventing malaria from returning.
article.articleSummary: Malaria elimination is being safeguarded in Dien Bien Province, Vietnam, to prevent resurgence. From 2022 through 2025 the province reported zero new malaria cases, including domestic and imported infections. On 30 June 2025, the Central Institute of Malariology, Parasitology and Entomology issued Decision 685/QĐ-VSR recognizing Dien Bien as malaria-eliminated, marking a shift to maintenance, surveillance, and prevention of reintroduction. A 16 July conference mobilized resources for ongoing control, and the RA I4E project (2024–2026) will be implemented in Muong Toong, Muong Nhe, and Dien Bien Phu Ward. Key actions include sustaining microscopic networks to detect cases; providing monthly travel subsidies for 14 village health workers in hotspot areas; strengthening epidemiological surveillance from provincial to commune levels; and ensuring drug supply, rapid tests, insecticide-treated nets, and treated hammocks. Sustained local-government and community engagement remains crucial.

triage.headline_ja: ディエンビエン省保健局、環境保全でマラリア再流行を防止
triage.triage_reason: マラリア排除達成後の維持・監視活動を報じる内容であり、新規感染や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 本記事はマラリア排除達成後の維持管理・再流行防止策に関する内容であり、2022年以降新規感染例はゼロ。シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Is Omicron RF.5 more severe than other Covid strains in India? Here's what to know
article.articleSummary: Omicron RF.5 detected in Andhra Pradesh, India, with four positive samples from Kadapa district identified as RF.5 after genome sequencing at NIV Pune. As of 2026-07-20, Andhra Pradesh reports 16 active COVID-19 cases. Officials say there is no evidence that RF.5 causes more severe disease or higher hospitalization risk compared with circulating Omicron variants. RF.5 is a sub-lineage detected in Singapore and parts of Southeast Asia; ongoing genomic surveillance tracks its spread and any changes in transmissibility or severity. Symptoms reported align with other Omicron infections: fever, sore throat, cough, runny nose, headache, fatigue, and body aches. In response, the Andhra Pradesh government has intensified surveillance and preparedness: dedicated isolation wards, adequate oxygen, essential medicines, expanded testing, and continued sequencing of positive samples. Public urged not to panic; focus remains on monitoring rather than alarm.

triage.headline_ja: オミクロンRF.5はインドの他のCOVID株より重症度が高いのか？知っておくべきこと
triage.triage_reason: 新規オミクロン亜系統RF.5が検出されたが、症例数は少なく（活動性症例16件）、当局も重症度上昇の証拠なしと明言しており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大の懸念は現時点で認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はCOVID-19オミクロン亜系統RF.5に関するもので、ニパウイルスは疾患名タグに含まれるが本文に記載なし。シンガポールでも検出されているが対象国リストに含まれず、インドのみが主題国。地方自治体レベルでの監視強化のみで、国際的な懸念や重症化の証拠は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Kwilu : le paludisme fait 146 morts en six mois, la maladie désormais
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kwilu: Malaria has killed 146 people in six months, the disease henceforth.
article.articleSummary: Malaria outbreak in Kwilu province has caused 146 deaths among 387,874 cases in the first six months of the year, with all 24 health zones affected and both uncomplicated and severe forms reported, according to provincial Health Minister Robert Dinsodi. The village of Mukulubiala in Bulungu territory emerged as a critical hot-spot, where a June surge produced fever, abdominal pain and vomiting, yielding about ten deaths in a matter of days. Emergency field teams have stabilized the Bulungu sector, and Mukulubiala records 72 cases and 15 deaths (8 women, 7 men) to date, with no new cases or deaths since direct medical intervention began. Samples—5 water, 30 blood, 28 salt—have been sent to Kinshasa’s INRB for analysis to exclude other etiologies; results are pending. Authorities call for expanded distribution of insecticide-treated nets and anti-malarial inputs as the outbreak persists across Kwilu.

triage.headline_ja: クウィル州:マラリアで半年間に146人死亡、疾病は依然拡大
triage.triage_reason: DRCクウィル州で146人死亡・387,874例という大規模なマラリア流行が発生し、急激な集団死を伴う異常なクラスター（ムクルビアラ村）が確認され、他の病因を除外するための検体分析が進行中であるため、IHR基準を2つ以上満たす。
triage.notes: ムクルビアラ村での急激な死亡クラスター（数日で約10人死亡）は通常のマラリアの経過として非典型的であり、水・血液・塩のサンプルがキンシャサのINRBに送られ他の病因（コレラ等）を除外するための検査中である点に注意。結果判明まで続報を要する。

article.articleHeadline: Ебола односи животе у ДР Конго: Расте број потврђених случајева, преминуло 930 људи
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Claims Lives in DR Congo: Rising Number of Confirmed Cases; 930 People Have Died.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo: as of July 20, 2026, the country reports 2,344 confirmed Ebola cases and 930 deaths. The World Health Organization’s Executive Director for the Health Emergencies Programme, Chikwe Ihekweazu, says the true scale is at least two to four times higher than official counts, based on analysis and modeling. Outbreak response is hampered by a shortage of treatment centers and community resistance to stringent hygiene measures, Reuters reported via Tanjug. The report emphasizes that the real burden may be substantially undercounted, with no further laboratory-confirmed details or infection-source information provided in the article. The ongoing outbreak underscores a significant, undercounted burden in DR Congo and highlights the need for strengthened health-system capacity and public health measures to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがコンゴ民主共和国で命を奪う：確認例数が増加、930人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（確認例2,344人、死者930人、真の規模は過小評価の可能性）であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響とヒトーヒト感染のリスクからIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: WHOのIhekweazu氏は実際の感染規模が公式報告の2〜4倍に達する可能性を指摘。治療センターの不足や住民の衛生対策への抵抗が対応を妨げているとされる。

article.articleHeadline: Over 900 people dead in Congo's Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Eastern Congo is experiencing the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak on record, driven by Bundibugyo virus. Since the May 15 declaration in eastern Congo, 2,344 cases have been confirmed and at least 930 deaths reported, including 37 new deaths in the last 24 hours. About 724 patients are in isolation in hospitals as response efforts are intensified in affected health zones, notably Ituri province. Security concerns have hindered the response, with at least 12 attacks on health facilities and teams since mid-May. Health workers face dangerous conditions; at least 36 health workers infected have died, and many have walked off due to nonpayment. There is no approved vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo virus, complicating containment efforts in this outbreak. The situation underscores ongoing challenges in outbreak response and health-system resilience in the region.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行、死者900人超に
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ東部でブンディブギョウイルスによる過去最速拡大のエボラ流行が発生し、死者930人超・治療薬未承認・治安悪化により対応が困難な状況であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 承認済みワクチン・治療薬がないブンディブギョウイルス種による流行で、治安悪化により保健施設への攻撃や医療従事者の離脱が発生しており、対応が非常に困難な状況。過去最速の拡大速度とされ、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Ebola en RDC : 2 344 cas confirmés et 930 décès, la riposte s'intensifie dans cinq provinces | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | Ebola in the DRC: 2,344 confirmed cases and 930 deaths, the response intensifies in five provinces | mediacongo.net
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo spans five provinces—Haut-Uele, Ituri, Nord-Kivu, Sud-Kivu, and Tshopo—with intensified response including surveillance, patient care, and contact tracing to interrupt transmission. As of 20 July 2026, 2,344 laboratory-confirmed cases and 930 deaths (case fatality rate 39.7%) have been reported; 724 patients are hospitalized or in isolation, and 466 have recovered. The contact-tracing rate is 85.8%, a key metric for interrupting transmission. Ituri remains the epicenter, reporting 83 new confirmed cases and 22 new recoveries during the period. Sud-Kivu and Tshopo are stable, with no new health zones affected. Authorities urge vigilance, rapid reporting of suspected cases, and adherence to preventive measures to end the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱のコンゴ民主共和国流行：確定患者2,344例、死者930人、5州で対応強化

article.articleHeadline: India approves first dengue vaccine Qdenga for people aged 4-60
article.articleSummary: DCGI approves QDENGA, Takeda's tetravalent dengue vaccine, for dengue prevention in individuals aged 4–60 in India, marking the country’s first dengue vaccine approval. The subcutaneous 0.5 mL dose is given in a two-dose regimen 3 months apart, with no pre-vaccination testing required. WHO recommends use in endemic settings, and the vaccine holds WHO pre-qualification, enabling procurement via UNICEF and PAHO. India bears about one-third of global dengue, with 2025 reported cases over 113,000 and modelling suggesting tens of millions infected annually. QDENGA is approved in 43 countries and has distributed over 32 million doses, including Brazil’s National Immunisation Programme and public provision in Argentina, Colombia, and Indonesia. The development program spans 19 trials (28,000+ participants); 12-month efficacy against virologically confirmed dengue is 80.2%, 18-month efficacy against dengue-related hospitalization is 90.4%, and 4.5-year hospitalization protection is 84.1%.

article.articleHeadline: India Gets Its First Approved Dengue Vaccine: Takeda's QDENGA Gets Drug Regulator Nod As Cases Surge 11-Fold In Two Decades
article.articleSummary: India becomes the first country to approve Takeda's QDENGA dengue vaccine, with regulatory clearance in July 2026 as dengue cases in India have surged 11-fold over two decades and the country accounts for about one-third of the global dengue burden. Outbreaks peak during and after the monsoon, stressing hospitals. QDENGA is a tetravalent live-attenuated vaccine designed to protect against all four dengue serotypes, addressing the risk that infection with different serotypes can lead to severe disease. Since its global launch in 2022, QDENGA has approvals in 43 countries and more than 32 million doses distributed; long-term follow-up shows sustained protection against symptomatic dengue and dengue-related hospitalization. Takeda, with Biological E in 2024, plans 50 million doses annually in India and 100 million globally by decade's end. Wider rollout will depend on price, immunisation recommendations, and integration into prevention strategies; scale-up could strengthen India's dengue control.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 Outbreak Again? May Not Have a Fever! Doctor: Six Symptoms Appear, Don’t Hesitate—Seek Medical Attention Immediately.
article.articleSummary: As of June 2026, China CDC reports 79,000 new COVID-19 cases, with influenza-like SARS-CoV-2 positivity rising from 2.9% to 6.4% over four weeks, signaling a summer uptick. Notably, many infections now occur without fever, enabling silent spread as people continue daily routines. Most patients have temperatures below 38°C or no fever; symptoms include sore throat, fatigue, muscle aches, and gastrointestinal issues, with only mild impact on smell or taste. This wave is driven by Omicron NB.1.8.1, which favors upper respiratory infection; severe disease concentrates in older adults, those with chronic conditions, and the unvaccinated. Immunity from prior infection or vaccination tends to lessen symptoms but reinfection can occur. Six warning signals merit urgent care: persistent sore throat, unexplained fatigue, myalgia, GI symptoms, subtle smell/taste changes, and elderly behavioral changes. Also watch for silent hypoxia; SpO2 90–95% warrants caution, <90% immediate care. Public health: ventilation, hand hygiene, masking; avoid overdisinfection or lockdown. High-risk groups: elderly, pregnant, infants, chronic disease, immunocompromised.

article.articleHeadline: Cả nhà nhiễm ký sinh trùng chó mèo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Whole Family Infected with Dog and Cat Parasites.
article.articleSummary: July 20, 2026, Hanoi, Vietnam – A family of three (Lan, 38; husband 42; daughter 9) presented with fatigue, abdominal discomfort, and intermittent itching. They have kept a cat for eight years. Tests confirmed Toxocara infection (roundworms) with eosinophilia and positive stool tests. Dr. Le Xuan Luat notes that close contact with pets—especially sharing a bed—without routine deworming and good hygiene increases exposure risk. Toxocara eggs shed by dogs and cats contaminate soil, dust, surfaces, and fur; humans acquire infection by ingesting eggs and may be asymptomatic or have fatigue, abdominal pain, digestive disturbance, and itching, with larvae potentially migrating to liver, lungs, or eyes causing organ damage. The family was treated and stable after three months; they will keep the cat but deworm pets regularly, clean living areas, wash hands, and avoid cats sleeping on the bed. Other pet-linked risks include fungal infections, Bartonella cat scratch disease, and rabies.

article.articleSummary: India approves QDENGA (TAK-003), a live-attenuated tetravalent dengue vaccine for ages 4-60, targeting all four serotypes (DENV-1 to DENV-4). It requires no pre-vaccination screening and is administered as two subcutaneous doses 3 months apart. triage.triage_reason: 本記事はデング熱ワクチンの承認・製品情報に関するニュースであり、新規の異常な感染拡大やアウトブレイクを報じるものではない。既知の流行状況（インドでの症例数）への言及はあるが、シグナルとして扱うべき新規性・異常性は認められない。
