triage.notes: 記事自体は地域コミュニティによる対応支援活動に関する内容だが、背景にあるベニでの進行中のエボラ出血熱流行は既知の重大な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、続報および現状のアウトブレイク規模の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 'Ebola ambulante': por que o surto no Congo é tão difícil de conter
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 'Ambulant Ebola': why the Congo outbreak is so hard to contain.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus (Bundibugyo strain) drives an 'ambulant Ebola' pattern in the Democratic Republic of the Congo outbreak, where patients become ill enough to transmit the virus but remain mobile, facilitating community spread. Virologist Corri Levine, whose PhD work focused on Bundibugyo, observed that this strain replicates more slowly than Zaire ebolavirus, the lineage behind the West Africa epidemic a decade earlier. The slower disease progression means symptoms may be present without disabling illness, creating a longer window for detection and intervention. Early antiviral treatment offers a better chance of altering outcomes before viral loads reach septic shock and multi-organ failure. Levine’s insights come from laboratory work at the University of Texas Medical Branch in a BSL-4 facility, underscoring that earlier, timely treatment could improve survival and help curb transmission in the Congo outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: 「歩行性エボラ」：コンゴでの流行がなぜこんなに封じ込めが難しいのか
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）によるDRCの進行中の流行であり、IHR基準の4項目全てに該当する可能性が高く、WPROスクリーニング基準の複数項目を満たす。
triage.notes: DRCでのエボラ流行は進行中で、Bundibugyo ebolavirus（Bundibugyo株）による「歩行性エボラ」パターンが特徴。患者が移動可能なまま感染性を保つため、コミュニティ内での拡散が促進される。テキサス州はBSL-4施設での研究機関の言及のみで、実際のイベント発生地ではないため除外。アンゴラも発生地域リストに含まれるが、記事サマリーで言及されていないため除外。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak grows in DR Congo as confirmed cases reach 2,344
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) continues to expand, with 2,344 laboratory-confirmed infections reported; 930 deaths as of July 18, per local authorities cited by Reuters. The Bundibugyo strain is driving the surge and is spreading at the fastest pace recorded for this variant. WHO warned earlier this month that many newly confirmed infections are linked to previously unidentified transmission chains, complicating containment. No details on imported or exported cases are provided. Laboratory confirmation underpins the case counts; the infection source is linked to untraced transmission chains. Time markers: death toll updated July 18; reporting date July 20. These developments underscore a rapidly evolving outbreak and the need for intensified surveillance and control measures.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の発生が拡大、確認例2,344人に
triage.triage_reason: 確認感染者2,344人・死者930人と規模が大きく、未追跡の感染連鎖により拡大が続いているため、国際的拡大リスクを含むIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株による過去最速の拡大とされ、WHOが未確認の感染連鎖を警告している。渡航・貿易制限に関する明確な記述はないため不明とした。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : le bilan à la mi-juillet, où le virus circule, et comment se protéger sans céder aux rumeurs
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: the mid-July update, where the virus is circulating, and how to protect yourself without giving in to rumors.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo remains real and fastest-spreading to date. As of July 18, 2026, the official count is 2,344 confirmed cases and 930 deaths, with a case fatality around 37–40%. Five provinces are affected: Ituri (epicenter, including Djugu and Mongbwalu), Nord-Kivu, Sud-Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo; a first case has been detected in Mahagi. The outbreak is due to Bundibugyo Ebola virus; there is no vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo, unlike Zaïre-linked candidates. The response includes decentralised testing (16 labs), about 80% contact tracing, treatment centers, and safe burials, though health workers (>100) have been infected and funding is limited amid displacement and cross-border movement. Prevention focuses on hand hygiene, avoiding contact with bodily fluids, reporting deaths for safe burial, and seeking prompt care for fever, fatigue, muscle pains, vomiting, diarrhea, rash, or bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：7月中旬の状況報告、ウイルスの流行地域、そして流言に流されずに身を守る方法
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部で確認例2,344人、死者930人（致死率37-40%）に達する史上最速拡大のエボラ流行（ブンディブジョ株、ワクチンなし）が5州に拡大しており、医療従事者感染や資金不足も報告されているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ブンディブジョ株によるエボラ流行で特効薬・ワクチンがなく、致死率が高い。国境を越えた人口移動や避難民の存在から地域拡大のリスクが高く、資金不足により国際支援が必要な状況。

article.articleHeadline: ফের বাংলায় করোনার থাবা! আক্রান্ত নাবালক-সহ মোট ৪
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Coronavirus strikes Bengal again! Four in total, including an infected minor.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 strikes West Bengal again, four cases total, after an earlier spike in Andhra Pradesh. Three patients are admitted in a private hospital in Kolkata, and one adolescent is hospitalized in another facility. All present with fever, shortness of breath, sore throat and severe cough. Medical experts warn against self-medication with antibiotics, which offer no benefit for viral infections and can drive antibiotic resistance; antibiotics may be used only if a secondary bacterial infection develops during the illness. Dr. Shubjit Sen, a pulmonary diseases expert at Fortis Hospital, stresses home fever/cough warrants prompt medical advice and avoidance of self-prescribing antibiotics. To assess suspected COVID-19, an Upper Respiratory BioFire panel test is used and can identify SARS-CoV-2 along with influenza, rhinovirus, and adenovirus. Among the patients is an 11-year-old child; officials note monsoon season boosts viral circulation, with rising COVID-19 and adenovirus activity.

triage.headline_ja: コロナウイルスが再びベンガルを直撃！未成年者を含む合計4人が感染
triage.triage_reason: 西ベンガル州で4例のCOVID-19が報告されているが、いずれも軽症〜中等度で入院管理下にあり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常性、国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: COVID-19は既知の疾患であり季節性の変動範囲内。モンスーン季にウイルス性疾患（アデノウイルス含む）が増加する旨の一般的注意喚起記事で、危機的状況を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de Ébola na República Democrática do Congo torna-se a epidemia mais rápida de sempre
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo Becomes the Fastest Outbreak on Record
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), caused by the Bundibugyo variant, is the fastest on record. Since it was declared on May 15, the death toll has reached at least 930, with 2,344 confirmed cases reported. In the latest period, 37 deaths were tallied, among the largest daily increases. The WHO warned that roughly 80% of new infections occur in unknown transmission chains, signaling widespread community spread beyond traceable contacts. Over two months, the country has averaged 272 new cases and 111 deaths per week, with July showing accelerated growth. Currently, 724 patients remain hospitalized or in isolation. Security concerns in Ituri province—armed attacks on health teams and misinformation—have hampered the response, with at least 12 attacks since May and 36 health workers dead. Transmission occurs from wildlife to humans and between people via bodily fluids and contaminated surfaces; no vaccine or approved treatment exists for Bundibugyo.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク、史上最速の流行に
triage.triage_reason: エボラ（バンディブギョ株）による大規模流行で死者930人以上、感染経路不明の伝播が80%を占め、ヒト-ヒト感染と国際的拡大リスクが高いためフルRRA対象とする。
triage.notes: 武装勢力による医療従事者への攻撃・誤情報が対応を妨げており、ワクチン・承認治療薬が存在しないバンディブギョ株であることも重大なリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: Prefeitura de Leopoldina Promove Bota-Fora Contra a Dengue no Bairro São Cristóvão
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Leopoldina City Hall Promotes a Bota-Fora Cleanup to Combat Dengue in the São Cristóvão Neighborhood.
article.articleSummary: Dengue prevention drive in Leopoldina, Minas Gerais, Brazil: On Saturday, July 18, 2026, the city’s Health Secretariat organized a Bota-fora cleanup in the São Cristóvão neighborhood to eliminate materials that can serve as Aedes aegypti breeding sites, the vector for dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. Endemics Sector teams collected unusable items—old furniture, plastic containers, tires, and other water-holding debris—and conducted door-to-door guidance on keeping yards and residences free of mosquito habitats. The operation is part of broader municipal measures to reduce mosquito infestation and raise community awareness about prevention. The report underscores shared responsibility and practical steps—eliminating water-collecting objects and maintaining clean environments—to support ongoing vector control across Leopoldina. No specific dengue case data are provided in the article.

triage.headline_ja: レオポルディナ市役所、サン・クリストヴァオ地区でデング熱対策の一斉清掃活動を実施
triage.triage_reason: デング熱等の予防を目的とした通常の地域清掃・広報活動であり、症例データも報告されておらず、公衆衛生上の異常事態を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は自治体による日常的なデング熱予防・清掃活動の広報であり、具体的な感染者数や流行拡大の情報はない。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれるが、通常の予防活動であるため危機的なシグナルとは判断しない。

article.articleHeadline: A deadly Ebola crisis is accelerating -- and health workers face mounting obstacles
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak centered in Bunia, Ituri province, has reached 2,344 confirmed cases and 930 deaths as of Saturday, July 18, 2026, with 37 more deaths reported in the last 24 hours. The Bundibugyo strain, a less common variant, has no approved vaccine or specific treatment, complicating containment. The crisis is described as the fastest-growing Ebola epidemic in the country. Insecurity and attacks on health facilities and response teams, coupled with staffing shortages and unpaid workers, hinder outbreak response. Dozens of frontline healthcare workers have died from infection while treating patients. More than 700 patients remain in isolation or under hospital care as teams conduct contact tracing and care. International health officials warn many new infections cannot be linked to known transmission chains, signaling ongoing challenges in transmission containment.

triage.headline_ja: 致死的なエボラ危機が加速──医療従事者は増大する障害に直面
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で2,344例・930名死亡に達し急速に拡大するエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)流行であり、ワクチン・治療法未承認、治安悪化、感染経路不明な新規感染例の存在等からIHR基準・WPRO基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株には承認済みワクチン・特効薬がなく、治安不安と医療従事者への攻撃が対応を妨げている。感染経路不明の新規感染例が報告されており、ヒト-ヒト感染の継続リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : 6 guéris quittent le centre de traitement à Nia-nia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: 6 recovered leave the treatment center at Nia-Nia.
article.articleSummary: Six people, including two healthcare workers, were declared cured on Friday, July 17, and discharged from the Ebola treatment center in Nia-Nia, Bandaka Chiefdom, Mambasa Territory, Ituri Province. The Nia-Nia General Reference Hospital had admitted about twenty Ebola patients; among the cured is the medical director of the Djuhudi reference health center, who was in critical condition. Dr. Joseph Pemanakuwe, zone medical chief, welcomed the recoveries and urged affected communities to seek care promptly at nearby facilities to ensure proper treatment. Recovered patients thanked staff for free medical and nutritional care during roughly a month of treatment. The recoveries underscore the government’s commitment, via the Ministry of Public Health and Social Welfare, to ending the 17th Bundibugyo-strain Ebola outbreak in Ituri and North Kivu.

triage.headline_ja: イツリ州エボラ：ニアニア治療センターから治癒者6名が退院
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（第17次流行、ブンディブジョ株）はIHR Annex2上常に通知対象となる疾患であり、致死率が高く国際的拡大・渡航制限のリスクも伴うため、継続中の進行状況としてフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事は治癒者の退院という好転情報だが、第17次エボラ流行（イツリ・北キブ州）が継続中であることを示す。既存アウトブレイクの経過情報としてWATCHまたはPICKUPの継続的モニタリングが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Ébola : le Canada ferme ses frontières aux voyageurs ayant séjourné en RDC face à une épidémie qui progresse rapidement | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | Ebola: Canada closes its borders to travelers who have stayed in the DRC amid an epidemic that is spreading rapidly | mediacongo.net
article.articleSummary: Canada tightened border controls amid a rapidly spreading Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), driven by the Bundibugyo strain and centered in Ituri Province. Foreign nationals who have stayed in the DRC within the past 21 days are barred from entering Canada, effective July 20, 2026 at 23:59, with no duration or explicit exceptions announced. The measure aims to reduce importation risk and strengthen frontline screening, including for humanitarian workers returning from DRC missions. The outbreak was declared two months ago and has progressed quickly, with the World Health Organization reporting 2,003 cases and 796 deaths. In the DRC, authorities continue surveillance, patient care, and efforts to contain transmission as the outbreak accelerates, which WHO notes is faster than the 2019 outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：カナダがコンゴ民主共和国滞在歴のある渡航者に対して国境を閉鎖、急速に拡大する流行に対応
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで急速に拡大し（2,003例・796死亡、2019年流行より速い進行）、カナダが渡航制限措置を導入するなど国際的な対応が生じており、IHR基準の複数該当とスクリーニング基準も満たすためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: カナダは流行発生地ではなく渡航制限措置を実施した国であるため、verified_locationsには含めない（対象国リストにも含まれない）。致死率が高く（約40%）、2019年流行より進行が速い点は重大な懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Death toll crosses 900 as Ebola infections surge in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo persists with 2,344 confirmed cases and 930 deaths (case fatality 39.7%) as of 20 July 2026, with 724 patients in isolation or hospital and 466 recoveries. Five provinces are affected: Haut-Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, and Tshopo; Ituri remains the epicenter with sustained transmission. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo virus strain. Contact tracing stands at 85.8%. The outbreak was declared on May 15. Frontline responders, health authorities and partners continue coordinated efforts, with Africa CDC expressing cautious optimism that the curve may bend in coming weeks to months.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ感染拡大、死者数が900人を超える
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で確定2,344例・死亡930例（致死率39.7%）に達する大規模エボラ流行が継続しており、複数州にまたがる持続的なヒト-ヒト感染がみられるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナルである。
triage.notes: Bundibugyoウイルス株によるエボラ流行。5月15日に発生宣言、Ituriが震源地として持続的な感染拡大中。Africa CDCは今後数週間から数ヶ月で流行が収束に向かう可能性に慎重な楽観を示しているが、致死率が高く継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Número de casos de ebola dispara; mais de 800 pessoas já morreram e este número pode subir nos próximos dias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of Ebola cases surges; more than 800 people have already died, and this number could rise in the coming days.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) worsens, with 2,267 confirmed cases and 893 deaths reported in the latest bulletin, including 86 new cases and 29 deaths in the prior 24 hours. The epidemic centers in the DRC and Uganda, driven by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment. The World Health Organization has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern as conflicts in affected regions hinder testing, care, and rapid response. Canada will bar entry of foreigners who have been in the DRC in the past 21 days, mirroring U.S. restrictions; seven U.S. humanitarian workers remain quarantined in Kenya. A second U.S. patient in Germany is responding to treatment; the first was discharged in June. WHO recommends against travel or trade bans to avoid stigmatization and aid outbreak control.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ患者数が急増、死者800人超、今後も増加の可能性
triage.triage_reason: DRC・ウガンダでのエボラ流行が拡大し、WHOがPHEICを宣言、複数国が渡航制限を実施するなど国際的関心と拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。米国・カナダ・ドイツ・ケニアは渡航制限や治療関連の記載のみで発生国ではない。

article.articleHeadline: OKO 3000 SLUČAJEVA GODIŠNJE Mislili li ste da je više nema? Varate se, kuga i dalje postoji, iznenadit ćete se gdje
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Approximately 3,000 cases per year. Did you think there were none left? You're mistaken—the plague still exists, and you'll be surprised where.
article.articleSummary: Worldwide, plague (Yersinia pestis) causes about 3,000 cases annually, with the Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda, and Madagascar as current hotspots; Madagascar endured a major outbreak in 2017, averaging 250–500 infections per year. Occasional cases occur in western USA, while Europe last reported a case in 1945 on Corsica. Plague remains a deadly zoonosis, with rodent reservoirs and fleas as vectors, presenting in bubonic (painful swollen lymph nodes), septicemic, and pneumonic forms (airborne and capable of human-to-human spread). Bacterial virulence has evolved, notably the ymt gene enabling flea transmission, though early strains lacked it. Transmission occurs via flea bites or contact with infected animals; diagnosis in Europe is challenged by low clinical suspicion. A Oregon case, Paul Gaylord, initially thought to have flu or cat-scratch disease, underscores how plague can mimic common illnesses and progress to severe illness without treatment.

triage.headline_ja: 年間約3000件の症例。もう存在しないと思っていましたか？それは誤りです。ペストは今も存在しており、どこで発生しているか驚くでしょう。
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はペストに関する一般的な解説・啓発記事であり、特定の新規アウトブレイクを報じるものではないため、シグナルとしての緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はペストの世界的な流行状況に関する教育的・解説的な内容で、コンゴ民主共和国、ウガンダ、マダガスカルが常在地として言及されているが、新規の急性アウトブレイクを報告するものではない。米国オレゴン州の個別症例（Paul Gaylord氏）も既知の風土病的発生であり、緊急性を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Especialista alerta para importância da testagem e diagnóstico precoce das hepatites virais no Norte
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Specialist warns about the importance of testing and early diagnosis of viral hepatitis in the North.
article.articleSummary: North Region of Brazil bears one of the highest burdens of viral hepatitis, with Hepatitis B and Delta dominating the area, especially in the Amazon. Rondônia, Acre and Amazonas are among the states with the highest Hepatitis B incidence; Hepatitis Delta, which only occurs in people already infected with Hepatitis B, accounts for more than 70% of regional cases. Diagnosis is often late, as chronic Hepatitis B and C can be entirely silent for years, risking progression to cirrhosis and liver cancer. During July's Yellow awareness month, experts emphasize that viral hepatitis symptoms are not guaranteed early; universal screening is recommended for all adults 18 and older at least once in life. Transmission occurs via shared sharp objects; casual contact does not spread the viruses. Vaccination against Hepatitis A and B is available in SUS; Hepatitis B vaccination indirectly protects against Delta.

triage.headline_ja: 専門家がブラジル北部地域におけるウイルス性肝炎の検査と早期診断の重要性を訴える
triage.triage_reason: 既知の慢性B型・デルタ型肝炎の疫学状況に関する啓発記事であり、急性の公衆衛生上の異常事態や新規アウトブレイクではないため。
triage.notes: 記事は啓発キャンペーン（7月の肝炎啓発月間）に関するもので、慢性肝炎の既知の地域的流行状況の説明であり、新規のシグナルとは言えない。

article.articleHeadline: كندا تمنع دخول القادمين من الكونغو خلال 21 يوما لمواجهة تفشي الإيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Canada bars entry of travelers arriving from the Congo for 21 days to confront the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Canada imposes a 21-day entry ban on foreigners who have visited the Republic of the Congo within the prior 21 days to curb the Ebola outbreak, effective 11:59 p.m. ET on July 20. WHO cautions against travel or trade restrictions, citing stigma and noting Ebola spread is not linked to nationality or race, with international risk considered low. Ebola primarily transmits via contact with bodily fluids. As of July 15, the Congo reported more than 2,100 cases and 828 deaths. Canada had previously suspended visa issuance for residents from Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan, with no confirmed South Sudan cases and Uganda’s new infections having halted last month. Penalties for violations can reach CAD 150,000 for individuals and CAD 1.5 million for companies. The United States imposed similar 21-day entry limits after Congo travel, with seven American aid workers quarantined in Kenya.

triage.headline_ja: カナダ、コンゴからの入国者を21日間禁止しエボラ流行に対応
triage.triage_reason: DRCで2,100例超・828人死亡のエボラ流行が拡大し、カナダ・米国が入国制限を実施するなど国際的な対応が進んでおり、IHR基準の複数（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限）に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事では『Republic of the Congo』と表記されているが、症例数（2,100例超、828人死亡）はDRCの現行エボラ流行を指す。米国・カナダ・ウガンダ・南スーダン・ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Lubero : 15 cas confirmés d'Ebola dont 9 décès Musienene
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lubero: 15 confirmed Ebola cases, including 9 deaths in Musienene.
article.articleSummary: 15 laboratory-confirmed Ebola virus disease cases, including 9 deaths, were reported in the Musienene health zone, Lubero, North Kivu, with samples sent to Beni and confirmed as Bundibugyo strain. Cases are distributed across five health areas: Nduko (8), Vikindwe (3), Ivatama (2), Katolo (1) and Kyambogho (1). Of the 9 deaths, 5 occurred in Nduko, 2 in Vikindwe, 1 in Katolo and 1 in Ivatama. A provincial update dated July 17 noted 7 new confirmed cases in Katwa (5) and Butembo (2). As of 18 July 2026, Nord-Kivu totals stood at 213 confirmed cases and 142 deaths (case fatality 66.7%), with 36 recoveries, 25 active cases and 10 displaced or escaped patients. Katwa remains the most affected zone (93/62), followed by Butembo (46/31) and Beni (36/27); 11 of 34 zones are affected. 3,009 active contacts, 2,618 followed in the last day (87%). Calls for government action, provision of prevention kits, adherence to barrier measures, and intensified community engagement to counter misinformation and encourage treatment-seeking.

triage.headline_ja: ルベロ：ムシエネネで15例のエボラ確定例、うち9名死亡
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国北キブ州で継続中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（症例致死率66.7%）に関する新規確定例報告であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にウガンダ（Republic of Uganda）が含まれているが、記事サマリー内ではウガンダでの発症は言及されておらず、地理的近接性による誤付与と判断し除外した。北キブ州全体で213例確定・142名死亡・CFR66.7%と非常に深刻な状況が継続中。

article.articleHeadline: India's Cockroach party supporters swarm the streets, Houthis declare naval blockade on Saudi Arabia, US aid workers quarantine at Ebola treatment center in Kenya
article.articleSummary: Seven American aid workers who responded to the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo are quarantining at a controversial US-run Ebola treatment center in Kenya. They are described as asymptomatic and exposed to Ebola. The Kenyan center has faced protests accusing the US of offloading health risks onto Kenya; a Kenyan court ordered construction halted last month, though work reportedly continued. Kenya has reported no Ebola cases outside these seven Americans. The situation underscores debates over foreign-led outbreak responses and cross-border health security amid the DRC Ebola outbreak. Locals oppose the facility, arguing it offloads health risks onto Kenya. Public health concerns persist.

triage.headline_ja: インドの『コックローチ党』支持者がデモ、フーシ派がサウジアラビア海上封鎖を宣言、米国人援助従事者がケニアのエボラ治療センターで検疫
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ流行に関連し、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響と国境を越えた対応（米国人援助者のケニアでの検疫）が確認されており、IHR基準2つ以上に該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はケニアで検疫中の米国人援助者だが、感染発生国はDRCであり、ケニアでは感染確認例なし（曝露した無症状者のみ）。米国・ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCのエボラ流行自体は既知の継続イベントである可能性があり、続報での重症度・感染拡大状況の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola death toll in DRC surges to at least 930 as outbreak gathers pace
article.articleSummary: Ebola death toll in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has reached at least 930, with 2,344 confirmed cases; 37 deaths occurred in 24 hours from Friday, one of the largest daily increases since the outbreak began on May 15. The DRC's 17th Ebola outbreak is spreading faster than ever; WHO said it took two months to reach 2,000 confirmed cases, and the true tally could be at least double. It is now the third-largest Ebola outbreak on record. First detected after deaths in Ituri's Bunia area, cases have appeared in five DRC provinces and neighboring Uganda, though Uganda is nearing virus-free status. Transmission is via close contact and infected bodily fluids. More than 80% of new cases are outside known contact lists, indicating missed transmission chains. In isolation, 724 patients; 22 recoveries in 24 hours; response efforts intensified. Bunia General Hospital was blocked by striking staff over compensation.,

triage.headline_ja: DRCのエボラ死者数、少なくとも930人に急増 ― アウトブレイクが加速
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上3番目に大きいエボラ流行が急速に拡大しており、死者930人・確認例2344人、感染経路不明の新規例が80%超と国際的拡大・公衆衛生への深刻な影響が明確でIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ウガンダにも感染例があるが、記事ではウガンダはほぼウイルス消失状態と記載されており対象国リストにウガンダは含まれないため除外。DRCが主要発生国として明記されている。

article.articleHeadline: Κονγκό: Δεκάδες υγειονομικοί μεταξύ των 930 που έχουν πεθάνει από Έμπολα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo: Dozens of healthcare workers among the 930 who have died from Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri province, among five eastern provinces) has at least 930 deaths and 2,344 confirmed Ebola cases as of Saturday. From Friday to Saturday, 37 new deaths were recorded in 24 hours, one of the highest daily tallies. The Bundibugyo strain is responsible; there is no approved vaccine or treatment. Ebola is highly transmissible, spreading from wildlife to humans and then via contact with bodily fluids and contaminated surfaces. Security concerns limit response in Ituri, with ongoing armed clashes in a heavily affected region. Since May, at least 12 attacks on health facilities; many health workers have left over delayed pay. At least 36 healthcare workers have died from infection. WHO warns 80% of new cases come from unknown transmission chains, signaling faster spread. Currently 724 patients are hospitalized or in isolation, with 22 new recoveries in 24 hours.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ:エボラで死亡した930人の中に数十人の医療従事者
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部で930人死亡・2344人感染確認のエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)大規模流行が継続し、承認済みワクチン・治療法がなく、治安悪化により対応が制限されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 承認済みワクチン・治療薬が存在しないブンディブギョ株による大規模流行。治安上の問題（医療施設への攻撃、医療従事者の離脱）が対応を阻害しており、WHOは新規感染の80%が感染経路不明であると警告。フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Karnataka govt. monitoring epidemic diseases
article.articleSummary: As of July 20, 2026, Karnataka is actively monitoring epidemic diseases—malaria, dengue, and COVID-19—with strict vigilance on Ebola. Passenger screening from African countries, including Congo and Uganda, is ongoing, with about 150 travelers completing a 21-day quarantine; no Ebola cases reported in Karnataka. The state is also guarding border districts adjoining Andhra Pradesh and Telangana against possible COVID-19 transmission. Officials note the total epidemic-disease burden is lower this year versus the same period last year. Malaria cases have fallen by 70% and dengue by 33%, and there have been no COVID-19–related deaths since January. To strengthen primary care, doctors are being hired on contract for PHCs in Kodagu, Chikkamagaluru, and Chamarajanagar, while drug stock levels across the state were reported satisfactory. Minister U.T. Khader chaired the department review.

triage.headline_ja: カルナタカ州政府、流行性疾患を監視中
triage.triage_reason: エボラは国内発生ゼロで検疫継続中、マラリア・デング熱・COVID-19も前年比で減少しており、通常の行政監視活動の範囲内であるため。
triage.notes: エボラは疑い例・確定例ともに報告なし。コンゴ・ウガンダからの渡航者に対する検疫措置が行われているのみで、コンゴ・ウガンダでの感染発生を示す記述はない。マラリア・デング熱・COVID-19は前年より状況改善。ルーチンの行政報告に近い内容。

article.articleHeadline: Nevarna gonoreja se širi po Evropi, antibiotiki izgubljajo moč - Svet24.si
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dangerous gonorrhea is spreading across Europe, antibiotics are losing their effectiveness.
article.articleSummary: Antibiotic-resistant gonorrhea is spreading across Europe, with France, Germany, Sweden, and the United Kingdom reporting rising locally transmitted cases, according to the European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC). Previously linked to travel, resistant Neisseria gonorrhoeae infections are increasingly spreading within communities; the overall risk to the general population remains low, but risk is higher for people with multiple partners or unprotected sex with new partners, and travelers to areas with resistant strains. Treatments—ceftriaxone, or ceftriaxone plus azithromycin—are becoming less effective as strains resist both drugs, threatening outbreak control. Most resistant strains entering Europe still originate in Southeast Asia (Cambodia, Indonesia, Thailand, Vietnam), though domestic transmission is rising. In 2024, 106,331 gonorrhea cases were confirmed in the EU since 2009; globally, about 82 million new infections occur annually. Surveillance may underestimate spread due to testing and reporting variations.

triage.headline_ja: 危険な淋病がヨーロッパ全土に拡大、抗生物質の効果が低下
triage.triage_reason: ECDCが報告する薬剤耐性淋菌（Neisseria gonorrhoeae）が欧州複数国（仏・独・スウェーデン・英）で地域内感染として拡大しており、治療薬の効果低下という公衆衛生上の懸念が生じているため。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は欧州（仏・独・スウェーデン・英）における薬剤耐性淋病の拡大であり、東南アジア諸国（カンボジア・インドネシア・タイ・ベトナム）は耐性株の起源として言及されているのみで、実際の発生地域として扱われていないため対象国リストからは除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Crece número de fallecidos debido al ébola en el Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Death toll from Ebola rises in Congo.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo has escalated, with at least 930 deaths among 2,344 confirmed cases as of the latest count. Authorities reported 37 new fatalities in a 24-hour period between Friday and Saturday. Declared on May 15, this outbreak is the fastest-growing Ebola emergency on record. The virus behind the surge is Bundibugyo virus, a less common strain with no vaccine or approved treatment available. Ebola is highly contagious and can spread from wildlife to humans and, through human-to-human contact, via bodily fluids such as vomit, blood, or semen, and through contaminated surfaces and materials like bedding and clothing. The report notes ongoing transmission in the eastern Congo region and emphasizes the lack of licensed countermeasures, underscoring the urgent public health challenge posed by this outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラによる死者数が増加
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ東部でエボラ（ブンディブギョウイルス）の急速な拡大が確認され、致死率が高く、ワクチン・治療薬も存在しないため深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、国際的関心も高い。

article.articleHeadline: New Sub-Lineage of SARS-CoV-2 RF.5 Variant Possibly Behind 4 Deaths, 12 Severe COVID-19 Cases in Andhra Pradesh, India
article.articleSummary: Between June 26 and July 16, Andhra Pradesh logged 12 COVID-19 cases and four deaths, prompting reinforced surveillance. The four deceased had hypertension, diabetes and renal disease. Kadapa district accounted for most fatalities (3) with Kakinada reporting one death; Kadapa also recorded the highest case count, followed by Guntur, Visakhapatnam. Genome sequencing by the National Institute of Virology in Pune confirmed the Omicron RF.5 sub-lineage in four Kadapa samples, with officials stating infections appear sporadic rather than linked to a single outbreak. Some researchers suggest the detected RF.5 viruses may belong to newly evolving RF.5 sub-lineages carrying additional mutations, potentially linked to severe respiratory illness, though no direct association is yet confirmed. Further sequencing and epidemiological investigations are ongoing; authorities urge vigilance. Published 2026-07-20.

triage.headline_ja: インドのアンドラ・プラデーシュ州で、SARS-CoV-2の新たな亜系統RF.5変異株が4人の死亡と12件の重症COVID-19症例に関与の可能性
triage.triage_reason: 新規COVID-19亜系統(RF.5)が検出されたが、症例数は少なく死亡者には基礎疾患があり、当局も散発的事例と評価している。重症化との直接関連は未確認で、続報（追加配列解析・疫学調査）を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 報告された4人の死亡例はいずれも基礎疾患（高血圧、糖尿病、腎疾患）を有し、感染は単一のアウトブレイクではなく散発的とされている。新規亜系統の重症化との因果関係は未確定で、追加の配列解析・疫学調査の結果待ち。

article.articleHeadline: Dịch Ebola ở Congo ít nhất 930 người tử vong, trong đó có 36 nhân viên y tế
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in Congo has killed at least 930 people, including 36 healthcare workers.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern DR Congo has 2,344 confirmed cases and at least 930 deaths, as of July 19. In the 24 hours to July 19, 37 more deaths marked the highest toll since the outbreak began. Ituri province remains the epicenter amid security challenges, with five eastern provinces affected; at least 12 attacks on facilities and staff since mid-May. WHO warns about 80% of new infections from transmission chains not yet identified, signaling rapid spread beyond tracing capacity. Over two months, Congo has averaged 272 new cases and 111 deaths per week, with July accelerating. Currently 724 patients are in isolation and treatment, with 22 new recoveries in the last 24 hours. Bundibugyo Ebola virus lineage drives this outbreak; no vaccine or approved treatment exists. Transmission occurs via contact with body fluids and contaminated materials; zoonotic spillover is possible. France reports the imported case, a doctor returning from Congo.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行、死者少なくとも930人、うち医療従事者36人
triage.triage_reason: DRCで大規模なエボラ流行（確定2,344例、死者930人以上）が続き、感染経路不明な症例が80%に達し急速拡大、フランスへの輸入例も報告されているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: フランスでの輸入例（コンゴから帰国した医師）が報告されているが、フランスは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ワクチン・治療薬未承認、Bundibugyo株による流行で、感染経路不明の症例が多く拡大リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: COVID-19 Cases Continue to Rise Across Thailand with 6633 New Confirmed Cases and 257 Hospitalizations in the Last 7 Days
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 infections continue to rise in Thailand. Week 29 (July 13–19, 2026) recorded 6,633 laboratory-confirmed cases and 257 hospitalizations nationwide, indicating active circulation. Despite official figures, experts warn true infections may be substantially higher due to reduced testing in hospitals and clinics, especially for mild respiratory symptoms. NB.1.8.1 remains the dominant SARS‑CoV‑2 lineage in Thailand; no evidence of increased severity versus prior variants. Genomic surveillance is limited, and officials monitor for emerging RF.5 sub-lineages associated with higher severity in Andhra Pradesh, India, but their presence in Thailand is not confirmed. The Department of Disease Control reports no COVID‑19 deaths in the latest period, though some clinicians note unexplained deaths and occasional organ failure; investigations are ongoing. Public health emphasis remains on expanding testing, strengthening genomic surveillance, transparent reporting, and investigating unusual severe illnesses to identify new threats.

triage.headline_ja: タイで新型コロナウイルス感染症が拡大継続、直近7日間で新規確定患者6,633人、入院257人
triage.triage_reason: タイでCOVID-19感染が継続的に増加しているが、重症度上昇の明確な証拠はなく、死亡者数も報告されていない。RF.5亜系統の懸念は継続監視が必要な段階。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はタイでのCOVID-19症例増加。アンドラプラデシュ州（インド）のRF.5亜系統への言及は比較参照であり、タイでの確認はされていない。一部臨床医が原因不明の死亡や臓器障害を報告しており、調査中とされているため今後の続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Le bilan de l'épidémie d'Ebola en RDC dépasse 900 morts
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The death toll from the Ebola outbreak in the DRC exceeds 900.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has surpassed 900 deaths. As of July 20, 2026, the ministry of health reports 2,344 confirmed Ebola cases and 930 fatalities, for a case fatality rate of 39.7%. About 724 patients remain isolated or hospitalized, and 466 have recovered. Since the outbreak was declared on May 15, transmission remains ongoing in five provinces: Haut-Uele, Ituri, Nord-Kivu, Sud-Kivu, and Tshopo, with Ituri the epicentre. The current transmissions are attributed to the Bundibugyo strain of the Ebola virus. Africa CDC states frontline teams, health authorities and partners continue response efforts, with optimism that the curve may invert in weeks to months due to coordinated action.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、死者900人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCで5州にわたるエボラ流行が継続し、死者930人・症例2344人・致死率39.7%と深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、ヒト-ヒト感染や国際拡大のリスクも懸念されるためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断。

article.articleHeadline: देश को मिली पहली डेंगू वैक्सीन 'क्यूडेंगा', सीडीएससीओ ने दी मंजूरी, साफ-सफाई रखने की सलाह
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Country gets its first dengue vaccine, 'Qudenga'; CDSCO approves it and advises maintaining hygiene.
article.articleSummary: On 20 July 2026, India’s CDSCO approved Takeda’s dengue vaccine Qudenga for use in individuals aged 4–60 years, marking the country’s first dengue vaccine approval. The vaccine, which does not require prior dengue infection screening and covers all four serotypes, demonstrated about 80% efficacy against laboratory-confirmed dengue up to one year after the second dose, with substantially reduced hospitalization for severe dengue. While hailed as a major step in dengue prevention, health experts emphasize that vector control, hygiene, and eliminating standing water remain essential components of control. The approval positions India to bolster dengue prevention efforts domestically, with the vaccine manufactured by a Japanese company and to be used across the eligible age group.

triage.headline_ja: インド初のデング熱ワクチン「クデンガ」を国内で承認、CDSCOが認可――衛生管理の徹底も呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の発生状況を報じる記事ではなく、ワクチン承認という規制・政策関連のニュースであり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常な流行を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 本記事はデング熱の発生報告ではなく、ワクチン承認に関する政策ニュースのため、疫学的シグナルとしての優先度は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Viroses: entenda as principais doenças causadas por vírus e como se prevenir
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Viral Infections: Understand the Major Diseases Caused by Viruses and How to Prevent Them.
article.articleSummary: Viral infections (viroses) encompass widespread diseases such as seasonal influenza, COVID-19, and oropouche fever, affecting populations globally. Transmission occurs via inhalation of droplets, contaminated water/food, direct contact with surfaces, and objects, with sexually transmitted infections via bodily fluids. Diagnosis requires medical evaluation by clinicians or infectious disease specialists. Respiratory viruses like influenza and common colds cause variable symptoms; annual influenza vaccination, offered by the Ministry of Health, remains the most effective prevention to reduce complications in vulnerable groups. The COVID-19 pandemic (SARS-CoV-2) reshaped surveillance and isolation practices for respiratory illness. Oropouche fever, vectored by Culicoides paraensis (maruim), calls for environmental vector-control measures and rigorous use of repellents; no antivirals exist, so care targets pain and fever. Chronic infections such as HIV/AIDS require lifelong management; antiretroviral therapy can suppress viral load to undetectable levels, preserving immunity and health. Ongoing public health updates guide prevention and care.

triage.headline_ja: ウイルス感染症とは：ウイルスが引き起こす主な疾患とその予防法
triage.triage_reason: 特定の発生イベントではなく、ウイルス性疾患全般に関する一般的な啓発・解説記事であり、具体的な感染拡大や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報がない。

article.articleHeadline: Набирает обороты вспышка лихорадки Эбола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola fever outbreak is gaining momentum.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is accelerating under the Bundibugyo strain. WHO warns of catastrophic spread, with about 2,300 confirmed cases and roughly 900 deaths across five provinces as of July 20, 2026. Official tallies likely underestimate true burden since many new patients are not recorded as contacts, and infections often resemble a flu. There is no vaccine specifically targeting Bundibugyo. On 14 July 2026, clinical trials began for a promising experimental antiviral developed by American pharmaceutical firms, following encouraging preclinical results. The rapid rise highlights surveillance gaps and the need for rapid diagnosis, risk communication, and robust containment, as healthcare workers report mounting caseloads across multiple provinces.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行が拡大している
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）が5州に拡大し、約2,300例・死亡900例と深刻化しており、WHOも壊滅的拡大を警告しているため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断した。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株に特化したワクチンが存在せず、感染がインフルエンザ様症状を示すため過小報告の可能性が高い。米国製薬企業による実験的抗ウイルス薬の臨床試験が2026年7月14日に開始された点も注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: দ্রুত গতিতে ছড়াচ্ছে ইবোলা ভাইরাস, মৃত্যু বেড়ে ৯৩০

In the latest 24 hours, 37 deaths were recorded—the highest daily increase since the outbreak was declared on 15 May—making it the third-largest and fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak on record. The World Health Organization notes that 2,000 infections were reached in just two months, far quicker than the 2018–2020 outbreak. The outbreak has reached five provinces across the DRC and neighboring Uganda, though Uganda is moving toward being virus-free. Ituri province in the northeast was the initial focus amid armed-group activity. Bunia General Hospital staff protests over pay have hindered response. More than 724 patients are in isolation, and 22 have recovered in the last 24 hours; over 80% of new infections are outside known contact lists, signaling undetected transmission chains.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスが急速に拡大、死者930人に増加
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱が史上3番目の規模・最速の速度で拡大しており、死者930人・感染2344人、複数州およびウガンダへの拡大が確認されている。IHR基準を3つ満たし、WHOも注視する重大な公衆衛生上の脅威である。

article.articleHeadline: കോംഗോയിൽ എബോള ഭീതി; മരണം 930 ആയി
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola fear in Congo; death toll at 930.

Transmission starts from wildlife to humans and then spreads through bodily fluids. triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラの恐怖；死者930人に

article.articleHeadline: Ébola en RD del Congo deja 930 muertos en el brote más rápido registrado
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DR Congo leaves 930 dead in the fastest outbreak on record.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Bundibugyo ebolavirus) has killed 930 people among 2,344 confirmed cases, with 37 deaths in the last 24 hours. Declared May 15 in eastern DRC, it is the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak. The Bundibugyo virus is less common than other strains, and there is no licensed vaccine or approved treatment. Transmission occurs via wildlife exposure and human-to-human contact with bodily fluids and contaminated surfaces. The hardest-hit area is Ituri province, with five eastern provinces affected. At least 12 attacks on health facilities have been reported; about 36 health workers infected have died, and many have abandoned duties. The WHO warns that around 80% of new cases arise from unknown transmission chains. Over two months, averages were ~272 cases and 111 deaths per week, with July increases; 724 patients are in isolation, and 22 recoveries were recorded in 24 hours, as response is intensified.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ、史上最速の流行で死者930人
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ(Bundibugyo株)がコンゴ民主共和国で急速に拡大し、930人死亡・複数州に拡大、医療施設への攻撃や不明感染経路が多く、国際的拡大・公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が明確なためPICKUPと判定。
triage.notes: ワクチン・治療薬未承認、80%が感染経路不明、医療従事者への攻撃・死亡多数と、制御が非常に困難な状況。WHOも警戒を強めている。

article.articleHeadline: എബോള; യുഎൻ നിർദേശം മറികടന്ന് കോംഗോയിൽ നിന്നുള്ള സന്ദർശകർക്ക് കാനഡയുടെ വിലക്ക്
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola; Canada bans visitors from Congo in defiance of UN directive.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak accelerates in the Democratic Republic of Congo, prompting Canada to impose a travel ban on foreign nationals who have visited Congo within the past 21 days. The prohibition, effective until August 29, 2026, requires airlines not to board such travelers; exemptions exist for Canadian citizens and permanent residents, while those who have recently visited Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan must undergo stringent health screening on arrival and may face a 21-day quarantine even if asymptomatic. The government warns of heavy fines and imprisonment for violations. The move is described as defying United Nations directives and aligning with stringent international health controls in response to the rapidly spreading Ebola situation in Congo.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ；国連の指導に反してカナダがコンゴからの入国者を禁止
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行拡大に対し、カナダが渡航禁止措置を取るなど国際的な対応が生じており、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大・渡航制限）の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はカナダの渡航制限措置を主題としているが、根本の感染症イベントはDRCでのエボラ流行。ウガンダ・南スーダンも渡航制限対象国として言及されているが、対象国リストにウガンダ・南スーダンは含まれず、DRCのみverified_locationsに含めた。カナダも対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Zambia Launches Final Round of Polio Vaccination Campaign Targeting 3.9 Million Children
article.articleSummary: Polio vaccination campaign underway in Zambia's six priority provinces (Lusaka, Southern, Eastern, Central, Western, Muchinga), targeting about 3.9 million children under five as the final round of Sub-National Immunization Activities runs 21–26 July 2026. This follows two earlier rounds in April and June as part of regional outbreak response, boosted by a newly solarized 100-kW National Vaccine Store to strengthen the vaccine cold chain; projected annual savings ~$48,000. Across rounds, 6 provinces, 71 districts, 1,985 facilities with 7,830 vaccination teams and 8,006 mobilizers/supervisors participated. Round 1 reached 3,841,940 (102% of 3,759,057 target); Round 2 3,979,228 (103% of 3,845,667). Zero-dose children declined from 1.5% to 0.55%. The campaign, supported by GPEI, WHO, Rotary, UNICEF, KSRelief, UAE, aims to interrupt poliovirus transmission after environmental detections in Lusaka earlier this year. Final doses cover children who received prior doses; all under-five children offered oral polio vaccine at diverse venues.

triage.headline_ja: ザンビア、390万人の子供を対象としたポリオワクチン接種キャンペーンの最終ラウンドを開始
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はザンビアで既に実施中のポリオ対応（サブナショナル予防接種活動）の進捗報告であり、新規の異常事象や感染拡大の報告ではないが、ポリオは国際的に注視すべき疾患であり継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事は今年初めにルサカで環境中からポリオウイルスが検出されたことを受けた地域アウトブレイク対応の第3ラウンド（最終ラウンド）のワクチン接種キャンペーン進捗報告。新規の症例報告や異常事象ではなく、既存対応の実施状況（カバー率、ゼロドーズ児童の減少等）が中心。GPEI、WHO、UNICEF等の国際支援を受けている継続的な公衆衛生対応。

article.articleHeadline: Populasi Nyamuk Melonjak saat Cuaca Panas, Kenali Risiko Penyakit dan Lokasi yang Jadi Sarangnya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mosquito Populations Surge During Hot Weather: Know the Disease Risks and the Locations That Become Their Breeding Grounds.
article.articleSummary: Hot weather accelerates mosquito breeding cycles, shortening adult lifespan but speeding development from egg to larva to adult, raising household mosquito populations in tropical areas. Studies cited from the National Library of Medicine on Anopheles gambiae at 27°C, 30°C, and 32°C show that higher temperatures shorten mosquito longevity while hastening physiological development; older mosquitoes at higher temperatures are more prone to death and show higher susceptibility to bacterial infections, with Escherichia coli infection intensity increasing with heat. Mosquitoes are poikilothermic and their metabolism rises with ambient temperature, intensifying growth, survival challenges, and infection responses. The result is a potentially higher risk of malaria and dengue fever outbreaks as populations surge. Breeding sites at home include damp areas from standing water, wet laundry, and poor ventilation, especially in tropical climates.

triage.headline_ja: 気温上昇で蚊の個体数が急増、病気のリスクと発生源となる場所を知る
triage.triage_reason: 特定の疾病発生や症例報告ではなく、気温上昇による蚊の生態と疾病リスクに関する一般的な啓発記事であり、具体的な公衆衛生上の異常事態は報告されていない。
triage.notes: 本記事は具体的な発生国・地域における症例報告ではなく、気温と蚊媒介感染症リスクに関する一般的な科学的解説記事であるため、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: ಸಾಂಕ್ರಾಮಿಕ ರೋಗ ತಡೆಗಟ್ಟಲು ಶಾಸಕರ ಸಮಿತಿ ರಚನೆಗೆ ತೀರ್ಮಾನ: ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ಸಚಿವ ಯು.ಟಿ. ಖಾದರ್ | MLA Panel to Be Formed to Prevent Epidemics: U.T. Khader
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Decision to form an MLA committee to prevent infectious diseases: Health Minister U.T. Khader
article.articleSummary: Malaria cases down 70% and dengue down 33% in the state. Bengaluru Health Minister U.T. Khader announces formation of MLA-led committees from each constituency to oversee infectious disease control, enabling faster local response. An Ebola-related screening at airports continues for travelers from Congo, Uganda and other African nations, with a new health‑emergency management system to rapidly relay information to all districts. Local oversight and border surveillance will enhance coordinated action; house-to-house larva surveys are underway, and recruitment of lab technicians and pharmacists is planned. Private hospitals treating infectious diseases must report to the health department, with SOPs to prevent unwarranted charges. Regarding COVID-19, officials say there is no public panic; increased testing shows higher case numbers, but all patients have recovered and no deaths have been reported.

triage.headline_ja: 感染症予防のため州議会議員委員会を設置することを決定：保健大臣U.T.カダール
triage.triage_reason: マラリア・デング熱は減少傾向、COVID-19は死亡例なく回復、エボラは渡航者スクリーニングのみで感染確認事例はなく、行政の予防的体制強化を報じる内容であり緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事はインド・カルナータカ州（ベンガルール）における感染症予防の行政対応を報じるもので、マラリア・デング減少、COVID-19は軽症、エボラは水際対策のみで実際の症例発生は報告されていない。コンゴ・ウガンダは渡航元として言及されるのみで、当該国での発生を報じるものではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Lucknow News: मानसून संग लखनऊ में डेंगू-मलेरिया की भी हुई आहट
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lucknow News: With the monsoon, dengue and malaria have also made their presence felt in Lucknow.
article.articleSummary: Lucknow experiences a monsoon-driven rise in mosquito-borne diseases, with dengue and malaria prominent and July–September identified as the most vulnerable period. Malaria cases show a stark year-on-year shift: 2025 January–July totals of 2, 2, 3, 14, 32, 76, 150, versus 2026 totals of 3, 7, 17, 11, 28, 51, 44, indicating a mid-year decline in 2026 after a 2025 peak. Dengue numbers fluctuate, with 2025 January–July at 6, 5, 17, 6, 6, 8, 15 and 2026 at 11, 5, 7, 5, 10, 7, 13. Authorities report ongoing awareness campaigns contributing to reduced rates, but cautions persist and residents should maintain preventive measures to curb transmission in Lucknow.

triage.headline_ja: ラクナウ・ニュース：モンスーンとともにデング熱・マラリアの兆候も現れる
triage.triage_reason: モンスーン期における例年通りの蚊媒介感染症（デング熱・マラリア）の季節的発生報告であり、2026年の症例数は2025年と比較して減少傾向にあるため、異常性や重大な公衆衛生上の懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: 季節性の蚊媒介感染症に関するローカルニュースであり、症例数は前年比で減少傾向。当局による啓発活動も実施されており、通常の監視対象範囲内と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: 越南旅遊染登革熱 嘉市現首例
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever contracted during travel to Vietnam; Chiayi City reports its first case.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever confirmed in Chiayi City, Taiwan as an imported case from travel to Vietnam. A recent graduate developed fever, headache and retro-orbital pain after returning, with dengue PCR positive on July 18. Chiayi City Health Bureau conducted epidemiologic investigations, surveyed vector density around the patient’s residence, and completed indoor/outdoor chemical control within 100 meters to eliminate breeding sites. With dengue season ongoing and hot, humid conditions favoring Aedes mosquitoes, authorities urge the public to follow the 4-step prevention—patrol, drain, clean, scrub—and remove standing water. In New Taipei City, the deputy mayor led dengue prevention efforts in Tucheng; no locally acquired dengue cases yet, but high vigilance remains. The Environmental Protection Bureau reports by end-June 26,516 person-times mobilized, 8,163 breeding sites cleared, and 11,865 standing-water containers eliminated through a multi-agency approach. Health authorities note 486 facilities stock NS1 rapid tests, with 157 contracted pharmacies for referrals, plus a reporting incentive system to ensure early detection and treatment.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナム旅行でデング熱感染、嘉義市で初の症例
triage.triage_reason: 台湾嘉義市における輸入デング熱の単発例で、地域内感染は確認されておらず、通常の防疫対応の範囲内であるため。
triage.notes: 台湾（対象国外）における輸入デング熱の単発例。ベトナムは感染源として言及されているが、記事の主題はベトナムでの流行状況ではなく台湾嘉義市の防疫対応であるため、verified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: കോംഗോയില്‍ എബോള ഭീതി രൂക്ഷം; മരണസംഖ്യ 930 കടന്നു; സ്ഥിതി അതീവ ഗുരുതരം | Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola fear intensifies in Congo; death toll crosses 930; the situation is extremely serious | Ebola
article.articleSummary: As of 20 July 2026, Congo faces a severe Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 2,344 laboratory-confirmed cases and 930 deaths. In the past 24 hours, 37 deaths were reported. The outbreak, which emerged on 15 May in eastern Congo, is described as the fastest-spreading on record. There are no approved vaccines or proven effective treatments for Bundibugyo Ebola in this setting. Transmission began wildlife-to-human, then rapid human-to-human spread via bodily fluids. Security threats from rebel groups and attacks on health facilities and workers, plus public mistrust and unpaid-wages protests, have hampered response. About 36 health workers have died; 80% of new cases cannot be traced to a clear source.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラの恐怖が深刻化；死者930人超；状況は極めて深刻
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部でBundibugyoエボラウイルスによる大規模流行が進行中で、致死率が高く、史上最速の拡大とされ、治療薬・ワクチンも未確立であるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 武装勢力による治安悪化、医療従事者への攻撃、賃金未払い抗議などが対応を阻害しており、国際的な支援が急務とされる。承認済みワクチン・有効な治療法が存在しない点も重大なリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola en RD Congo se propaga "más rápido" que los precedentes, alerta la OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the DRC is spreading faster than previous outbreaks, WHO warns.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), declared about two months ago, is spreading faster than any previous events, according to WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. As of July 2026, 2,003 cases and 796 deaths have been reported. The epidemic, caused by the Bundibugyo variant, is the third-largest Ebola outbreak on record, with transmission outpacing the 2018–2020 outbreak, which reached about 3,500 cases and approximately 2,300 deaths. There is currently no vaccine or approved treatment for Bundibugyo Ebola. The World Health Organization has begun clinical trials this month evaluating two therapeutic approaches: the monoclonal antibody MBP134 and the antiviral remdesivir, tested alone or in combination. The briefing was issued from Geneva, with ongoing concerns about the outbreak’s rapid spread and the need for effective countermeasures.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱、過去の流行より「速いスピード」で拡大とWHOが警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（2,003例、796死亡）がWHOにより過去最速の拡大速度で進行中と警告されており、ワクチン・治療薬未承認という重症度・拡大リスクの観点からIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 発生地域にGenève/Switzerlandが含まれるが、これはWHO本部所在地であり、実際の発生国はDRCのみ。ワクチン・治療薬未承認のBundibugyo株による過去最大級の流行として厳重な注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola tears through Congo with 930 dead and no vaccine yet
article.articleSummary: Eastern Congo's Ebola outbreak has 930 deaths among 2,344 confirmed cases, with 37 fatalities in a 24-hour period, making it the fastest-growing outbreak on record. Declared May 15 in Ituri province (epicenter around Bunia), the Bundibugyo virus drives the surge; there is no approved vaccine or treatment, leaving supportive care as the main option. Early symptoms include fever, severe weakness, pain, vomiting, and potentially bleeding; transmission occurs via animal-to-human spillover and human-to-human contact with bodily fluids, with unsafe funeral practices accelerating spread. The World Health Organization reports 80% of new cases come from unknown transmission chains. Congo notes 724 patients isolated and 22 recoveries logged in a single day. Health workers are heavily affected (36 deaths), with 12 attacks on facilities/teams amid unpaid wages and protests; Uganda reports a small nearby cluster but is close to being declared free of the virus.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱がコンゴを席巻、死者930人、ワクチンはまだない
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ東部のエボラ出血熱は930人死亡・2344人確定例で史上最速の拡大を見せ、ワクチン・治療法が未確立、80%が感染経路不明という深刻な状況であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナル。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも近隣クラスターが報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。記事の主題はコンゴ（イトゥリ州、ブニア中心）のアウトブレイク。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola au Haut-Uélé : la Croix-Rouge renforce les capacités des volontaires pour une meilleure riposte - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Haut-Uélé: the Red Cross strengthens volunteers' capacities for a better response - ACP
article.articleSummary: On 20 July 2026, Red Cross volunteers in Haut-Uélé, northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo, have been trained in dignified and secure burials (EDS) as part of the Ebola response. The EPIC program covers EDS, infection prevention and control (IPC), psychosocial support (PSPS), risk communication and community engagement (CREC), community-based surveillance (CBS), and Protection, Gender and Inclusion (PGI). The training responds to a security incident in Madjo, Isiro, where responders were attacked. It is delivered across six territories—Dungu, Rungu, Faradje, Watsa, Wamba, Niangara—to ensure province-wide coverage. The Red Cross requests security assistance for field operations to halt Ebola in Haut-Uélé, amid a resurgence officially declared since May 2026.

triage.headline_ja: オー・ウエレ州のエボラ出血熱：赤十字社がより良い対応のためボランティアの能力を強化
triage.triage_reason: 2026年5月から公式に再燃が宣言されているコンゴ民主共和国オー・ウエレ州のエボラ出血熱に関する報道であり、深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威かつ国際支援要請（治安確保支援）が明示されているためフルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断する。
triage.notes: 発生地域に記載されたIndonesia（Provinsi Lampung, Maja）は記事内容と無関係であり、Bluedot APIの地域付与誤りと判断して除外した。本事案はDRCオー・ウエレ州における2026年5月以降のエボラ再燃に関するもので、現場対応者への襲撃事件を受けた治安支援要請が明記されている点が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : les chefs de villages riverains du lac Albert appelés à la sensibilisation - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Village chiefs along the shores of Lake Albert urged to raise awareness
article.articleSummary: On 20 July 2026, in Bunia, Democratic Republic of Congo, village chiefs along the Lake Albert shoreline in Djugu territory, Ituri, were urged by a customary leader to bolster community awareness of Ebola prevention during a meeting in Tchomia. Pilo Mulindro Willy, chief of Bahema Nord, called on all village authorities to intensify education on Ebola prevention measures to curb transmission and to collaborate with health services to improve adherence to barrier precautions. He urged traditional authorities to accompany health workers to secure community buy-in. Regarding Lake Albert fishing, he advocated responsible fishing and strict adherence to regulations to protect livelihoods and resources. The gathering reflects proximity-based actions by local authorities to heighten Ebola vigilance and promote sustainable fisheries in Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：アルバート湖沿岸の村長らに啓発活動が呼びかけられる
triage.triage_reason: 記事は確認された新規感染者情報を含まず、住民啓発活動に関する内容のため現時点では確定的シグナルとは言えないが、エボラという重篤疾患かつ既知の流行地域（イトゥリ州）での動きのため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は具体的な感染者数や新規発生の確認情報を含まず、地域住民への予防啓発活動が主題。エボラ自体は重篤疾患であり、イトゥリ州は過去に流行歴があるため継続的な監視が必要。「Lake Albert」および「New South Wales」等オーストラリア関連の地理情報はBluedotの誤タグ付けと判断し除外。

article.articleHeadline: Canada bars travelers from DR Congo over Ebola outbreak, defies WHO warnings
article.articleSummary: Canada will temporarily bar foreign nationals who have visited the Democratic Republic of the Congo within the last 21 days, effective July 20 at 11:59 p.m., to curb the worsening Ebola outbreak centered in the DRC. The move, described by the Public Health Agency of Canada as reducing public health risks, defies WHO warnings that broad travel bans are counterproductive and can fuel stigma. As of July 15, health officials reported more than 2,100 confirmed Ebola cases and 828 deaths, with transmission primarily via direct contact with infected bodily fluids. The restriction follows similar measures by the United States; seven American aid workers who traveled to the region are quarantined in Kenya before returning to the United States. The WHO has assessed the international risk as low and emphasized that spread is not determined by nationality or ethnicity. The tension between domestic risk mitigation and international humanitarian needs continues as policymakers weigh containment at the source against broader travel controls.

triage.headline_ja: カナダ、エボラ出血熱の流行を理由にコンゴ民主共和国からの渡航者を禁止、WHOの警告に反する対応
triage.triage_reason: DRCで2100人超の感染者・828人の死者を出すエボラ出血熱の大規模流行が継続し、複数国が渡航制限を導入するなど国際的な対応が拡大しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 米国・カナダは渡航制限を課した対応国、ケニアは援助従事者の検疫先であり、いずれもエボラ流行の発生地ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Father-daughter duo tests COVID-19 positive in Bihar's Bhagalpur
article.articleSummary: Two COVID-19 cases confirmed in Bhagalpur district, Bihar, on 20 July 2026: a 65-year-old man and his 35-year-old daughter. The man was admitted to Jawaharlal Nehru Medical College and Hospital (JLNMCH) with suspected infection; RT-PCR confirmed COVID-19. The daughter tested positive during contact testing; initial misidentification as the wife was corrected to daughter. Both patients are in intensive medical care and under close monitoring. The man's condition deteriorated on 15 July after treatment at a private clinic, leading to referral to JLNMCH. COVID-19 protocols have been activated; district programme manager instructed to test people in the vicinity. District administration confirmed the two cases. Hospital officials said the patients are stable and urged the public to maintain preventive measures and seek timely care, stressing there is no need for panic.

triage.headline_ja: ビハール州バガルプールで父娘がCOVID-19陽性
triage.triage_reason: 個別の家族内2例に限られ、重症化やクラスター拡大の兆候はなく、当局も「パニックの必要なし」と発表しており、通常の散発例として社会的関心・国際的懸念は低い。
triage.notes: COVID-19は既知の疾患であり、家族内の2例（濃厚接触者検査で判明）に限定。地域当局が接触者調査を実施しているが、通常の公衆衛生対応の範囲内。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Nia-Nia : persistance des décès communautaires à Bafwabango - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Nia-Nia: Persistence of Community Deaths in Bafwabango - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola persists in Nia-Nia Health Zone, particularly in the city of Bafwabango in Mambasa, Ituri, northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo. As of 20 July 2026, community deaths remain alarmingly high, averaging 15–20 per day as outbreak response activities have yet to resume. The health zone's chief medical officer, Dr. Joseph Pemanakue, said the laboratory in Nia-Nia is operational and enhances detection and surveillance. A total of 68 confirmed Ebola cases have been recorded in Nia-Nia. The Ebola Treatment Center (ETC) within Nia-Nia General Referral Hospital currently cares for around 20 patients; recoveries are being recorded thanks to medicines and nutritional support. Authorities continue to strengthen the response to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: ニアニアでのエボラ:バフワバンゴで続く地域社会内死亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確定患者68名、地域社会内死亡が1日15-20人と高水準で継続し、公衆衛生上深刻かつ対応体制の再開が急務であるため。
triage.notes: 地域社会内での死亡が多数（対応未再開）であり、検査・治療体制の遅延が感染拡大リスクを高めている。続報でアウトブレイク対応の再開状況・症例数の推移を要確認。

article.articleHeadline: गुजरात में चांदीपुरा वायरस के 12 मामले पुष्ट, 8 की मौत, सरकार ने निगरानी बढ़ाई
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Twelve Chandipura virus cases confirmed in Gujarat, eight dead, government tightens surveillance.
article.articleSummary: As of 20 July 2026, Gujarat reports 63 suspected Chandipura virus cases with 12 laboratory-confirmed and eight deaths among them; three additional confirmed cases are in Rajasthan. Confirmed Gujarat cases: Panchmahal (2), Kheda (2), Sabarkantha (1), Mehsana (1), Bharuch (1), Bhavnagar (1), and Ahmedabad Municipal Corporation area (1) — total 9 in Gujarat and 3 in Rajasthan. All 63 suspected samples have been tested or are in process at the Gandhinagar-based Gujarat Biotechnology Research Centre; 55 results reported. Rapid Response Teams are investigating travel histories to identify transmission sources. Vector control includes dusting and insecticide spraying against sandflies, plus large-scale surveillance around shelters and animal enclosures; thousands of households are surveyed. 117 sandfly samples tested so far, all negative. Chandipura virus, identified in 1965 in Chandrapur, Maharashtra, mainly affects children under 15 and can cause acute encephalitis syndrome. Seek urgent care for fever with seizures or altered consciousness.

triage.headline_ja: グジャラート州でチャンディプラウイルス感染12例確認、8人死亡、政府が監視強化
triage.triage_reason: 小児を中心に急性脳炎症候群を引き起こすチャンディプラウイルスにより複数州で確認例・死亡例が発生し、致死率が高く公衆衛生上の影響が大きいため、IHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: チャンディプラウイルスはサシチョウバエ媒介の脳炎症候群で、グジャラート州で過去にも周期的に発生している既知の疾患。今回はグジャラート9例、ラジャスタン3例の確認例と8人の死亡が報告されており、症例の重症度と小児への影響から続報の確認とフルリスク評価が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola death toll rises to 930, as outbreak spreads at record pace
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-07-20, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has killed at least 930 people and reached 2,365 cases, with 37 deaths in the prior 24 hours; five eastern provinces are affected, centered on Ituri, with 20 cases in Uganda and 1 in France, signaling cross-border spread. More than 80% of new cases are not on known contact lists, indicating gaps in traceability. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain driving this crisis has no vaccine or treatment. Africa CDC plans a two-vaccine frontline trial using Ervebo (Zaire ebolavirus) as the first dose plus an experimental vaccine against Sudan ebolavirus from IAVI, among health workers in eastern Congo; approval submission is expected soon. The 2014-16 West Africa outbreak, which killed over 11,300, spurred Ervebo’s development. Local distrust and attacks on health facilities hinder response; WHO warns the outbreak could spread to neighboring countries.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、死者930人に増加、感染拡大は記録的なペースで進行
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で930人の死亡・2365例に達し、ウガンダ・フランスへの越境拡大が確認されており、ワクチン・治療法のないBundibugyo株による深刻かつ異常な流行としてIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため、フルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダ(20例)・フランス(1例)への越境拡大が報告されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCが主たる発生国。

article.articleHeadline: Assam: Tinsukia imposes 30-day pork trade ban after ASF outbreak
article.articleSummary: As of 20 July 2026, Assam’s Tinsukia district imposes a 30-day pork trade ban after an African Swine Fever (ASF) outbreak centered in Simoluguri village, Kailashpur Gaon Panchayat, Margherita. A 1-km infected zone and 10-km surveillance zone are established; all pork shops in Digboi Co-District are closed for 30 days. Sale, transport and movement of pigs and pork products within and outside the co-district, including to Arunachal Pradesh, are prohibited. A culling operation will run July 21–23, with veterinary teams overseeing culling, carcass disposal, sanitisation and biosecurity measures per ASF guidelines. This is the second ASF outbreak in Tinsukia within six weeks; a June 9 outbreak at Ouguri village, Rupai Siding, Doomdooma Block prompted culling and containment. ASF has killed more than 40,000 pigs, affecting over 14,000 pig-rearing families across 22 districts, with up to 100% fatality. The Disaster Management Act 2005 order may invoke BNS Section 223.

triage.headline_ja: アッサム州:ティンスキア地区がASF発生後30日間の豚肉取引禁止令を発令
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚熱(ASF)がアッサム州で再発し、豚肉取引禁止・移動制限などの防疫措置が発令され行政（災害管理法）が介入している点でWPRO基準（重症度・持続的暴露・流行しやすさ）に複数該当し、政府の関心も高いためピックアップ対象とする。
triage.notes: ASFはヒトに感染しない動物疾病であり、直接的な公衆衛生リスクは低いが、養豚業への経済的影響と地域的拡大（22地区・14,000世帯・40,000頭以上死亡）が続いており、行政による災害管理法の適用など社会的関心が高いためWATCH以上の対応が望まれる。

article.articleHeadline: 5 người tại TP.HCM tử vong vì bệnh dại, không tiêm vắc xin sau khi bị chó mèo cắn
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Five people in Ho Chi Minh City die from rabies after not getting vaccinated following bites from dogs and cats.
article.articleSummary: Rabies deaths in Ho Chi Minh City total 5 in the first half of 2026, all after dog/cat bites with no post-exposure vaccination or rabies immunoglobulin. Cases occurred in Long Hải (3), Cu Chi (1), and Hòa Hiệp (1). About 40% of victims mismanaged injuries with measures like attempting to extract venom, applying oil, or herbal remedies, delaying life-saving prophylaxis. A representative case describes a man bitten while exercising who avoided medical care, pursued venom extraction per informal guidance, and delayed treatment until symptoms appeared, dying about 12 hours after hospital admission. Public health guidance emphasizes immediate wound washing with soap under running water for at least 15 minutes, disinfection with 45–70% alcohol or povidone-iodine, and timely vaccination and rabies immunoglobulin as indicated. City health authorities and veterinary services are strengthening surveillance, communication, and outbreak control to prevent rabies transmission from animals to humans.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市で狂犬病により5人死亡、犬猫に咬まれた後ワクチン未接種
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病はベトナムで既知の流行病であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いが、咬傷後の予防処置未実施による死亡が続いており、地域内での監視強化が必要な状況。
triage.notes: 狂犬病はベトナムで既知の流行病であり、本記事は予防啓発を目的とした国内報道。人-人感染の可能性はなく、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威とは言えないが、咬傷後の不適切な処置（民間療法など）による死亡例が継続しており、地域の動物由来感染症対策の状況を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola death toll in Congo rises to at least 930, including dozens of health workers
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo, centered in Ituri Province and Bunia, caused by Bundibugyo virus. As of July 20, 2026, Congo’s Ministry of Health reports 2,344 confirmed cases and at least 930 deaths, with 37 new deaths recorded Friday–Saturday. The May 15 declaration marks the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak on record; there is no approved vaccine or treatment. Ebola is highly contagious, transmitted from wild animals and between people via bodily fluids and contaminated materials. Five eastern provinces are affected, with Ituri the hardest hit; safety fears and rebel violence have constrained response, and at least 12 attacks on health facilities have been recorded. About 36 health workers have died from infection. WHO notes roughly 80% of new cases arise from unknown transmission chains, indicating rapid spread. Currently, 724 patients are in isolation or hospital, and 22 recoveries were reported in 24 hours, with weekly cases/deaths rising notably in July.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ死者数が930人以上に増加、医療従事者数十人を含む
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイクで死者930人以上、2,344人の確定例、既承認ワクチン・治療法がなく、医療従事者への攻撃や不明な感染経路が80%を占めるなど公衆衛生上深刻かつ異常な状況であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当。
triage.notes: 史上最速の拡大ペースとされるエボラ流行で、5州に拡大、反政府勢力による攻撃・治安不安が対応を妨げている。ワクチン・治療薬未承認で国際支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Walikale : les soignants réclament l'aménagement des sources d'eau face à la montée des maladies hydriques à Mutakato
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Walikale: Healthcare workers demand improvements to water sources amid rising waterborne diseases in Mutakato
article.articleSummary: Mutakato, in Walikale health zone, North Kivu, Democratic Republic of Congo, reports rising waterborne diseases due to lack of potable water. Since the start of July, the Mutakato Health Area centre has treated 30 cases of waterborne illness, with diarrhoea and typhoid fever among presentations from consumption of water from unimproved sources without a potable-water system. Healthcare worker Akilimali Mubangu warns of an ongoing public health threat, capable of rapid spread without preventive action. Authorities and humanitarian partners are urged to invest in water-source development and potable-water infrastructure to prevent epidemics such as cholera, diarrhoea, and typhoid fever. Residents seek a rapid response to reduce sanitary risks and improve living conditions.

triage.headline_ja: ワリカレ:ムタカトで水系感染症が増加する中、医療従事者が水源整備を要求
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国北キブ州ワリカレで水系感染症（下痢、腸チフス）が増加し、コレラ流行の懸念が医療従事者から表明されており、WPRO基準（持続的暴露、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）が複数該当し社会的関心もあるため。
triage.notes: 現時点でコレラの確定例は報告されていないが、飲料水インフラの欠如により今後拡大するリスクが医療従事者から警告されている。症例数や死亡者数など重症度の詳細情報は不明。続報を確認しフルRRAでの精査が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: गुजरात में चांदीपुरा वायरस के 12 मामले पुष्ट, 8 की मौत, सरकार ने निगरानी बढ़ाई | Gujarat reports 63 suspected Chandipura virus cases, confirms eight deaths (Photo: IANS)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 12 Chandipura virus cases confirmed in Gujarat, 8 dead; government steps up surveillance.
article.articleSummary: Chandipura virus outbreak in Gujarat, India, with 63 suspected cases this year; 12 confirmed and 8 more samples under investigation. Of the confirmed cases, 9 are in Gujarat and 3 in Rajasthan; districts include Panchmahal and Kheda with two each, and Sabarkantha, Mehsana, Bharuch, Bhavnagar, and Ahmedabad Municipal area with one each. All 63 suspected cases are hospitalized; samples sent to Gandhinagar-based Gujarat Biotechnology Research Centre for laboratory confirmation; response teams are investigating travel histories and exposure. Vector-control measures include dusting and insecticide spraying to curb sandflies; thousands of homes inspected; 117 sandfly samples tested—all negative. Eight of the twelve confirmed patients have died. Gujarat has ICU beds, essential medicines, and ventilators for children; 1,993 pediatricians trained; emphasis on monsoon season risk and seeking care promptly. Chandipura virus, first identified in 1965 in Chandipura, Maharashtra, is transmitted by sandflies and can cause acute encephalitis syndrome in children under 15.

triage.headline_ja: グジャラート州でチャンディプラウイルス感染症63例が疑われ、12例確定、8名死亡；政府が監視強化
triage.triage_reason: インドグジャラート州でチャンディプラウイルスによる急性脳炎症候群の確定患者12例中8例が死亡と高い致死率を示し、モンスーン期の継続的な媒介動物（サシチョウバエ）暴露が見込まれるため、社会的・行政的関心も高くフルリスク評価が必要と判断した。
triage.notes: チャンディプラウイルスは1965年にマハーラーシュトラ州で最初に確認された既知の病原体で、サシチョウバエ媒介の急性脳炎症候群を引き起こす。グジャラート州では過去にも季節的発生が報告されているが、今回は確定患者の致死率が高い（8/12）。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いが、モンスーン期の継続的暴露と小児への重症化リスクから経過観察・フル評価が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Jaunpur News | Child Health Tips | Jaunpur Latest Hindi News | UP Breaking News Hindi Newstrack | Jaunpur News: बारिश में बच्चों का रखें खयाल, डॉ. कुलदीप ने संक्रामक बीमारियों से बचाव की दी ये सलाह
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jaunpur News | Child Health Tips | Jaunpur Latest Hindi News | UP Breaking News Hindi Newstrack | Jaunpur News: Take care of children in the rain, Dr. Kuldeep has given this advice for preventing infectious diseases.
article.articleSummary: Jaunpur, Uttar Pradesh—In the rainy season, Dr. Kuldeep Nigam, a physician at Sadar District Hospital and Maharajganj Market resident, urges guardians to shield children from seasonal and infectious illnesses. With monsoon-related factors like contaminated water, dirt, and rising mosquito populations, several diseases pose risk: diarrhoea, viral fever, typhoid, dengue, malaria, chikungunya, and skin infections. Advice includes providing clean, boiled or purified water; serving fresh, nutritious food; avoiding exposed foods; and maintaining home cleanliness to limit transmission. For mosquito control, use nets, long-sleeved clothing, and repellents as needed. Seek prompt medical care for high fever, persistent vomiting or diarrhoea, rashes, breathing problems, or severe weakness; avoid self-medication or unqualified treatments. Health department programs aim to raise awareness and reduce seasonal disease burden.

triage.headline_ja: ジョンプル・ニュース｜子供の健康アドバイス｜ジョンプル最新ヒンディー語ニュース｜UPブレイキングニュース：雨季における子供の感染症予防についてクルディープ医師が助言
triage.triage_reason: 特定のアウトブレイクではなく、雨季の一般的な健康啓発記事であり、異常事態や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報がない。
triage.notes: 季節性感染症（デング熱、チクングニア熱、マラリア、腸チフス）に関する一般的な予防啓発記事であり、具体的な発生数や異常な流行を報告するものではない。

article.articleHeadline: بھارت میں پہلی ڈینگی ویکسین کی منظوری
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First dengue vaccine approved in India
article.articleSummary: New Delhi, 20 July 2026: India's drug regulator approved Takeda Pharmaceutical's QDENGA dengue vaccine, the country's first dengue vaccine. QDENGA targets all four dengue virus serotypes and is approved for individuals aged 4-60 years. The two-dose schedule is given three months apart, and prior dengue infection testing is not required. In trials, efficacy against confirmed dengue after the second dose (one year later) was 80.2%, while hospitalization due to dengue fell by 90.4% after 18 months. QDENGA has been cleared in 43 countries. Takeda India has expanded local production via a 2024 partnership with Biological E. Globally, dengue is a rapidly spreading vector-borne disease; WHO reported over 14.4 million cases and 11,201 deaths in 2024, with India accounting for 232,425 cases and 233 deaths. An infectious disease expert notes vaccination reduces severity and hospitalization but cannot fully prevent transmission while mosquitoes persist.

triage.headline_ja: インドで初のデング熱ワクチンが承認
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の新規発生・アウトブレイクではなくワクチン承認に関する規制ニュースであり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常性を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン承認という医薬品規制ニュースであり、感染症の異常発生や流行を示すものではない。デング熱自体は既知の流行病であり、既存の対応枠内。

article.articleHeadline: On débattait depuis 200 ans de l'épidémie qui a décimé les Aborigènes en 1789 : une modélisation vient de trancher
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: For 200 years there has been debate about the epidemic that decimated the Aboriginal people in 1789: a modeling study has just settled the matter.
article.articleSummary: Smallpox decimated Aboriginal Australians in 1789, about a year after the First Fleet arrived in Botany Bay. A modeling study in Nature Human Behaviour argues the most probable origin is introduction by the British First Fleet in 1788, not from Indonesian fishermen from Makassar. The rival hypothesis questioned virus survival over the eight-month voyage; the solution lies in inoculation practices: British physicians carried vials of dried variola crusts, potentially re-supplied during calls at the Cape (South Africa) or Rio de Janeiro, keeping the pathogen viable. The epidemic spread across the continent, with initial impact around Botany Bay and Port Jackson (Sydney Cove). It is estimated to have caused about 220,000 deaths and accelerated the cultural decline of Aboriginal communities. The findings illustrate how mathematical modeling can illuminate historical questions about disease origins and the consequences of colonization.

triage.headline_ja: 1789年にアボリジニを激減させた疫病、200年来の論争にモデリング研究が終止符
triage.triage_reason: 1789年の歴史的な天然痘流行に関する歴史学的モデリング研究であり、現在進行中の公衆衛生イベントではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は1789年の歴史的な天然痘流行の起源に関する学術的モデリング研究の紹介であり、現在発生中の感染症イベントではない。対象国リストに含まれる国での現行イベントは存在しない。

article.articleHeadline: Mystery fever hits residential school, 35 girls fall sick in Dharwad
article.articleSummary: 35 girl students at Kasturba Gandhi Residential School in Alnavar, Dharwad district, fell ill on Saturday night with fever and leg pain. Some were initially treated at the Alnavar primary health centre before being shifted to the district hospital in Dharwad. Of the 35, 28 have been discharged and seven remain hospitalized. Blood samples have been collected from all affected students to identify the cause. Preliminary tests for dengue and chikungunya were negative, and officials are awaiting H1N1 test results. District health officer Dr. Parashuram FK said a detailed investigation is underway to determine the exact reason behind the illness. Health authorities are awaiting further results and a confirmed diagnosis as the cause remains unknown.

triage.headline_ja: 謎の発熱が寄宿学校を襲う、ダルワードで女子生徒35人が発病
triage.triage_reason: 寄宿学校で35名が発熱・下肢痛を発症する集団発生だが、デング熱・チクングニアは陰性でH1N1結果待ちのため原因不明。人-人感染拡大の可能性や重症度の詳細が不明なため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 原因病原体が未確定（デング・チクングニア陰性、H1N1結果待ち）。同校内での集団発生であり、地域内での拡大有無や重症度の続報を要確認。
