article.articleHeadline: India approves first dengue vaccine as cases surge in South Asia
article.articleSummary: India has approved Takeda's QDENGA dengue vaccine, the first in the country, by the CDSCO. The live-attenuated tetravalent vaccine protects against all four dengue serotypes and can be given regardless of prior infection. The approval comes amid a South Asia dengue surge, with Sri Lanka reporting 2,652 new cases on a Sunday, totaling 76,044 this year and at least 53 deaths; Bangladesh recording over 9,000 cases and 30 deaths amid a measles outbreak. Dengue is transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes and causes fever, severe muscle pain, and, in severe cases, shock or internal bleeding. Phase III data from over 20,000 participants across eight countries (including Sri Lanka) and 480 Indian volunteers showed safety and immunogenicity in adults and 4–60-year-olds. Post-marketing safety studies are required within six months. WHO pre-qualified; India aims to up to 50 million doses annually through Biological E, supporting a 100 million global target.

triage.headline_ja: 南アジアでデング熱の症例が急増する中、インドが初のデング熱ワクチンを承認
triage.triage_reason: 南アジア地域でデング熱の症例・死亡者数が急増しており、インドが対応としてワクチンを承認するなど社会的・政府的関心が高いため、フルRRAでの精査が望ましい。
triage.notes: 記事はインドでのデング熱ワクチン承認が主題。スリランカ・バングラデシュの症例・死亡者数データは文脈情報として引用されているが、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。インド国内の症例規模自体は記事中に明示されていない点に注意。

article.articleHeadline: Angka korban lepasi 900 orang, penularan Ebola meningkat di DR Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Death toll has surpassed 900 people as Ebola transmission increases in DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of 20 July 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached 2,344 confirmed cases and 930 deaths, with 724 patients in isolation or hospital care and 466 recoveries. The case fatality rate is about 39.7% and contact tracing coverage is 85.8%. The virus has affected five provinces: Haut-Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, and Tshopo, with Ituri remaining the main transmission hub. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain. Since its declaration on 15 May, community transmission has persisted. The Africa CDC notes frontline responders, health authorities, and partners are intensifying collaboration to curb spread. Officials express guarded optimism that, through coordinated measures, transmission curves may begin to decline within weeks to months.

triage.headline_ja: 死者数900人超え、コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ感染が拡大
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で確認例2,344件・死者930人に達し、5州に拡大しコミュニティ内感染が継続していることから、IHR基準の複数項目に該当し、フルRRAへの移行が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: 北キブ州（North Kivu）は対象国リストに含まれないが、コンゴ民主共和国自体が対象国のため国単位でDRCを列挙。致死率39.7%、Bundibugyoエボラウイルス株による大規模流行で、既に大規模な国際支援（Africa CDC等）が動員されている。

article.articleHeadline: Fox killed after latest local rabies scare
article.articleSummary: Mechanicville, NY — A fox suspected of biting a resident and charging others was killed by police Monday; the carcass was turned over to the state DEC for rabies testing. The animal had an unsteady gait and appeared aggressive. The bite victim, a woman on Elizabeth Street, was hospitalized. A separate incident on North Seventh Avenue saw the same fox charge at a man and his two children before it was captured. Rabies testing had not yet been completed, but officials expected swift results. The episode adds to ongoing rabies concerns in the Capital Region, with beavers suspected of rabies attacking bathers at Turtle Island, Lake George (July 9), a rabid horse near Fultonville, and a rabies-positive skunk on Swan Street, Amsterdam.

triage.headline_ja: 狂犬病騒動でキツネを駆除
triage.triage_reason: 米国ニューヨーク州における個別の野生動物咬傷事例であり、対象国リストに該当する国での発生ではなく、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威や社会的関心の高まりも認められない。

article.articleHeadline: 新一輪埃博拉疫情在剛果蔓延 多國跟進管制 | WHO | 剛果疫情 | 新冠疫情源頭
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A new round of Ebola outbreak spreading in the Democratic Republic of the Congo; several countries step up containment measures | WHO | Congo outbreak | Origin of the COVID-19 pandemic
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak spreading in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. As of July 19, 2026, the Congo’s National Public Health Institute reports 2,344 cases and 930 deaths, with about 485 recoveries; later figures through July 20 show 2,365 cases and 932 deaths (CFR ~39%). No effective vaccine is available yet. The outbreak has prompted border restrictions: the United States bans entry of citizens who visited the DRC in the prior 21 days on commercial flights; Canada imposes a 21-day entry ban for foreign nationals with recent DRC visits, effective July 20, with airlines barred from boarding such travelers. The DRC Ministry requires 21-day quarantine/observation for people from outbreak areas. Healthcare workers are affected (reported infections and fatalities), while aid efforts are hampered by public skepticism and violence, including attacks on treatment centers and blocked shipments of Ebola medications.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ出血熱の新たな流行が拡大、複数国が渡航制限を強化 | WHO | コンゴ疫情 | 新型コロナ起源
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ大規模流行（死亡者930人超、CFR約39%）に対し米国・カナダが入国制限を導入しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数項目に該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 米国・カナダは渡航制限措置を導入した国であり、感染発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外。ワクチンが未だ有効なものがないとの記述、暴力による対応妨害等、対応能力に懸念がある。

article.articleHeadline: Harish seeks probe into Banswada hospital infections | Hyderabad News
article.articleSummary: 10 women developed severe post-operative infections after Caesarean deliveries at Banswada Mother and Child Hospital on July 13; five patients are being treated at NIMS Hyderabad, with three in critical condition, after initial transfer from a government hospital in Nizamabad. Former minister T Harish Rao demanded a high-level inquiry into alleged lapses in the operation theatre, possible use of expired medicines, and continuing surgeries the day after infections were detected. He urged public disclosure of inquiry findings, identification and disciplinary action against responsible officials and doctors, and adequate ex gratia support for affected families who faced significant costs (one family around ₹3 lakh). The government should provide advanced care and publish findings. Key locations include Banswada, NIMS Hyderabad, Nizamabad, and Khammam.

triage.headline_ja: ハリシュ氏、バンスワダ病院の感染症事例について調査を要求 | ハイデラバードニュース
triage.triage_reason: 単一病院での帝王切開後の集団感染事例で複数患者が重症化しており、公衆衛生上の深刻性と異常性が認められ、政治的・社会的関心も高いため、詳細確認のためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 本事例は特定病院（Banswada Mother and Child Hospital）における帝王切開後の院内感染集団発生であり、感染症の国際的拡大リスクは低いが、医療管理の不備・重症例多数・政治的関心の高さからシグナルとして識別。原因病原体や感染経路の詳細は不明。

article.articleHeadline: Λ.Δ. Κονγκό: Δεκάδες υγειονομικοί μεταξύ των 930 ανθρώπων που έχουν πεθάνει από την επιδημία Έμπολα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Dozens of healthcare workers among the 930 people who have died from the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: 930 deaths among 2,344 confirmed Ebola cases in the eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, with 37 new deaths in the last 24 hours, according to the health ministry as of Saturday. Declared mid-May, the outbreak is the fastest-growing on record, driven by Bundibugyo virus; there is no approved vaccine or treatment for this strain. Transmission begins from wildlife to humans and spreads through contact with bodily fluids, contaminated surfaces, and items. Five eastern provinces are affected, with Ituri hardest hit amid security disruptions and attacks on health facilities; since May there have been at least 12 attacks. About 724 patients are hospitalized or in isolation; at least 36 healthcare workers have died after infection, and many staff have left due to delayed pay. WHO notes 80% of new cases arise from unknown transmission chains, indicating rapid spread and ongoing intensified response efforts.

triage.headline_ja: DRC:エボラ出血熱の流行で死亡した930人の中に数十人の医療従事者が含まれる
triage.triage_reason: 致死率が高く急速拡大するエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株、ワクチン・治療薬なし）がDRC東部で発生し、医療従事者の死亡や治安悪化を伴う異常事態であり、国際的拡大リスクも高いためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株による過去最速拡大の流行とされ、ワクチン・治療薬未承認、医療従事者への攻撃・給与未払いによる人員不足、80%が不明の感染経路など、極めて深刻な公衆衛生上の懸念事項が複数確認される。

article.articleHeadline: Prefeitura de Sinop reforça importância da testagem rápida para hepatites virais durante o Julho Amarelo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sinop City Hall reiterates the importance of rapid testing for viral hepatitis during Yellow July.
article.articleSummary: Sinop, Brazil — during the Yellow July campaign, the City Hall through the Health Secretariat reiterates the importance of free rapid testing for viral hepatitis (HBV and HCV), HIV, and syphilis at the Specialized Care Service (SAE). Tests use a finger-prick blood sample with results in minutes, enabling immediate guidance and linkage to care if positive. The SAE also provides follow-up and treatment for diagnosed viral hepatitis, HIV, and other sexually transmitted infections, plus family planning and a vaccination room open to the public. The initiative, a federal government effort since 2019, emphasizes that viral hepatitis often presents few symptoms early and can progress to cirrhosis or liver cancer without timely diagnosis. Transmission can occur via unprotected sex and sharing sharp instruments. The SAE is located at Avenida das Itaúbas, 2715, Setor Comercial, near the Sinop Regional Hospital.

triage.headline_ja: シノップ市役所、イエロージュライにおけるウイルス性肝炎の迅速検査の重要性を強調
triage.triage_reason: これは公衆衛生キャンペーン（検査促進）に関する広報記事であり、アウトブレイクや異常な感染症イベントの報告ではない。
triage.notes: 記事は既存の啓発・検査キャンペーンに関する内容であり、新規または異常な感染症イベントの発生を示すものではないため、対象国リストの該当国であってもverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Monsoon fuels rise in flu cases; Karnataka health department strengthens surveillance
article.articleSummary: Seasonal influenza in Karnataka, India, is rising with 2,056 laboratory-confirmed cases from January to the second week of July 2026. Monthly counts climbed from 242 in April to 383 in May and 414 in June, the year’s highest totals; by the second week of July, 324 cases had been recorded in July so far, versus 383 for all of July 2025, signaling a sharper monsoon build-up. Karnataka typically has two seasonal peaks—January–March and July–September—and officials attribute the spike to weather patterns. The Integrated Disease Surveillance Programme (IDSP) directs districts to strengthen surveillance, ensure sample collection and laboratory consumables, and maintain stocks of Oseltamivir, PPE, and N95 masks. Hospitals should keep ventilators ready, and public campaigns should emphasize cough etiquette, hand hygiene, mask use, and seeking early care. Minister UT Khader chaired the review; Ritvik Ranjanam Pandey commented on preparedness.

triage.headline_ja: モンスーンでインフルエンザ患者が増加、カルナタカ州保健当局が監視体制を強化
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの例年通りの季節的増加であり、重篤性や異常性は明確でないが、症例数増加と当局の監視強化対応が続報の注視対象となる。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザの例年の流行パターン内の増加であり、重症度や死亡者数についての具体的情報は記事に記載なし。カルナタカ州当局が監視・準備を強化している。

article.articleHeadline: Европа е изправена пред нарастваща заплаха от резистентна на лекарства гонорея
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Europe is facing an increasing threat from drug-resistant gonorrhea.
article.articleSummary: Europe faces increasing antibiotic-resistant gonorrhea (Neisseria gonorrhoeae) with expanding local transmission across several countries. ECDC reports rising cases since 2025, notably in France, Germany, Sweden, and the United Kingdom, while others show sporadic cases. An ECDC microbiology expert warns that local spread signals a potential escalation as resistance undermines treatments. Ceftriaxone remains the main therapy, sometimes with azithromycin, but strains increasingly resist both, risking reduced effectiveness. Imported cases remain a primary route for ceftriaxone-resistant strains, with global sources in Southeast Asia (Cambodia, Indonesia, Thailand, Vietnam). However, Europe also shows growing local transmission, underscoring early spread and the need for strict control. In 2023–2024, overall cases rose, with a 7.9% increase among men and an 8.6% decrease among women; 62% of 2024 cases involved men who have sex with men, 37% heterosexual transmission. Overall risk is low, but higher for those with multiple partners or travel to high-resistance regions.

triage.headline_ja: 欧州、薬剤耐性淋菌（性感染症）の増大する脅威に直面
triage.triage_reason: 欧州複数国（仏・独・瑞・英）で薬剤耐性淋菌の局所伝播が拡大しており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大の可能性がありIHR基準を2つ満たすため。ただし発生地は対象国（東南アジア）ではなく欧州が主体。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は欧州（フランス・ドイツ・スウェーデン・英国）での薬剤耐性淋菌の局所伝播拡大であり、カンボジア・インドネシア・タイ・ベトナムは輸入株の起源地として言及されているのみで、実際の発生地ではないため対象国としては除外した。

article.articleHeadline: രാജ്യത്ത് ആദ്യ ഡെങ്കിപ്പനി പ്രതിരോധ വാക്സിന് അംഗീകാരം | Deepika | The Largest Read Malayalam Internet Daily | Online News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First dengue vaccine approved in the country.
article.articleSummary: As of 20 July 2026, India’s Drugs Controller General approved Takeda's dengue vaccine Qdenga, the first dengue vaccine authorized in the country, for individuals aged 4 to 60 years. The vaccine is administered in two doses three months apart and can be given without prior dengue infection screening. It offers protection against all four dengue virus serotypes, and clinical trials reported an approximately 84% reduction in dengue-related hospitalizations. Dengue remains a major public health threat, with India accounting for about one-third of global dengue cases; official counts surpassed 113,000 last year, though true numbers are likely higher. Globally, more than 125 countries are affected, and Brazil and Argentina are among the 43+ countries using Qdenga. The approval is expected to be pivotal in India's dengue prevention efforts.

triage.headline_ja: インドで初のデング熱ワクチンが承認
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はデング熱ワクチンの承認に関する規制・公衆衛生政策ニュースであり、新規アウトブレイクや異常な感染拡大を報じるものではないため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン承認という制度的トピックが主題。ブラジル・アルゼンチンはQdenga採用国として言及されているのみで、当該国での発生イベントではないため verified_locations から除外。デング熱自体はインドで既知の公衆衛生課題であり新規性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: ECDC waarschuwt voor opmars van antibioticaresistente gonorroe in Europa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: ECDC warns of the rise of antibiotic-resistant gonorrhoea in Europe.
article.articleSummary: Gonorrhea antibiotic resistance is rising across Europe with clear community transmission in the United Kingdom, Sweden, Germany and France, and ongoing cases elsewhere. In 2024 Europe recorded 106,331 confirmed infections—an all-time high since monitoring began in 2009; globally, about 82 million people aged 15–49 are infected annually. While many resistant strains originate in Southeast Asia (Vietnam, Thailand, Indonesia, Cambodia), Europe is witnessing increasing domestic spread. Ceftriaxone, alone or with azithromycin, is losing effectiveness, driving transmission. Demographics show 62% of cases among men who have sex with men; the highest incidence occurs in women aged 20–24 and men aged 25–34; 37% occur in heterosexuals. The overall risk to the general sexually active population is low, but risk rises for those with multiple partners or unprotected sex with new partners, and for travelers to high-resistance regions.

triage.headline_ja: ECDC、欧州における抗生物質耐性淋菌の拡大を警告
triage.triage_reason: 抗生物質耐性淋菌の感染が欧州で過去最高を記録し、複数国で地域内伝播が確認されており、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大）に複数該当するためフルRRAへの移行が適切。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は欧州（英国・スウェーデン・ドイツ・フランス）における薬剤耐性淋菌の国内伝播拡大であり、東南アジア諸国（ベトナム・タイ・インドネシア・カンボジア）は耐性株の起源地として言及されているのみで、当該国での発生事例としては主題化されていないため、verified_locationsには含めなかった。

article.articleHeadline: 930 People Dead In Congo's Ebola Outbreak!
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo's Ebola outbreak, declared May 15 in eastern Congo, has become the fastest-growing on record, with 2,344 confirmed cases and 930 deaths reported as of July 20, 2026. In the latest 24-hour period, 37 deaths were recorded (Fri–Sat). The Bundibugyo strain, a less common form, currently has no approved vaccine or treatment. The World Health Organization warned that about 80% of new cases come from unknown transmission chains, signaling rapid, hard-to-trace spread despite expanding responses. Ebola transmits through contact with bodily fluids and contaminated materials, and while rare, is severe and often fatal. Neighboring Uganda and Zambia have tightened border screening and surveillance to curb cross-border transmission. The outbreak is ongoing, with continued transmission across eastern Congo.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行で930人死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当する重大なエボラ流行（史上最速の拡大、930人死亡、承認ワクチン・治療法なし、隣国での国境対策強化）であり、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ザンビアは国境検疫強化の対応国として言及されているが、実際の感染発生地ではないためverified_locationsから除外。Bundibugyo株は承認ワクチン・治療法がなく、80%の新規感染が感染経路不明という点で流行制御の困難さが顕著。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola death toll in Congo rises to at least 930, including dozens of health workers
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo has risen to at least 930 deaths from 2,344 confirmed cases, according to the Congo Ministry of Health as of Saturday, with 37 new deaths in 24 hours. The Bundibugyo virus is responsible, and there is no approved vaccine or treatment. Ituri remains the worst-affected province, part of a five-province eastern outbreak where rebel violence and safety fears have hampered response. Attacks on health facilities and teams have been recorded (at least 12), and many health workers have stopped work; 36 health workers have died. The World Health Organization warns that about 80% of new cases come from unknown transmission chains, indicating rapid spread. In two months, the outbreak has averaged about 272 new cases and 111 deaths per week. The ministry reports 724 patients in isolation or hospital, with 22 recoveries in the last 24 hours and intensified response efforts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ死者数、医療従事者数十人を含み少なくとも930人に増加
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ東部で承認されたワクチン・治療法のないブンディブギョウイルスによるエボラ流行が拡大し、死者930人・感染2,344人に達し、80%が不明の感染経路であることから急速な拡大と公衆衛生への深刻な影響が確認される。
triage.notes: 反政府勢力による暴力と医療施設への攻撃が対応を妨げており、WHOは新規感染の80%が感染経路不明であることを指摘。ワクチン・治療法未承認のブンディブギョウイルスによる流行で、国際的な支援と警戒が必要。

article.articleHeadline: देश को मिली पहली डेंगू वैक्सीन 'क्यूडेंगा', सीडीएससीओ ने दी मंजूरी
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: India's first dengue vaccine 'Qdenga' approved by CDSCO.
article.articleSummary: India's drug regulator CDSCO approved Takeda's dengue vaccine Qdenga for use in India, marking the country's first dengue vaccine approval. The vaccine is eligible for individuals aged 4 to 60 years and does not require prior dengue infection testing before vaccination. Qdenga targets protection against the four dengue virus serotypes (DENV-1 to DENV-4). In clinical trials, efficacy against laboratory-confirmed dengue after the second dose given one year apart was around 80%, with a substantially reduced risk of hospitalization for severe dengue. Experts say the approval strengthens dengue prevention in India, though vector control, sanitation, and elimination of standing water remain crucial. Developed by Takeda in Japan, the vaccine's India rollout follows CDSCO clearance, with the policy to integrate vaccination into broader dengue control strategies.

triage.headline_ja: インドで初のデング熱ワクチン『Qdenga』がCDSCOの承認を取得
triage.triage_reason: これはワクチン承認に関する規制ニュースであり、感染症の発生や流行を示す内容ではないため、シグナルとしての該当性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱の発生報告ではなく、ワクチン承認に関する報道。日本はワクチン開発元（武田薬品）としての言及のみで発生地域ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Vacimóvel aplica doses contra gripe e sarampo no Zoológico de Guarulhos, nesta semana
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vaccination van administers doses against influenza and measles at Guarulhos Zoo this week.
article.articleSummary: Guarulhos Municipal Zoo hosts a Vacimóvel mobile vaccination unit offering influenza and measles vaccines from Tuesday, July 21 to Friday, July 24, 2026, operating 9:00–16:00 local time. The service, run by the Municipal Health Secretariat, aims to improve preventive coverage by bringing immunization to a high-traffic location. Eligible attendees must present photo identification; bring their vaccination record if available to verify and update doses. This preventive campaign is part of ongoing municipal health measures to maintain up-to-date vaccination coverage. No disease outbreak or case counts are reported in connection with this event. The effort focuses on vaccination rather than treatment, and there is no laboratory confirmation involved. The Guarulhos Zoo serves as the venue to facilitate access for residents and visitors, with emphasis on influenza and measles protection.

triage.headline_ja: グアルーリョス動物園でインフルエンザと麻疹の予防接種を実施する移動ワクチンバス、今週稼働
triage.triage_reason: 予防接種キャンペーンの案内記事であり、実際の感染症発生や症例報告は含まれていないため、シグナルとしての該当性はない。
triage.notes: 記事は感染症発生ではなく、地方自治体による通常の予防接種キャンペーン（インフルエンザ・麻疹）の告知である。

article.articleHeadline: Karnataka minister asks districts to boost monsoon disease surveillance, preparedness
article.articleSummary: Karnataka Health Minister U T Khader has directed all 31 districts to remain on high alert during the monsoon, stepping up surveillance and preparedness against viral fevers and communicable diseases. In a virtual review, districts reported on disease activity, surveillance, medicines, logistics, lab readiness, and vector control. The State Surveillance Unit updated on Covid-19 and other communicable diseases, including influenza, SARI, dengue, malaria, chikungunya, Japanese encephalitis, and cholera. The minister ordered intensified Integrated Disease Surveillance Programme activities, timely reporting through the Integrated Health Information Platform, strengthened Rapid Response Teams, and expanded public awareness, hygiene, safe drinking water, and early healthcare-seeking behavior. Key actions include house-to-house larval surveys, mosquito-source reduction at construction sites, and testing all influenza-like illness and SARI cases. Officials were urged to coordinate with Rural Development, Panchayat Raj, Urban Local Bodies, and Labour Departments; the State Health Emergency Operations Centre will receive regular situation reports.

triage.headline_ja: カルナタカ州保健大臣、モンスーン期の感染症サーベイランス・体制強化を各地区に指示
triage.triage_reason: 特定のアウトブレイクではなく、季節性の予防的サーベイランス強化に関する行政発表であり、異常性・深刻性を示す具体的データがない。
triage.notes: 記事はモンスーン期における予防的な行政指示であり、具体的な症例数や異常な流行の報告はない。定期的な公衆衛生対策の一環と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : la riposte positive en Ouganda redonne espoir aux commerçants de Kasindi - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Uganda's positive response restores hope for Kasindi traders - ACP.
article.articleSummary: As of 20 July 2026, Ebola outbreak in Uganda drives cautious optimism for cross-border trade between Kasindi, Nord-Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, and Mpondwe, Uganda, as Uganda's epidemiological situation shows signs of improvement. Traders told ACP on Monday that activity could restart across the Kasindi–Mpondwe frontier, previously closed, sharply constraining commerce. Fabrice Nzanzu Ndavo, head of the Comesa cross-border trade information desk at Kasindi, cited improving epidemiology in neighboring Uganda as a key factor for resuming cross-border commerce. Since the frontier closure, staple foods such as bananas and tomatoes failed to reach markets, worsening living standards on both sides. Prices at Kasindi surged. Traders had faced uncertainty until Uganda reported the last confirmed Ebola case and subsequent suspected cases, reviving hope for reopening. Kasindi and Mpondwe economies rely predominantly on cross-border trade.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：ウガンダでの前向きな対応がカシンディの商人たちに希望を与える - ACP
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダのエボラ流行状況改善に伴う国境貿易再開への期待を報じる続報記事であり、新規の感染症学的情報や急激な悪化は見られないが、エボラという重篤な疾患であるため継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はウガンダでのエボラ流行改善に伴うDRC・ウガンダ国境（カシンディ・ムポンドウェ）の貿易再開への期待であり、DRC側は経済的影響を受ける当事国として言及されている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。新規感染拡大の報告ではなく、既存流行の経過報告的な内容。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : le Canada ferme ses frontières aux voyageurs en provenance de la RDC - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Canada closes its borders to travelers arriving from the DRC - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo triggers a tightening of Canada's border controls. From July 20, 2026 at 11:59 p.m. Eastern Time, foreign nationals who have spent time in the Democratic Republic of the Congo within the preceding 21 days will be refused entry to Canada. Airlines and other carriers are prohibited from allowing boarding of these travelers to Canada. Ottawa's new measures tighten the approach compared with late May, when the Public Health Agency of Canada had imposed a 21-day mandatory quarantine and a temporary suspension of visa processing for travelers from the DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan. The report does not include case counts, symptoms, or laboratory confirmation details. Dateline: Kinshasa; disease: Ebola virus disease; location: Democratic Republic of the Congo; context: ongoing outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：カナダがコンゴ民主共和国からの渡航者に対し国境を閉鎖
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱流行を受け、カナダが渡航制限措置を実施しており、IHR基準（重大性・異常性・国際拡大リスク・渡航制限）を複数満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はカナダの渡航制限措置が主題だが、感染症イベントの発生地はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）。ウガンダ・南スーダンは過去の措置の文脈で言及されているのみで、今回の発生地ではないため対象国リストからも除外（元々対象国リストにも含まれない）。症例数・症状・検査確定情報は記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Ituri : construction d'un centre de traitement Ebola de 80 lits à Kasenyi - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri: construction of an 80-bed Ebola treatment center in Kasenyi - ACP
article.articleSummary: 80-bed Ebola Treatment Center is under construction in Kasenyi, Ituri, in the Tchomia health zone of the Democratic Republic of Congo, with support from a Ugandan partner. Suspected Ebola cases in this lake-adjacent area are first admitted to a transitional treatment center at Tchomia General Referral Hospital; confirmed cases are transferred to the Ebola Treatment Center in Bunia for specialized care. The new facility aims to bring treatment closer to populations around Lake Albert and reduce delays in care. Dr. Hervé Bavi, health zone medical chief, said construction could begin operating as early as Monday pending provincial and national authorization. The effort reinforces ongoing Ebola surveillance and response in collaboration with national authorities and technical partners; no case counts are provided in the report.

triage.headline_ja: イツリ州:カセニーに80床のエボラ治療センターを建設 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イツリ州で進行中のエボラ対応において新たな治療センターが建設されており、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響とヒト-ヒト感染のリスクを伴う疾患であるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAustralia（Lake Albert, New South Wales）が含まれるが、これはBluedotの地理情報付与の誤り（同名の地名混同）と考えられ、記事の主題はDRCイツリ州のエボラ対応に限定される。感染者数などの具体的な症例数は記事中に記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : plus de 2.400 cas confirmés d'Ebola enregistrés en moins de trois mois - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: More than 2,400 confirmed Ebola cases recorded in less than three months - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease has been confirmed in over 2,400 cases across five provinces in the Democratic Republic of the Congo within under three months, according to WHO data cited by ACP on 20 July 2026. The outbreak is most active in Ituri, with transmission centers in the health zones of Bunia, Rwampara, Mongbwalu, and Nizi; Nord-Kivu ranks second in cases, followed by Haut-Uele, Tshopo, and South Kivu, where the situation remains under control. WHO calls for intensified community engagement and adherence to prevention measures to interrupt transmission. The disease is curable when detected early and treated in specialized facilities; hundreds of patients have survived due to rapid care. The report underscores ongoing transmission dynamics and the need for sustained response to curb the epidemic.

triage.headline_ja: DRC:3ヶ月足らずでエボラ確定例が2,400人を超える - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRC5州にわたり2,400人超のエボラ確定例が3ヶ月未満で発生しており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクがあり、WHOも対応強化を呼びかけているためフルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: ルワンダは発生地域リストに含まれるが、記事本文はDRC国内(Ituri, Nord-Kivu, Haut-Uele, Tshopo, South Kivu)での流行を主題としており、ルワンダでの発生は記載されていないため対象国リストにはないが除外(そもそも対象国リストにルワンダは含まれない)。WHOデータに基づく大規模流行であり、致死性・地理的拡大の両面で継続的な監視とフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Walikale : les soignants réclament l'aménagement des sources d'eau face à la montée des maladies hydriques à Mutakato
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Walikale: health workers demand improvements to water sources as waterborne diseases rise in Mutakato.
article.articleSummary: Mutakato health area in Walikale, North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, faces persistent drinking-water shortages as residents rely on unregulated sources. Since July, the Mutakato health centre has treated 30 cases of waterborne diseases, with diarrhoea and typhoid fever among the most common presentations, along with other related illnesses. Health worker Akilimali Mubangu warns unsafe water poses a continual public health threat and can spark rapid outbreaks without preventive action. He calls on authorities and humanitarian partners to invest in water-source development and potable-water infrastructure to protect the population and prevent epidemics such as cholera, diarrhoea, and typhoid fever. Residents hope for a swift response to reduce health risks and sustainably improve living conditions.

triage.headline_ja: ワリカレ：ムタカトで水系感染症が増加する中、医療従事者が水源整備を求める
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国の一地域で水系感染症（チフス・下痢）が発生し今後コレラ等の流行リスクが指摘されているが、現時点で症例数は小規模（30例）で深刻度・拡大の情報が不足しているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は水源不足を主因とする水系感染症の増加を報じており、コレラの確定発生は報告されていない。今後の症例増加やコレラ確認の続報に注意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola: alerta en los países vecinos de RD del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Alert in the neighboring countries of the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-07-20, Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) are spreading to neighboring Uganda, Rwanda, and Zambia. The DRC reports at least 930 deaths and 2,344 cases of the Bundibugyo variant since the outbreak was declared on May 15, with the WHO warning that real case numbers could be up to four times higher. Uganda has strengthened border surveillance through Kisoro, Kanungu and Rukungiri districts, with Kabale hospital noting elevated risk on western borders. Rwanda has tightened border controls, expanded surveillance, and activated rapid-response teams. Zambia reports no confirmed cases but has enhanced entry screening, infection prevention measures, and provincial health emergency centers. The East African Community, Africa CDC, and WHO coordinate enhanced cross-border preparedness, diagnostics, and surveillance. Tedros calls the outbreak the third largest on record; there is no vaccine for Bundibugyo. A funding gap exceeds $400 million.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：コンゴ民主共和国の周辺国で警戒
triage.triage_reason: DRCで930人死亡、2344例のBundibugyo型エボラ流行が確認され、複数の隣国へ拡大の兆候があり、WHOが史上3番目に大きい流行と警告している。ワクチンがなく資金不足も深刻で、国際的関心・支援ニーズが高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ルワンダ・ザンビアは国境警戒強化を実施しているが、確定患者は報告されていない（特にザンビアは確定例なしと明記）。対象国リストに含まれるウガンダ・ルワンダは非対象国のため除外。ザンビアは確定例なしのため実際の発生国とは判断せず除外。

article.articleHeadline: Nord-Kivu : neuf nouveaux cas déclarés positifs à Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: North Kivu: nine new cases test positive for Ebola - ACP
article.articleSummary: North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo — Nine new Ebola virus disease cases were reported in Nord-Kivu on July 19 (data released July 20, 2026). Six cases were in the Katwa health zone; one death in Butembo; one in Musienene; and one in Oicha. The cumulative laboratory-confirmed cases reach 238 across 11 health zones, with 153 deaths among confirmed cases (case fatality rate 64.3%). Active contacts total 3,042, with 2,202 contacts currently being followed. As of July 17, 213 cases were confirmed positive in Nord-Kivu, with 142 deaths among the cumulative confirmed cases. This confirms an ongoing Ebola outbreak in Nord-Kivu with continued case growth and a high fatality rate.

triage.headline_ja: 北キブ州:エボラ新規陽性者9人 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の継続的なアウトブレイクで新規9例確認、致死率64.3%と高く、複数の保健地区に拡大しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 累計238例確認、153死亡（CFR 64.3%）、11の保健地区に拡大、接触者3,042人中2,202人を追跡中。継続的な感染拡大が確認されており、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: COVID-19's 2021 variant raises fresh concerns in 2026; four deaths reported across states | DNA Explained
article.articleSummary: COVID-19's 2021 variant raises fresh concerns in 2026, with four deaths reported across states. The article notes renewed attention to this lineage as health monitoring continues, though it provides no state-by-state breakdown or clinical details within the summary. Dated July 20, 2026, the report is attributed to DNA Explained and Zee Media Bureau, describing a newsroom model that collaborates across television, digital, and social platforms to deliver timely, verified breaking health news. The piece emphasizes ongoing public health relevance of an earlier SARS-CoV-2 variant but offers no specifics on symptoms, laboratory confirmation, infection sources, or imported/exported cases. In short, the key takeaway is that a 2021 COVID-19 variant remains a concern in 2026, with four deaths reported across states as of the publication date.

triage.headline_ja: 2021年のCOVID-19変異株が2026年に再び懸念を招く、複数州で4人死亡 | DNA Explained
triage.triage_reason: インド国内で2021年型変異株による死亡例が報告されているが、州別内訳や臨床詳細、変異株の具体的性質が不明であり、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事は既知の2021年型変異株の再燃という異例性を報じているが、具体的な症例情報や検査確認、感染源に関する記載がなく詳細不明。続報での情報更新を待つ必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Mumbai Dengue Alert: BMC Urges Residents To Prevent Mosquito Breeding As Cases Rise 27.8%; Know Symptoms, Precautions And Treatment
article.articleSummary: Mumbai dengue alert: Dengue cases in Mumbai rose 27.8% in six-and-a-half months of 2026, with 938 cases reported till mid-July. The Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) urges residents to prevent water stagnation to curb Aedes mosquito breeding and reduce dengue risk. Key symptoms of dengue appear 4-10 days after a bite and include high fever, severe headache, pain behind the eyes, muscle and joint pain, nausea/vomiting, rash, and extreme fatigue. Warning signs necessitating immediate care include severe abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, nose or gum bleeding, blood in vomit or stool, breathing difficulty, or drowsiness/restlessness. Precautions: use repellents, wear long sleeves, install nets/screens, and eliminate standing water in coolers, pots, tyres, and other containers. Dengue mosquitoes breed in stagnant clean water. Dr Honey Savla notes dengue can worsen if warning signs are ignored; avoid NSAIDs like ibuprofen. Treatment is supportive: hydration, rest, paracetamol per doctor advice; most recover, some require hospitalization.

triage.headline_ja: ムンバイ・デング熱警報：BMCが住民に蚊の発生防止を要請、症例27.8%増加、症状・予防・治療について解説
triage.triage_reason: 毎年季節性に見られるデング熱の症例増加報告であり、地域衛生当局による通常の注意喚起の範囲内。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは見られないが、症例増加傾向は継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: ムンバイ市内でのデング熱症例増加(27.8%増)は季節性の感染症としての通常対応で、BMCが自主的に予防策を発表している。重症度や死亡者数など詳細情報は記事に含まれておらず不明。

article.articleHeadline: Avance del ébola alarma a países vecinos de la República Democrática del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Spread of Ebola alarms neighboring countries of the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of 20 July 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 2,344 Ebola cases and at least 930 deaths from the Bundibugyo variant, with the outbreak officially declared on 15 May. The World Health Organization warns the true case count could be up to four times higher due to under-detection in conflict-affected eastern DRC. The epicenter is in the east, including Ituri, and authorities fear cross-border spread. Zambia reports no confirmed cases but tightens border controls, infection prevention, hand hygiene, and rapid-response planning. Uganda reinforces border surveillance, identifying Kisoro, Kanungu, and Rukungiri as high-risk districts. Rwanda also intensifies border health checks and rapid-response capacity. The East African Community, Africa CDC, and WHO coordinate to strengthen surveillance, laboratory diagnostics, risk communication, and emergency response, while calling for over $400 million in funding for the joint preparedness and response plan. No vaccine is available for Bundibugyo.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ拡大、近隣国に警戒感
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部でエボラ（ブンディブジョ株）が2,344例・930人死亡と大規模拡大しており、近隣国への越境拡大懸念とワクチン未存在という重大なリスクがあり、国際支援要請も出ているためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ザンビアは国境管理強化等の予防対応を行っているが確定例なしと明記されているため、実発生国としては含めていない。ウガンダ・ルワンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: In het Congolese Beni verrijst uit het niets een ebola-behandelcentrum: 'Er is veel argwaan en misinformatie, net als tijdens Covid'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the Congolese Beni, an Ebola treatment center springs up from nowhere: 'There is a lot of suspicion and misinformation, just like during COVID'
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Beni, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, driven by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus variant. Doctors Without Borders (MSF) via Artsen zonder Grenzen is rapidly building a second Ebola treatment center in Beni, supplementing an existing hospital with about 20 Ebola beds. The new facility, slated to open July 27, will include 32 individual rooms and enhanced isolation features, including private windows and a wall with tactical holes to pass supplies, under a stringent no-touch infection-control regime. As of May, Congo reported over 2,200 confirmed Ebola infections and about 890 deaths nationwide; in the Beni area, around 35 positive cases have been noted, far fewer than in the north where hundreds have occurred. Beni has roughly 250,000 registered residents (potentially up to 400,000). Public messaging emphasizes handwashing, avoidance of bushmeat, and vaccination questions—no vaccine yet for this variant. Widespread mistrust and misinformation persist, which MSF aims to counter through outreach and community engagement.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ・ベニ市に突如出現したエボラ治療センター:「COVID流行時と同様、多くの疑念とデマがある」
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で2,200例超・死亡890例に達するエボラ流行（ブンディブギョ株）が継続中で、国際的な緊急支援（MSF）による治療センター新設が行われており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際支援の必要性が明確に認められる。
triage.notes: 対象株（ブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス）には現在ワクチンがなく、地域住民の不信・誤情報が対応を難化させている点に留意。国際的拡大リスクと渡航・貿易制限の有無は記事内で明示されていないため不明と評価。

article.articleHeadline: ಕಾಂಗೋ : ಎಬೋಲಾ ರೋಗಕ್ಕೆ ಕನಿಷ್ಠ 930 ಜನರು ಮೃತ್ಯು | At least 930 people have died in Congo's Ebola outbreak
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo: At least 930 people have died from Ebola disease.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak reported in Bunia, Congo. As of July 20, 2026, at least 930 people have died among 2,344 laboratory-confirmed cases. In the last 24 hours, 37 new deaths were recorded, one of the highest daily tolls. At least 36 health workers have died from Ebola infection. About 724 patients remain in isolation or hospitalized as authorities intensify containment, treatment, and response efforts in affected areas. The Health Ministry provided the update, noting confirmed cases and deaths but offering no details on laboratory methods, infection sources, or imported/exported cases. The report underscores ongoing transmission within Congo and the need for intensified public health interventions. Keywords: Ebola, outbreak, Congo, Bunia, public health response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ：エボラ出血熱で少なくとも930人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: コンゴでエボラ出血熱の大規模流行が継続し、死者930人・確認例2,344例・医療従事者36人死亡と重篤な公衆衛生上の影響があり、国際的拡大リスクも否定できないためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 医療従事者への感染・死亡が多数発生しており、院内感染対策の脆弱性が示唆される。続報でWHOの国際対応状況や国境地域への拡大有無を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Haití, basura espacial, ébola, Mundial y México... Las noticias del lunes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Haiti, space junk, Ebola, World Cup, and Mexico... Monday's news.
article.articleSummary: Haiti: UN Security Council briefed that gangs now seek to control state institutions and key economic routes, threatening governance and security beyond Port-au-Prince; UNODC head Monica Juma urged dismantling financing sources and strengthening investigations to allow elections and credible voter registration amid ongoing instability after the 2021 assassination of President Moïse. Space debris: UN reports about 140 million fragments over 1 mm orbit Earth, with risks to satellites and future missions as launches expand; debris may affect atmospheric chemistry, cloud formation, and ozone, prompting calls to cut waste, prevent in-orbit explosions, and safely retire defunct hardware. Ebola in DRC: confirmed cases in at least 16 displacement camps housing over 270,000 people, worsening access and living conditions; funding needs for 2026 increased from $1.4B to $2.3B to assist 10.7 million people. Mexico: UN human-rights experts allege intimidation and restrictions on families of disappeared during the World Cup.

triage.headline_ja: ハイチ、スペースデブリ、エボラ、ワールドカップ、そしてメキシコ…月曜のニュース
triage.triage_reason: DRCで避難民キャンプ16か所以上・27万人超に影響するエボラ確認例が続き、2026年の資金需要が1.4億ドルから2.3億ドルへ増額されるなど、深刻な公衆衛生上の懸念と国際支援の必要性が示されている。
triage.notes: 記事は複数トピックを含むUN速報まとめであり、エボラに関する記述はDRCの避難民キャンプでの拡大と資金需要増加が中心。ハイチ・メキシコは対象国リスト外のため除外。続報や詳細な感染者数・地域データを要確認。

article.articleHeadline: SA requires DRC travellers to fill in questionnaire, as Ebola cases increase - Earthnews365
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak prompts South Africa to screen travellers from Uganda and the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). The Department of Health, announcing on Monday, requires travellers entering SA to complete a health questionnaire due to rising Ebola activity. Globally, the outbreak has reached about 2,344 confirmed cases and roughly 930 deaths, with most infections in the DRC and about 20 cases reported in Uganda. Uganda discharged its last patient on July 16 and has begun a 42-day countdown to being Ebola-free. The World Health Organization says the virus remains active in 38 health zones across five DRC provinces: Ituri (27/36 zones), North Kivu (11/34), South Kivu (1/34), Haut-Uele (4/13), and Tshopo (3/23). The CDC and others have raised alarms that the outbreak surpassed 1,000 confirmed cases within 40 days of response activation.

triage.headline_ja: 南アフリカ、エボラ感染増加に伴いDRCからの渡航者に質問票記入を義務化
triage.triage_reason: DRCで大規模エボラ出血熱の流行が継続し（確定2,344例、死亡約930例）、ウガンダへの国際的拡大や南アフリカの渡航制限措置が発生しており、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当する明確なシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCで継続中のエボラ流行と、ウガンダへの拡大、南アフリカによる渡航者への健康質問票義務化を報じている。ウガンダと南アフリカは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを記載した。CDC・WHOも警戒を強めており、国際的な監視・支援体制が敷かれている状況。

article.articleHeadline: Soutien à la riposte Ebola: la RDC, le Soudan du Sud et l'Ouganda bénéficient d'un don de 13 millions USD de la BAD
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Support for the Ebola response: the DRC, South Sudan and Uganda receive a US$13 million grant from the African Development Bank.
article.articleSummary: US$13 million from the African Development Bank supports Ebola virus disease response in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), South Sudan, and Uganda. Of the total, US$10 million—reprogrammed from the DRC portfolio—will be deployed through the World Health Organization, while US$3 million from a Multi-Country Emergency Aid Project will be implemented by Africa CDC. The DRC will receive US$11 million in total (US$10 million from its portfolio plus US$1 million from the regional project); Uganda and South Sudan will each receive US$1 million from the regional project. The funding, part of the Ebola outbreak response plan, aims to interrupt transmission and reduce mortality and morbidity by strengthening early diagnosis, epidemiological surveillance, community engagement, risk communication, and regional coordination, in close collaboration with national health ministries. Mohamed Cherif, Deputy General Manager for Africa Central and head of the DRC country office, emphasized the Bank’s commitment to crisis response. On May 15, 2026, the DRC announced a new Ebola outbreak centered in Ituri (Bunia, Rwampara, Mongbalu), the 17th EVD outbreak, with spread to North Kivu and South Kivu.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ対応への支援：DRC、南スーダン、ウガンダがアフリカ開発銀行から1300万米ドルの助成金を受領
triage.triage_reason: DRCで発生中の第17次エボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（イトゥリ州発、北キブ・南キブ州へ拡大）に関する国際支援であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と地域拡大リスクがIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事は資金援助に関する報道だが、背景として2026年5月にDRCイトゥリ州で発生した第17次エボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが北キブ・南キブ州へ拡大していることが示されている。ウガンダ・南スーダン・ルワンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: 민주콩고 '에볼라 사망 930명' 이르러
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 930 Ebola deaths.
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak has reached 930 deaths with over 2,300 laboratory-confirmed cases; more than 700 patients remain in isolation and 466 have recovered. The rapid spread is attributed to a rare Ebola variant with no approved vaccine. As of 2026-07-20, Canada imposes entry restrictions on foreign nationals who have visited the Democratic Republic of the Congo within the prior 21 days, while Canadian citizens and permanent residents are allowed entry and will undergo health screening. The Public Health Agency of Canada says the measures aim to reduce public health risk and ensure safe processing of travelers and humanitarian workers. A similar restriction has been recently adopted by the United States for Americans who visited DRC within 21 days.

triage.headline_ja: 民主コンゴ、エボラ死者930人に達する
triage.triage_reason: DRCで死者930人・確定例2300人超という深刻なエボラ流行が継続し、稀な変異株でワクチン未承認、米国・カナダが渡航制限を導入するなど国際的関心・対応が生じているため、フルRRAへ進むべきシグナル。
triage.notes: 米国・カナダは渡航制限を導入した国であり、発生地域ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: सितंबर-अक्टूबर तक पशुओं में फैल सकती है ये बीमारी, बिहार के किसान अभी कर लें ये उपाय
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: This disease could spread among animals by September-October; farmers in Bihar should now take these measures.
article.articleSummary: Lumpy Skin Disease (LSD), an infectious viral disease of cattle and buffalo, poses increasing risk in Bihar, India. Begusarai’s Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) reports that September–October could see widespread LSD transmission, with rural areas sometimes calling the condition ‘Mata Maiya.’ Based on analysis by ICAR’s Disease Surveillance System and Local18, environmental conditions such as temperature, humidity, and rainfall may favor LSD spread in several districts of Bihar. Clinically, LSD causes nodules and vesicles on the skin, fever, weakness, reduced milk yield, and reduced appetite; severe cases can lead to the death of affected animals. In response, the Bihar state government is conducting vaccination campaigns, urging all eligible cattle and buffalo to be vaccinated. Farmers are advised to isolate sick animals and seek prompt veterinary help at government clinics or contact SDM/DM if services are unavailable locally.

triage.headline_ja: この病気は9月から10月にかけて家畜に広がる可能性がある、ビハール州の農家は今すぐ対策を
triage.triage_reason: 家畜の感染症（ランピースキン病）であり動物疫病の予防的注意喚起記事。人への健康影響はなく、公衆衛生上の緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: ランピースキン病は牛・水牛のみに感染するウイルス性疾患で人獣共通感染症ではない。ビハール州政府はワクチン接種を推進中で、予防的な農業情報記事。

article.articleHeadline: Zeven Amerikanen zitten in quarantaine in omstreden ebolacentrum in Kenia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Seven Americans are in quarantine at a controversial Ebola center in Kenya.
article.articleSummary: Seven Americans who fought the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo are in quarantine at a new U.S. Ebola center in Laikipia, central Kenya, despite a Kenyan court order to halt construction. The center, designed for 50 beds to quarantine returnees for three weeks, houses the seven in large military tents with field beds and U.S. military-provided meals. Kenyan protests over the project led to three deaths; lawmakers warned the health system is unprepared for Ebola. Health Minister Aden Duale apologized and said work had stopped, though satellite imagery suggested otherwise. President William Ruto defended the deal as a mutual agreement tied to a $2.5 billion health pact with the United States, part of a broader policy linking aid to reciprocity. In Congo, the Bundibugyo Ebola variant has killed at least 930 people since mid-May, the fastest-growing outbreak on record.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアの物議を呼ぶエボラ隔離センターに米国人7人が隔離中
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国のブンディブギョ・エボラ変異株による流行が5月中旬以降930人以上の死者を出し、記録上最速の拡大速度とされる深刻な公衆衛生事象であり、国際的な対応（米国による隔離センター設置、ケニアでの政治的混乱）も発生しているためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はケニアにおける米国主導の隔離センターの政治的混乱だが、根本原因であるDRCのエボラ流行（ブンディブギョ変異株、930人以上死亡、記録上最速拡大）が対象国リストに含まれるため、DRCのみをverified_locationsに含めた。ケニア・米国は対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: KUGA BUKTI, A CENA MESA TINJA: Traje bitka protiv opasne zaraze svinja
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hog cholera rages, and the price of meat is rising: The battle against the dangerous swine disease continues.
article.articleSummary: African swine fever (ASF) remains active in Serbia, with emergency status declared in Ruma, Obrenovac, and Sremska Mitrovica since Friday, expanding to Šabac; Sremski and Mačva districts are most affected. In the last week the number of pigs killed or euthanized exceeds 28,000, raising concerns about pork supply and prices, though experts say supply should remain stable due to existing long-term import contracts; processors source pork from farms and imports. Pork prices at live-weight markets vary, about 250–350 dinars per kilogram. Serbia continues production and relies on imports for processing, so shortages are unlikely though price volatility may occur. Minister Dragan Glamočić visited Obrenovac and noted lapses by local authorities; emergency measures remain in 11 infected areas across seven districts. China, Lithuania, Estonia, Denmark, Czechia, Poland, Spain, and Croatia have ASF experience.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ豚熱が拡大、豚肉価格も上昇：危険な豚の伝染病との戦いが続く
triage.triage_reason: セルビアにおける動物疾病（ASF）のみに関する情報であり、対象国（人的健康影響を含む）での発生は確認されていないため見送りとする。
triage.notes: 本イベントはブタのアフリカ豚熱（ASF）に関するもので、ヒトの健康への直接的影響はない。発生国はセルビアであり、対象国リストに含まれない。中国等は「ASF経験国」として言及されているのみで、現在の発生地ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-uitbraak in Congo eist meer dan 900 levens terwijl besmettingen blijven oplopen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has claimed more than 900 lives as infections continue to rise.
article.articleSummary: As of July 20, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has claimed over 900 lives, with a case fatality rate around 39.7%. There are 2,344 confirmed infections, 930 deaths from ongoing community transmission, 466 recoveries, and 724 patients still under medical follow-up or in quarantine. The Bundibugyo strain drives the surge, with Ituri province as the main epicenter. The outbreak has spread across five provinces: Tshopo, Ituri, Haut-Uele, North Kivu, and South Kivu, since a state of emergency was declared on May 15. Africa CDC notes joint action by medical teams, government authorities, and international partners to curb spread. Yap Boum, head of Emergency Preparedness and Response at Africa CDC, says coordinated efforts in the coming weeks or months should reduce infections.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱、感染拡大が続き死者900人超に
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC5州に拡大し、死者900人超・致死率約40%と深刻な公衆衛生インパクトがあり、国際的拡大リスクも認められるためフルRRAへ移行すべきシグナル。
triage.notes: 北キブ州も感染拡大地域として記事本文に記載されているが、発生地域リストには含まれていない。致死率約39.7%と非常に高く、Bundibugyo株による流行でイトゥリ州が主要な感染拡大地域。

article.articleHeadline: L'épidémie d'Ebola au Congo a fait plus de 900 victimes, tandis que le nombre de cas continue d'augmenter
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in Congo has killed more than 900 people, as the number of cases continues to rise.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has killed more than 900 people. The Ituri province is the main epicenter of the Bundibugyo strain. International partners are coordinating with national authorities to halt transmission. Latest figures from the Ministry of Health show 2,344 confirmed cases, 930 deaths, 466 recoveries, and 724 people under follow-up or in quarantine. The case fatality rate is 39.7%, while contact tracing success reaches 85.8%. Since the emergency was declared on 15 May, the virus has spread to five provinces: Tshopo, Ituri, Haut-Uele, Nord-Kivu, and Sud-Kivu, with Ituri remaining the primary hotspot due to Bundibugyo. The African CDC says medical teams, public authorities, and international partners are working to contain the outbreak. Yap Boum of Africa CDC expressed confidence that coordinated efforts will reduce cases in the coming weeks or months.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行、感染者数の増加が続く中で死者900人超に
triage.triage_reason: 5州に拡大し2,344例・930名死亡（致死率39.7%）と大規模かつ深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、IHR基準およびWPRO基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 2026年5月15日に緊急事態宣言後、5州（Tshopo, Ituri, Haut-Uele, Nord-Kivu, Sud-Kivu）に拡大。Bundibugyo株によるもので、Ituri州が主要な流行中心地。国際的な支援（African CDC等）が既に展開されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola death toll in Congo rises to at least 930, including dozens of health workers
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo has reached at least 930 deaths among 2,344 laboratory-confirmed cases, with 37 new deaths reported Friday–Saturday. Declared May 15 in Ituri and other eastern provinces, the Bundibugyo strain drives the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak on record, with no approved vaccine or treatment. Ebola transmits from wild animals and between people via bodily fluids and contaminated surfaces. Security fears have hampered response in Ituri, with five eastern provinces affected amid rebel violence. At least 12 attacks on health facilities and teams since mid-May reflect skepticism and rumors. About 36 health workers have died from infection. WHO warned that roughly 80% of new cases come from unknown transmission chains, signaling fast spread. Over two months, the outbreak averaged about 272 new cases and 111 deaths weekly; 724 patients are in isolation or hospitals, and 22 recoveries were reported in 24 hours. Authorities are intensifying response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ死者数、医療従事者数十人を含め少なくとも930人に上昇
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ東部で承認されたワクチン・治療法がないBundibugyo株による記録的な速さで拡大するエボラ流行が発生し、致死率が高く医療従事者への感染・死亡も多数発生しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数が該当する。
triage.notes: 80%の新規症例が感染経路不明であることや、治安悪化・医療施設への攻撃が対応を阻害している点はリスク評価で重点的に確認すべき。

article.articleHeadline: City-based pvt varsity conducted dengue vaccine's chemical trial | Bhubaneswar News
article.articleSummary: Dengue vaccine QDENGA, developed by Takeda and DCGI-cleared, was the focus as Bhubaneswar's private university PTCTU conducted its chemical/Phase III trial in India. Dr E Venkata Rao, head of PTCTU, confirmed last year's trial, noting the vaccine is safe with minimal or no side effects, and can be given to people aged 4–60 without prior dengue screening, including those previously infected. The Centre's approval, India's first for dengue vaccination, is expected to bolster Odisha's dengue prevention efforts amid seasonal monsoon spikes. Odisha recorded 39,983 dengue cases and one death between 2021-2025, with 2023 the worst year. Officials say vaccination could be introduced under universal immunisation in the future, though adoption will require regulatory steps; mass production could lower costs. Dr Rabindra Nath Mishra, director of public health, welcomed the development but noted no Centre communication yet.

triage.headline_ja: 地元私立大学がデング熱ワクチンの化学的試験を実施 | ブバネーシュワル・ニュース
triage.triage_reason: 記事はデング熱ワクチン（QDENGA）の臨床試験承認に関する内容であり、アウトブレイクや急性の公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱ワクチンの臨床試験・承認に関する報道であり、感染症アウトブレイクの発生報告ではない。過去5年間の累積症例数(39,983例、死亡1例)が言及されているが、現在の急性事象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: UN warns of Ebola spread in DR Congo camps
article.articleSummary: On July 20, 2026, Ebola risk is spreading in displacement camps in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, with overcrowding in Ituri driving transmission. The UN OCHA reports confirmed Ebola cases in at least 16 displacement sites, housing more than 270,000 people. Ebola spreads through close contact and infected bodily fluids; authorities are installing handwashing stations and conducting prevention outreach. Cases have been detected in five DRC provinces and in neighboring Uganda. The outbreak has reached 2,344 laboratory-confirmed cases in the DRC, with 930 deaths, more than 460 recoveries, and 192 suspected cases. Declared May 15 as the 17th DRC Ebola outbreak, centered in Ituri. There are no approved vaccines or treatments for the Bundibugyo species driving this outbreak, prompting calls for heightened international support.

triage.headline_ja: 国連、コンゴ民主共和国の避難民キャンプでのエボラ拡大を警告
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中の第17次エボラ流行が避難民キャンプの過密状況下で拡大し、ウガンダへの越境例も確認されており、死亡者数930人・確定例2344件と重大。ワクチン・治療薬未承認の変異株であることから国際的な支援要請も生じている。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの感染例も報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。Ituriは州単位（ADM1）のため国別リストには含めず、DRC全体として記載。

article.articleHeadline: Varanasi news: 27 माह के बच्चे को कोरोना वायरस के तीन गंभीर श्वसन संक्रमण
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Varanasi News: Three severe coronavirus-related respiratory infections in a 27-month-old child.
article.articleSummary: Varanasi, India: A 27-month-old child from Chandauli district at Popular Multispeciality Hospital tested positive for multiple severe respiratory infections. A Comprehensive Respiratory Pathogen Panel detected human coronavirus (alpha and beta) along with Staphylococcus pneumoniae, Haemophilus influenzae, and Mycoplasma pneumoniae. As of 21 July 2026, the district has four coronavirus patients. The infant’s co‑infections raise concerns, as a mix of viral and bacterial pathogens can cause breathing difficulty, high fever, persistent cough, and weakness in young children with developing immune systems. Continuous monitoring is underway. Dr. Alok, a pediatrician, cautioned that co‑infections can worsen outcomes and urged care during seasonal changes, avoiding crowded places, masking, and seeking prompt medical care if symptoms appear. Nodal Officer Dr. Shishir advised immediate facility contact for symptoms like breathing trouble, persistent cough, high fever, or weakness.

triage.headline_ja: バラナシ:27ヶ月の子供が新型コロナウイルスに関連する3つの重度呼吸器感染症を発症
triage.triage_reason: 単一の小児例における混合感染で、地域的拡大や公衆衛生上の重大な影響を示す情報がなく、社会的関心の高まりも確認できない。
triage.notes: 地区内でコロナウイルス患者は4名のみと報告されており、局所的な事例。COVID-19とマイコプラズマ肺炎の混合感染だが、地域的な流行拡大を示す証拠はない。

article.articleHeadline: Woman tests positive for dengue, tally rises to 5 in city
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Gurgaon, India: A 20-year-old woman from Chauma village tested positive, raising this year’s confirmed dengue cases to five. On Monday, 94 samples were tested, with total dengue tests reaching 2,973 this year. Last year the city logged 64 dengue cases and no deaths; this year there have been no dengue-related deaths so far. Health authorities intensified vector surveillance, with rapid fever teams visiting 14,305 houses on Monday and 697,039 households reached since the campaign began. Malaria surveillance saw 839 blood slides prepared on Monday, with 158,518 slides examined since Jan 1 and three malaria cases reported this year (no new cases Monday; last year eight, no deaths). Authorities issued 845 notices for mosquito breeding. Dengue, malaria, chikungunya and Japanese encephalitis remain notifiable under the Epidemic Diseases Act until March 2027, requiring 24-hour reporting. Symptoms include fever, headache, muscle/joint pain, rash; preventive measures urged.

triage.headline_ja: 女性がデング熱陽性、市内の感染者数は5人に増加
triage.triage_reason: デング熱感染者数は5例と少なく、死亡例もなく、既存のサーベイランス体制下での通常の季節性報告であり、異常性や社会的関心の高まりは見られない。
triage.notes: 地域の日常的な媒介動物サーベイランス報告であり、感染者数は前年より少なく、死亡例もない。ルーチンの公衆衛生報告として扱うべき事例。

article.articleHeadline: Εφιάλτης δίχως τέλος - Εκτός ελέγχου η επιδημία του ιού Έμπολα στο Κονγκό... ξεπερνούν τους 930 οι νεκροί
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Endless nightmare - The Ebola virus outbreak in Congo is out of control... the death toll exceeds 930.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) driven by the Bundibugyo strain is escalating rapidly. As of 20 July 2026, the death toll exceeds 930, and confirmed cases reach 2,365, with 37 deaths in the last 24 hours. The epidemic has spread to two additional eastern provinces and now affects five areas, with Ituri province remaining the main focal point. Uganda has reported 20 imported cases and France 1, underscoring international concern. The World Health Organization says the outbreak continues to outpace response, with more than 80% of new cases arising from unknown transmission chains, signaling gaps in contact tracing. Africa CDC plans a clinical trial in eastern DRC to test a two-vaccine strategy: Ervebo (Zaire ebolavirus vaccine) plus an experimental Sudan-strain vaccine developed by IAVI, targeting frontline workers; approval pending. There is no licensed vaccine for Bundibugyo, complicating containment amid distrust, attacks on health facilities, and unsafe burial practices.

triage.headline_ja: 終わりのない悪夢 - コンゴでのエボラ出血熱の流行が制御不能に…死者930人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)アウトブレイクが死者930人超・感染者2365人に拡大し、国際的な感染拡大(ウガンダ・フランスへの輸出例)も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・フランスは輸入例のみで、対象国リストにウガンダ・フランスは含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。主たる発生国はDRC。承認済みワクチンがないブンディブギョ株であることも重症度・管理困難性を高めている。

article.articleHeadline: التنمية الأفريقي : 13 مليون دولار لدعم جهود مكافحة تفشي إيبولا في الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: African Development: $13 million to support efforts to combat an Ebola outbreak in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-07-20, the African Development Bank Group approved a $13 million grant to strengthen national Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with spillover risk to Uganda and South Sudan. The outbreak began in May in eastern DRC’s Ituri Province and has affected Bunia, Rwampara, and Mongwalu. The package includes a $10 million grant funded from repurposed World Bank resources, channeled through the World Health Organization, and a $3 million second grant under AfDB’s Multi-Country Emergency Aid Project, implemented by the Africa CDC. Of the total, DRC receives $11 million, while Uganda and South Sudan receive $1 million each. Funds target stopping transmission and reducing deaths via early detection, surveillance, community engagement, risk communication, and regional coordination. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain has no approved vaccine or specific treatment.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ開発銀行：コンゴのエボラ出血熱流行対策支援に1300万ドル
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが継続し、ウガンダ・南スーダンへの越境拡大リスクがあり、国際機関による大規模資金支援が行われている。IHR基準複数該当かつ社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: アウトブレイクは2026年5月にイトゥリ州で開始、ブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス株で承認ワクチン・特効薬なし。ウガンダ・南スーダンへの波及リスクが指摘されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: Japanese drugmaker Takeda's Qdenga becomes first dengue vaccine approved in India
article.articleSummary: India's drug regulator approved Takeda's dengue vaccine Qdenga on July 20, the first dengue vaccine cleared in the country. Qdenga is a two-dose, 0.5 ml injection given three months apart, indicated for ages 4–60 and usable regardless of prior dengue exposure. In late-stage trials, efficacy was 80.2% against confirmed dengue one year after the second dose and 90.4% against dengue-related hospitalisations after 18 months, and it protects against all four dengue serotypes. Availability in India is expected in H1 2027, initially through private healthcare settings. Globally, WHO tallied 14.4 million dengue cases and 11,201 deaths in 2024; India had 232,425 cases and 233 deaths that year. India has seen dengue rise 11-fold in two decades. Takeda aims for 100 million doses/year by 2030, with Biological E manufacturing up to 50 million annually. Dengvaxia not approved in India; post-marketing safety data may be required. IIL is pursuing a mid-stage dengue candidate.

triage.headline_ja: 日本の製薬会社武田薬品の「Qdenga」、インドで初のデング熱ワクチンとして承認
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はワクチン承認に関する薬事・産業ニュースであり、新規の感染症アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: デング熱の流行状況自体（症例数増加等）を報じる記事ではなく、ワクチン承認という規制上のニュースであるため、アウトブレイク関連のシグナルとしては扱わない。

article.articleHeadline: L'ONU alerte contre la propagation d'Ebola dans les camps de réfugiés en RDC - RTBF Actus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The UN warns about the spread of Ebola in refugee camps in the DRC - RTBF Actus
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease is spreading in refugee camps in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). Confirmed Ebola cases have been reported in at least 16 camps across Ituri province, which hosts more than 270,000 displaced people; overcrowding and limited basic services raise transmission risk. UN OCHA has installed handwashing posts and is conducting community awareness on prevention. Ebola, transmitted by close contact and infected bodily fluids, has been detected in five DRC provinces and in neighboring Uganda. The DRC's confirmed cases total 2,344 with 930 deaths; about 466 patients have recovered and 192 are suspected. The outbreak is the third-largest in Ebola history, with the 17th DRC outbreak declared on May 15 after several deaths in Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: 国連、コンゴ民主共和国の難民キャンプでのエボラ拡大を警告
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部の難民キャンプ16箇所でエボラ確定例が報告され、隣国ウガンダにも拡大しており、史上3番目の規模の流行であるためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの感染拡大が報告されているが、対象国リストにウガンダが含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。死者930人、確定例2,344人と規模が大きく、難民キャンプでの過密状態が感染リスクを増大させている点に注意。

article.articleHeadline: 21 cases so far, Sector 50, Barola among dengue hotspots
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Noida: 21 cases reported so far, with Barola, Surajpur, Kasna and Sector 50 identified as primary hotspots; six to seven hotspots exist in Gautam Budh Nagar where breeding sites, stagnant water and larvae were found. Since July 1, Noida Authority has launched a month-long fogging and anti-larval drive, with 650 ASHA workers deployed for door-to-door awareness, fever surveillance and vector source identification. Residents are advised to prevent water stagnation, clean overhead tanks and coolers weekly, cover water storage containers, and dispose of unused tyres and containers. Symptoms prompting care include persistent fever, severe headache, body ache or rash. Officials emphasize eliminating mosquito breeding sources before transmission. Neighboring Ghaziabad reports five malaria and four dengue cases this season; both districts have two scrub typhus cases each. Last year Noida recorded 650 dengue and 189 malaria; Ghaziabad 343 dengue and 92 malaria.

triage.headline_ja: これまでに21件、セクター50・バロラがデング熱の流行地に
triage.triage_reason: インドの一部地域における例年発生するデング熱・マラリア・つつが虫病の季節的な流行であり、当局による通常の対策（防疫作業）が実施されている。国際的な公衆衛生上の異常事態や渡航制限の懸念はない。
triage.notes: デング熱・マラリア・つつが虫病はインドの一部地域（ノイダ、ガジアバード）で毎年季節的に発生する媒介動物感染症であり、地方自治体が通常の防疫対策（防蚊、住民啓発）を実施中。前年比データも記載されており、特段の異常な増加や重篤化は確認されない。

article.articleHeadline: ഡെങ്കി വാക്സിന് അംഗീകാരം; 'ക്യൂഡെങ്ക' ഒരു മാസത്തിനകം
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue vaccine approved; 'Kyudengk' within a month.
article.articleSummary: As of July 20, 2026, India grants import license and Drugs Controller General of India (DGCI) approval for Takeda Biopharmaceuticals’ dengue vaccine, named 'Kyudengk', for distribution in the country, with delivery expected within a month. Developed in 2022 and already used in about 42 countries, the vaccine protects against all four dengue virus serotypes. Pre-vaccination serology testing is not required. WHO has urged use in high-burden dengue countries, and India accounts for roughly one-third of global dengue cases. The two-dose regimen is administered three months apart, for individuals aged 4 to 60 years. Price per dose is not finalized, but estimates range 3,000–6,000 INR. Adverse effects are minimal; no major systemic side effects reported. Local injection-site redness and pain may last up to two days, with possible mild dizziness or abdominal upset.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱ワクチンが承認；『キュデンカ』1か月以内に導入
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はデング熱ワクチンの承認・導入に関する政策・医薬品ニュースであり、感染症の発生や流行拡大を示す内容ではないため、シグナルとしては該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱ワクチンの承認とインドでの流通開始に関する内容であり、疾病の発生・流行状況を報告するものではないため、感染症イベントとしてのトリアージ対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : les défis qui gênent l'efficacité définitive de la
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: the challenges that hinder the definitive efficacy of the.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease is ongoing in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with five of 26 provinces affected after an outbreak that began in Ituri. Over two months into the resurgence, authorities report about 2,000 confirmed cases and under 800 deaths. The government cites restricted mobility in affected zones and public misperceptions as key impediments to an effective response. Stakeholders note additional obstacles such as rumor propagation, reluctance to follow up contacts, and persistent unsafe burials. A local financing mechanism for community structures is proposed to strengthen local response. On July 20, the African Development Bank announced a combined $13 million aid package to DRC, Sudan, and Uganda, with DRC receiving at least $11 million. The discussion features Dr Pierre Akilimali (deputy incident manager), Dr Jean-Paul Ngabu Tsunde (Djugu MP and former health zone chief), and Dr Michel Muvudi (World Bank health expert).

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：最終的な対応の効果を妨げる課題
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で継続中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが5州に拡大し、約2,000例・800人近い死亡が報告されており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的な資金支援も動いているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: スーダン・ウガンダは記事中でアフリカ開発銀行の資金援助対象として言及されているのみで、感染事例発生の確認はないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: No vaccine, no cure: Congo's deadliest Ebola outbreak claims 930 lives
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s eastern Ebola outbreak, driven by the Bundibugyo strain, has reached 2,344 confirmed cases and 930 deaths as of Saturday, with 37 new fatalities in the prior 24 hours (Friday–Saturday). Declared May 15 in eastern Congo, it is described as the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak on record. The Bundibugyo variant has no approved vaccine or specific treatment, complicating containment. Response efforts are hampered by insecurity, attacks on health facilities, and difficulties tracing transmission chains, raising concerns the outbreak could worsen in coming weeks. The situation underscores ongoing challenges in laboratory-confirmed surveillance and rapid containment in conflict-affected areas of the Democratic Republic of Congo.

triage.headline_ja: ワクチンも治療法もなし：コンゴで史上最悪のエボラ出血熱流行、死者930人に
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部で発生したエボラ出血熱（ブンディブジョ株）が2,344例・930人死亡と急拡大しており、ワクチンも治療法もなく、治安悪化により対応が困難化しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大なシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: ブンディブジョ株には承認済みワクチン・特効薬がなく、治安悪化・医療施設への攻撃・接触者追跡の困難さにより、今後さらに拡大する懸念がある「史上最速で拡大するエボラ流行」とされている。

article.articleHeadline: Texas Tech researchers secure NIH funding for tropical diseases
article.articleSummary: Texas Tech University researchers Peter Keyel and Kai Zhang secured roughly $600,000 from NIH/NIAID over three years to study leishmaniasis. Transmitted by phlebotomine sandflies, leishmaniasis affects millions worldwide, including Brazil, India and Central Africa. The disease manifests in cutaneous (most common), mucocutaneous (can cause disability and disfigurement), and visceral forms (untreated fatal in many cases). The project fuses Keyel's work on cell membrane repair with Zhang's parasitology expertise, aiming to identify shared and divergent features between mammalian cells and Leishmania to illuminate fundamental repair mechanisms. Researchers will examine how pore-forming toxins interact with parasite membranes and seek vulnerabilities across Leishmania species. After establishing basic understanding, the team plans translational steps toward inhibitors, followed by efficacy and safety testing, with fall-term undergraduate training to involve students.

triage.headline_ja: テキサス工科大学の研究者、熱帯病研究でNIHの資金提供を確保
triage.triage_reason: 研究資金に関する記事であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイクの発生を報告するものではないため、シグナルとしての緊急性はない。
triage.notes: 記事は米国テキサス工科大学の研究資金獲得に関する内容で、ブラジル・インド・中央アフリカは疾病の一般的な流行地として言及されているのみで、具体的なアウトブレイク発生国ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue: monitoramento identifica redução da presença do mosquito transmissor em Jaraguá do Sul
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue: monitoring identifies a reduction in the presence of the dengue-transmitting mosquito in Jaraguá do Sul.
article.articleSummary: Dengue monitoring in Jaraguá do Sul, Brazil shows reduced Aedes aegypti presence, with 481 ovitramp traps deployed citywide. Between epidemiological weeks 17 and 26, focal points were detected in weeks 17 (1), 18 (6), 19 (49), 22 (1), 23 (33), 25 (3), and 26 (9); weeks 20–21 and 24 recorded no foci. A total of 1,242 dengue cases were notified, with 26 confirmed and 14 under investigation. Control measures include Borrifação Residual Intradomiciliar (BRI) at strategic sites such as schools, early childhood centers, health units, and high-traffic spaces (bus terminals, squares, museums, Arena Jaraguá). Community Health Agents have supported home visits since October 2025. An Intersectoral Arboviruses Committee meets every two months to coordinate action. Residents are urged to inspect properties, eliminate water-holding containers, welcome agents, and report risks via the Jaraguá na Mão app or the Municipal Ombudsman. Public health relies on government, health workers, institutions, and community collaboration.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱：ジャラグア・ド・スルにおける監視でデング熱媒介蚊の存在の減少を確認
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル南部の一都市における通常の蚊媒介監視・対策活動の報告であり、媒介蚊の減少という改善傾向を示す内容で、異常性・深刻性・国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 地域の日常的なデング熱サーベイランス報告で、地方自治体レベルの対策活動を示すルーティン記事。確定例26件、調査中14件と規模も限定的。

article.articleHeadline: Coimbra reforça ações de conscientização no combate à dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Coimbra strengthens awareness efforts in the fight against dengue.
article.articleSummary: Coimbra city strengthens dengue prevention through endemic disease-control teams. The awareness campaign focused on arboviruses, with emphasis on dengue, outlining prevention steps, disease symptoms, and the importance of eliminating containers that collect standing water to curb mosquito breeding. Officials note dengue has four serotypes and can progress to severe illness, underscoring the need for community participation to keep yards, plots, and surroundings free of potential breeding sites. Residents showing symptoms—fever, body aches, skin rashes, or malaise—are advised to seek prompt evaluation at a health facility for proper guidance. The Municipal administration stresses that preventing dengue is a shared responsibility, relying on collaboration between public authorities and residents to protect public health.

triage.headline_ja: コインブラ市、デング熱対策の啓発活動を強化
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の日常的な予防啓発活動に関する記事であり、異常な流行拡大や重症事例の増加を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 地方自治体による通常の予防啓発活動の記事であり、具体的な感染者数増加や異常事態の報告はない。ブラジルの一地方都市（コインブラ）での活動だが、対象国リストにブラジルは含まれるものの記事内容は日常的な公衆衛生活動に留まる。

article.articleHeadline: संक्रामक रोगियों की रोजाना देनी होगी रिपोर्ट, मॉनीटरिंग करेगा लखनऊ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Infectious patients will have to submit a daily report; Lucknow will monitor.
article.articleSummary: Across Badaun district, Uttar Pradesh, two brothers died after contracting an infectious illness, prompting health authorities to deploy village camps and collect daily samples. With the onset of the monsoon, surveillance has intensified, mandating online daily reporting of tests and diagnosed diseases to identify hotspots. In Dahgawan block, jaundice affected two siblings, with six others showing jaundice symptoms; treatment is underway. Camps are being conducted beyond Dahgawan to detect more cases. The protocol requires uploading a full patient brief to a government portal by 5 PM daily; Lucknow will monitor the data to guide targeted oversight. District infectious disease experts confirm ongoing daily uploads and prompt treatment wherever cases are reported.

triage.headline_ja: 感染症患者は毎日報告が必要、ラクナウが監視へ
triage.triage_reason: ウッタル・プラデーシュ州バダウン県で原因不明の感染症により兄弟2人が死亡し、黄疸症状の集団発生も確認されたため、州当局が緊急監視体制を敷いている。WPRO基準（異常性・重症度・継続曝露）に複数該当し、行政の強い関心（日次報告義務化）が確認できる。
triage.notes: 原因病原体が未確定（『不明感染症』および黄疸症状）であり、続報でジャウンディス/肝炎等の確定診断情報を確認する必要がある。地域はウッタル・プラデーシュ州バダウン県に限定。

article.articleHeadline: 金門嚴防非洲豬瘟 加強邊境管控查驗 - OwlNews
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kinmen Tightens Border Controls and Inspections to Prevent African Swine Fever - OwlNews
article.articleSummary: On 2026-07-20, Kinmen County, Taiwan, confirmed African swine fever (ASF) through PCR in a 70-kg drifting pig carcass found at the Xintou coastline. The carcass tested ASF nucleic acid positive at the Veterinary Research Institute. A 10-km radius survey of 25 pig farms (5,033 pigs) reported all animals clinically healthy; no ASF cases among live pigs. The carcass was incinerated/buried and extensive disinfection conducted for surrounding area, personnel, vehicles, and equipment; border and coastal surveillance was intensified. Officials attribute the drift to weather and sea currents from Mawar typhoon, noting Kinmen’s proximity to Fujian Province, Xiamen, and the Jiulong River outlets, making drift plausible. To mitigate risk, the Agriculture Ministry extended a temporary ban on Kinmen pork and pork products to Taiwan’s main island and other offshore islands from 2026-07-16 to 2026-07-22; some processed products remain eligible after risk assessment. Farms are urged to uphold strict biosafety and disinfection; ASF remains a regional public-health concern.

triage.headline_ja: 金門、アフリカ豚熱を厳重警戒 国境管理・検査を強化
triage.triage_reason: 台湾金門島沿岸で発見された漂着豚死体からASF陽性が確認されたが、生豚への感染は確認されず、ヒトへの直接的な公衆衛生影響もないため、シグナルとしての優先度は低い。
triage.notes: 本事例は台湾金門島（対象国リスト外）での漂着豚死体からのASF検出。福建省からの漂着が推測されているが、中国本土での発生を直接報告するものではなく、動物疾病でヒトへの感染性もないため対象国verified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: At least 930 people have died in Congo's Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo has reached 2,344 confirmed cases and at least 930 deaths as of Saturday, with 37 deaths in the last 24 hours (Friday–Saturday). The Bundibugyo strain, for which no approved vaccine or treatment exists, drives the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak on record. Transmission occurs via contact with bodily fluids and contaminated materials; spread occurs human-to-human and from wildlife to people. Five eastern provinces are affected amid persistent rebel violence, with at least 12 attacks on health facilities since mid-May. Health workers are overextended or abandoning posts due to compensation issues; at least 36 health workers have died. The World Health Organization notes about 80% of new cases involve unknown transmission chains. About 724 patients are hospitalized or in isolation, with 22 recoveries reported in the latest 24-hour period as response efforts intensify.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行、死者少なくとも930人に
triage.triage_reason: 承認済みワクチン・治療法のないブンディブギョ株による過去最速拡大のエボラ流行で、死者930人・確認例2,344人に達し、武力紛争や医療体制崩壊も伴いIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 80%の新規感染で感染経路不明、医療従事者36人死亡、武力攻撃12件など対応能力の限界を示す複数要素あり。フルRRAでの詳細評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : l'épidémie d'Ebola s'emballe (2.344 cas, 930 décès) - essai clinique historique et course au vaccin - Cameroun24.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: the Ebola outbreak is spiraling (2,344 cases, 930 deaths) - a landmark clinical trial and the race for a vaccine - Cameroun24.net
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri with spread toward Nord-Kivu and South Kivu) worsens, with 2,344 laboratory-confirmed cases and 930 deaths as of July 20, 2026. In the last 24 hours, 77 new cases and 37 deaths were reported; case fatality is about 39.7%. Over 724 people are in quarantine; contact tracing coverage is 85.8%. The outbreak, officially declared May 15, centers in Ituri and has reached Uganda. On July 2, a historic clinical trial (PARTNERS) began testing three antivirals against Ebola Bundibugyo: MBP134 monoclonal antibody and remdesivir, used alone or in combination (not vaccines). Russia offers its vaccine to African countries. International support includes a $50 million pledge from the DRC president and $13 million from the World Bank. Disinformation and attacks on health workers hinder response efforts across the affected health zones.

triage.headline_ja: DRC:エボラ出血熱の流行が拡大中（症例数2,344件、死亡930人）―歴史的な臨床試験とワクチン開発競争
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常事象、国際拡大〈ウガンダへの拡大〉）に該当し、致死率約39.7%と重篤度が高く、国際的な資金・支援も動いているためフルRRAへの移行が必要。
