article.articleHeadline: Marcos Oliveira tem alta após 18 dias internado por infecção
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Marcos Oliveira discharged after 18 days in hospital due to infection.
article.articleSummary: Marcos Oliveira, 70, the actor known for Beiçola in A Grande Família, was discharged from Hospital São Lucas in Copacabana, Rio de Janeiro, after 18 days hospitalized for a perineal infection that required abscess drainage. Admitted June 30, he underwent abscess removal the next day and spent time in intensive care before stabilization. On July 11 he returned to the ICU due to feeding difficulties, then recovered and was discharged on July 20. Post-discharge, he moved to Retiro dos Artistas in Jacarepaguá (Zona Oeste), where he has lived since 2025; administrators said he left in good health, accompanied by a friend and stopping to buy a blender before heading home. Oliveira has a history of recent surgeries, including a May 2026 hernia repair, plus earlier catheterization in 2024 and a 2022 urethral fistula operation, with residence at Retiro dos Artistas funded by actress Marieta Severo.

article.articleHeadline: Hepatites virais podem evoluir por anos sem sintomas; infectologista alerta para a importância do diagnóstico precoce
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Viral Hepatitis Can Progress for Years Without Symptoms; An Infectious Disease Specialist Warns About the Importance of Early Diagnosis.
article.articleSummary: Northern Brazil carries one of the country's highest viral hepatitis burdens, especially Hepatitis B and Hepatitis D in Amazon. Rondônia, Acre and Amazonas are among states with the highest hepatitis B incidence; Hepatitis D accounts for over 73% of regional Hepatitis D infections, since the D virus only infects people already carrying Hepatitis B. Diagnosis is often late; many live with B or C infections for years without symptoms, allowing progressive liver damage. 300 million people have chronic hepatitis B or C. Adults 18+ should be screened once; testing should be offered to anyone requesting it. Transmission is by blood; sharing sharp objects is risky; casual contact is not. Vaccines exist for Hepatitis A and Hepatitis B in Brazil; none for Hepatitis C or D (D vaccination depends on Hepatitis B vaccination). Chronic infections can progress to cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma; early diagnosis and antiviral treatment reduce cancer risk.

triage.headline_ja: ウイルス性肝炎は何年も無症状で進行することがある―感染症専門医、早期診断の重要性を訴える
triage.triage_reason: 啓発・注意喚起を目的とした一般的な医療情報記事であり、急性のアウトブレイクや異常事象の報告ではないため、公衆衛生上の緊急対応を要するシグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル北部（ロンドニア州、アクレ州、アマゾナス州）における慢性B型・D型肝炎の疫学的背景と早期診断の重要性を解説する啓発記事であり、新規アウトブレイクの報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Vacinação no Aeroporto de Fortaleza oferece doses contra gripe e sarampo durante as férias escolares
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vaccination at Fortaleza Airport offers flu and measles vaccines during the school holidays.
article.articleSummary: From July 20–22, 2026, Fortaleza's Pinto Martins International Airport will host a free vaccination drive offering influenza (flu) and measles vaccines from 9:00 to 16:00. The Fortaleza City Hall, via the Municipal Health Secretariat (SMS), will administer vaccines to all eligible individuals presenting a photo ID, in line with the National Immunization Program (PNI). The airport site aims to facilitate access during school holidays when travel increases, protecting travelers and destination communities. In addition to the airport event, Fortaleza's vaccination program continues across the municipal health network: 134 health posts operate, with weekend units open 8:00–16:30. On July 25–26, six posts will provide vaccination, health services, and distribution of medications. Vaccines are free for those eligible according to PNI guidelines and are available to residents and travelers alike.

triage.headline_ja: フォルタレザ空港でのワクチン接種、学校休暇期間中にインフルエンザと麻疹のワクチンを提供
triage.triage_reason: 感染症の発生報告ではなく、通常のワクチン接種キャンペーンの広報記事であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態を示す内容ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : l'Institut national de recherche biomédicale mise sur les tests rapides (Professeur Muyembe) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: the National Institute of Biomedical Research bets on rapid tests (Professor Muyembe) - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) response in the Democratic Republic of Congo centers on rapid diagnostic tests, according to INRB Director-General Professor Jean-Jacques Muyembe in Kinshasa on July 20, 2026. The institute prioritizes field evaluation of rapid tests received from various pharmaceutical firms to determine suitability for use in Ituri and other provinces. A second priority focuses on understanding transmission dynamics, with emphasis on healthcare workers, health facilities, and gold mining employers of those working in Mongbwalu. A third priority seeks to elucidate the pathophysiology of EVD through localized anatomopathological studies across different organs. An international study will evaluate the Ebola vaccine before deployment in collaboration with partners to characterize differences among circulating strains. Muyembe also said Kinshasa has not recorded any positive case yet, and reinforced barrier measures such as handwashing and avoiding contact with contaminated individuals. Additional projects will be funded as the response evolves.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：国立生物医学研究所が迅速検査に注力（ムイェンベ教授）－ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州でのエボラ出血熱の継続的発生に関する対応状況の報告であり、重篤な疾患で人-人感染のリスクがあり、国際的な支援（ワクチン研究、製薬パートナー）も動いているためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 記事はイトゥリ州モングバルウの金採掘労働者や医療従事者を含む感染動態の調査、迅速検査・ワクチンの国際共同研究に関する内容。キンシャサでの感染例はまだ確認されていない。既知の継続中のエボラ流行に関する最新の対応報告。

article.articleHeadline: At least 930 people have died in Congo from Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of Congo’s eastern Ituri province, at least 930 people have died from an Ebola outbreak with 2,344 laboratory-confirmed cases as of Saturday. Thirty-seven new deaths were reported in the previous 24 hours, marking the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak on record. The Bundibugyo virus is responsible; it is less common and there is no approved vaccine or treatment. Safety fears have hampered the response in Ituri, where security incidents include at least 12 attacks on health facilities and teams since mid-May. Health workers' strikes over pay have compounded the challenge, with at least 36 infected health workers dying. The Health Ministry reports 724 patients are in isolation in hospitals, and authorities say response efforts are being intensified in the affected health zones.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ出血熱の流行により少なくとも930人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ（ブンディブギョウイルス）の大規模流行で、確定例2,344件・死者930人、承認済みワクチン・治療法がなく、治安悪化により対応が阻害されているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョウイルス（Bundibugyo virus）による流行で、記録上最速のエボラ流行とされる。医療施設への攻撃や医療従事者のストライキが対応を阻害しており、国際支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Como evitar surtos de mancha-aureolada no café
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: How to Prevent Outbreaks of Golden Spot on Coffee
article.articleSummary: Golden spot on coffee, caused by Pseudomonas syringae pv. garcae, threatens leaves, branches, and berries. From Sept 2025 to July 2026, risk rises in multiple producing regions due to irregular rainfall, winds, and temperature swings, requiring frequent field monitoring. Symptoms begin as dark, water-soaked spots on young leaves with a yellow halo, progressing to necrotic lesions, leaf drop, and shoot dieback; fruits may show dark spots and abortion of small beans on heavily affected limbs. The bacterium survives on crop residues, diseased plants, and equipment, spreading mainly through rain splash, wind, irrigation water, and handling. Diagnosis relies on field recognition of halos and early lesions, with lab confirmation if uncertain. Management emphasizes prevention: healthy planting material, sanitation, wound-minimizing pruning, residue management, canopy ventilation, appropriate spacing, balanced nutrition, and irrigation; pesticides may be used as advised and per regulations. Ongoing monitoring and technical guidance are essential.

triage.notes: 植物病害（作物疾患）であり、ヒト感染症のシグナルではないため対象国リストに関わらず該当なし。

article.articleHeadline: बंगाल में कोरोना का अलर्ट, कोलकाता में तीन नए संक्रमित मरीज मिलने से स्वास्थ्य विभाग में हड़कंप - three more cases of corona in kolkata
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Coronavirus alert in West Bengal as three new infected patients detected in Kolkata, health department in a tizzy
article.articleSummary: As of 20 July 2026, Kolkata, West Bengal has four coronavirus cases, including an 11-year-old child who was previously reported positive and three newly detected infections. All four patients are undergoing treatment in different hospitals. They present with fever, sore throat, severe cough, and breathing difficulties. Health authorities caution against taking antibiotics for coronavirus-like symptoms without medical supervision. The monsoon season commonly increases viral illnesses, and this period shows an uptick in adenovirus infections alongside coronavirus, prompting heightened vigilance and public health precautions. No deaths have been reported in connection with these cases. The development indicates ongoing local transmission in Kolkata, underscoring the need for prompt medical consultation for respiratory symptoms and adherence to public health guidance.

triage.headline_ja: 西ベンガルでコロナ警戒、コルカタで新たに3人の感染者確認し保健当局が緊迫

article.articleHeadline: Jamshedpur News: मलेरिया प्रभावित क्षेत्रों के लिए जदयू ने बनाई छह सदस्यीय समिति
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jamshedpur News: JD(U) has formed a six-member committee for malaria-affected areas.
article.articleSummary: Malaria outbreaks in Jamshedpur's East Singhbhum district—specifically Potka, Dumuria, Ghatshila, and Chakulia—have prompted Janata Dal (United) to form a six-member committee. District president Subodh Srivastav said the panel will contact affected patients to gather their problems and coordinate with the Civil Surgeon and health centers to ensure proper treatment. Committee members are Veer Singh Devgan, Manoranjan Mahato, Brihaspati Karmakar, Yashraj, Amit Patar, and Birbal Sardar. If any medical negligence or drug shortages are detected, the committee will intervene with relevant authorities to resolve issues. The initiative aims to streamline patient care amid rising malaria cases in these areas.

triage.headline_ja: ジャムシェドプールニュース:JD(U)がマラリア流行地域のために6人委員会を結成
triage.triage_reason: インド・東シングブーム県でのマラリア患者増加を受けた地元政党の対応に関する記事だが、規模・重症度等の具体的データが不足しているため経過観察が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Prefeitura reúne em página da web respostas às principais dúvidas sobre o sarampo e a vacinação - Click Guarulhos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: City Hall Compiles Answers on Its Website to the Main Questions About Measles and Vaccination - Click Guarulhos
article.articleSummary: Guarulhos City Hall published a measles vaccination FAQ page (Perguntas Frequentes sobre o Sarampo) at www.guarulhos.sp.gov.br/perguntas-frequentes-sobre-o-sarampo. Based on guidance from the Ministry of Health and the São Paulo State Health Secretariat, it answers 14 questions on who should be vaccinated, where to obtain the vaccine, required documents, actions for suspected measles or exposure, and explains the zero-dose for infants 6 to 11 months 29 days. Measles is highly contagious and can cause pneumonia, encephalitis, sequelae, and death; vaccination is the main prevention. In Guarulhos, vaccination is free at all Basic Health Units and Child Ambulatory Clinic, per national and state guidance. The material covers common vaccine reactions, contraindications, keeping the vaccination record updated, and precautions for fever and red rash. Surveillance and prevention actions intensified after confirmed measles cases in São Paulo state, including a case in Guarulhos; measures include zero dose, updating the vaccination schedule, and reinforcing immunization importance.

triage.headline_ja: 市役所が麻疹とワクチン接種に関する主要な質問への回答をウェブサイトにまとめる - Click Guarulhos

article.articleHeadline: Jamshedpur News: जिले में मलेरिया जांच बढ़ी, 95 नए मरीज मिले
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jamshedpur News: Malaria testing has increased in the district, 95 new cases detected.
article.articleSummary: Malaria testing in East Singhbhum's Jamshedpur district on Monday, July 20, 2026, expanded to 13,310 tests with 95 positive cases, up from 9,771 tests and 76 positives on Sunday. Potka block accounted for 28 positives among 3,830 tests; Patamda 17/569; Dumaria 15/2,159; Musabani 13; Dhalbhumgarh 10; Ghatsila 7; Baharagora 3; Chakulia 1; and Sadar Hospital 1. Camps were conducted in 30 Potka villages, with blood samples collected from villagers and schoolchildren. In schools, 498 students were tested, yielding 2 positives. Health teams delivered malaria prevention guidance, urging prompt testing for fever, avoiding stagnant water around homes, and completing the prescribed antimalarial course, while encouraging broader community awareness.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola update in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola update in DR Congo: As of Monday, 2,344 confirmed Ebola cases, 930 deaths, and 466 recoveries. 724 patients are in isolation or hospitalized. Case fatality rate 39.7%, and contact tracing 85.8%. Response efforts are mobilized across five affected provinces—Haut-Uélé, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, and Tshopo—with ongoing surveillance, patient care, and contact tracing to curb transmission. Ituri remains the epidemic's epicenter, with authorities strengthening surveillance and tracing there. Nationwide, 83 new confirmed cases have been recorded, and 22 new recoveries bring total recoveries to 466. South Kivu and Tshopo remain stable, with no new health zones affected. The outbreak continues with increased mobilization to contain spread.

article.articleHeadline: Más de 84 mil personas fueron tamizadas con inteligencia artificial para detectar casos de tuberculosis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 84,000 people were screened with artificial intelligence to detect cases of tuberculosis.
article.articleSummary: TB screening initiative in Peru: Since the start of the year, the Ministry of Health (Minsa) through the Directorate of Prevention and Control of Tuberculosis (DPCTB) has carried out radiographic screening aided by artificial intelligence in over 84,000 people in Lima Metropolitan, Callao, and prioritized regions including La Libertad, Loreto, Cusco, Ayacucho, Tumbes, Piura, Amazonas, Ucayali, and Lima region, as well as other areas. Screens were conducted in hospitals, health centers, schools, universities, and community spaces, including markets, plazas, sports facilities, and municipalities, enabling free access to TB screening for at-risk individuals. Digital X-ray machines with AI quickly analyze images to identify those with findings compatible with TB, who are then referred for a rapid molecular test to confirm diagnosis and begin treatment promptly. The effort aims to expand early diagnosis, reduce transmission, and reach vulnerable populations; campaigns will continue using innovative tech.

Dengue vaccination is available at seven UBS (Unidades Básicas de Saú­de) with extended hours: 7:30–15:30 initially, with some units open until 17:30 (Amanda II, Dom Bruno Gamberini, Rosolém, Santa Clara) and others until 18:30 (Amanda I, Figueiras, Parque do Horto). article.articleHeadline: Ebola : 13 millions de dollars de la BAD pour stopper l'épidémie dans la région - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: 13 million dollars from the African Development Bank to stop the outbreak in the region - ACP
article.articleSummary: An emergency grant of $13 million from the African Development Bank funds Ebola virus disease (EVD) response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), South Sudan, and Uganda. Of the total, $10 million is reprogrammed from the DRC portfolio and will be channelled via the World Health Organization; $3 million from a regional multi-country emergency project will be implemented by Africa CDC, with Uganda and South Sudan each receiving $1 million. In the DRC, total funding reaches $11 million, supporting the outbreak response centered in the Ituri province—epicenter including Bunia, Rwampara and Mongwalu—with spread to North Kivu, South Kivu and Tshopo. The 2025 outbreak, confirmed by WHO on 15 May, is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, noted for high virulence and the absence of an approved vaccine or specific treatment. WHO activated a Level 2 PHEIC due to cross-border transmission to Uganda. The plan strengthens early case detection, surveillance, community engagement, public awareness, and regional coordination through national health ministries.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola quarantine center for Americans is up and working in Kenya despite a court ban, activists say - MyNorthwest.com
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in Congo has killed at least 930 people, with 2,344 cases confirmed as of two months into the outbreak. Kenyan activists say a U.S.-backed Ebola quarantine center near Laikipia Air Base in Nanyuki is operating despite a Kenyan court ban last month. Seven Samaritan's Purse American staff evacuated from Congo are reported to be quarantined in large military tents for 21 days; none have shown Ebola symptoms. Kenya has no confirmed Ebola cases but hosts U.S.-funded preparedness efforts, including a $13.5 million pledge. Protests in Nanyuki over the plan have turned violent, leaving two dead. The court-ordered suspension followed petitions by the Law Society of Kenya and Katiba Institute concerned about overwhelming Kenya's fragile health system. Samaritan's Purse says staff are on the Congo response with centers in Bunia and Nyankunde; specifics on quarantined site location provided by the organization.

article.articleHeadline: New antibody offers possible dengue fever relief
article.articleSummary: Worldwide dengue fever affects an estimated 390 million infections annually, about 96 million symptomatic, and roughly 500,000 progressing to severe disease with around 22,000 deaths. Taiwan’s 2015 DENV-2 outbreak yielded 43,000 confirmed cases and 228 deaths. A NHRI–NCKU team led by Wang Jen-ren and Hsieh Shie-liang developed a bispecific antibody that blocks CLEC5A and TLR2, suppressing the dengue-triggered inflammatory cytokine storm. The antibody reduced inflammatory responses linked to all four dengue serotypes and some virulence-mutation strains, suggesting a potential novel treatment for severe dengue and possible applications against Zika virus and Japanese encephalitis. Findings were published in the Journal of Biomedical Science in July 2026. Separately, Chiayi City's health bureau confirmed its first imported dengue case, a student returning from Vietnam; symptoms included fever, retro-orbital pain, and headache. Authorities conducted targeted spraying and breeding-site control within 100 m of the case.

triage.headline_ja: 新抗体がデング熱治療に新たな可能性
triage.triage_reason: 内容の主体は新規抗体治療の基礎研究成果であり、台湾嘉義市での輸入デング熱症例1例（ベトナム帰りの学生）は迅速に対応（消毒・発生源対策）済みで、アウトブレイクや異常な拡大は確認されていない。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼は研究成果（CLEC5A/TLR2を阻害する二重特異性抗体）であり、台湾での輸入例1件は既に対応済み。ベトナムでの実際のアウトブレイク情報は記載されておらず、対象国としての実発生確認はできない。

article.articleHeadline: CDC expands Ebola travel precautions as Tampa Bay hospital reviews preparedness
article.articleSummary: CDC expands Do Not Board travel precautions after a U.S. citizen working for a humanitarian organization in the Democratic Republic of Congo tests positive for Ebola amid the DRC’s largest recorded Bundibugyo outbreak. The agency, with DHS, implements a Do Not Board process for certain travelers departing the DRC who may have been exposed, barring them from boarding US-bound flights until they leave the country and complete a 21-day symptom-monitoring period, after which contact tracing continues. Officials say the risk to the U.S. public remains low. Amid busy summer travel and major sporting events, hospitals are reinforcing preparedness for high-consequence pathogens. At HCA Florida Brandon Hospital in Tampa, staff have Ebola training, stocked PPE, and updated protocols. Ebola transmits by direct contact with blood or bodily fluids of an infected or deceased person and is not airborne. Early identification, isolation, and proper infection-control remain essential, including correct PPE removal.

article.articleHeadline: 嘉市首境外移入登革熱個案 曾赴越旅遊
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chiayi City's first imported dengue fever case, who had traveled to Vietnam.
article.articleSummary: Chiayi City, Taiwan, reported its first imported dengue fever case of the year. The patient, a male resident who had traveled to Vietnam, developed fever, headache and retro-orbital pain on July 15 and was confirmed by dengue virus nucleic acid testing the next day. The Chiayi City Health Bureau implemented emergency vector control around the residence, intensified mosquito surveillance, and eliminated breeding sites; by the morning of July 20, indoor and outdoor chemical control within a 100-meter radius was completed, with travel companions monitored and found healthy. Authorities warn that hot, humid conditions favor vector mosquitoes and urge residents to drain standing water, wear long-sleeve light-colored clothing, and use government-approved repellent. Returnees with fever or dengue-like symptoms should visit one of 41 dengue rapid-test clinics and report travel history.

triage.triage_reason: 台湾における単一の輸入デング熱症例であり、迅速な媒介制御が実施され渡航同伴者も健康であることから、公衆衛生上の重大な懸念や国際的拡大リスクは低い。
triage.notes: 台湾は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。患者の渡航歴があるベトナムは感染源として言及されているが、実際の発症・流行地は台湾であり、ベトナム国内での発生事例ではないため、verified_locationsとしての妥当性は限定的。ただし記事の文脈上、ベトナムへの渡航が感染源として明示されているため参考情報として記載。

article.articleHeadline: CCZ registra novo caso de raiva em morcego na Vila Nasser
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: CCZ records a new case of rabies in a bat in Vila Nasser.
article.articleSummary: Rabies detected in a bat in Vila Nasser, Campo Grande, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil. So far, 11 of the bats collected this year tested positive for the rabies virus, underscoring ongoing surveillance despite not constituting an alarm. The public is advised to avoid handling bats—live or dead—separate the area by covering the animal, and contact CCZ for safe collection and laboratory testing. Vaccinate dogs and cats annually as a protective measure. Contact numbers: general (67) 3313-5000; business hours (67) 2020-1789/1801; after-hours/weekends (67) 2020-1794. Address: Av. Filinto Müller, 1601, Vila Ipiranga, Campo Grande, MS.

article.articleHeadline: Mais uma semana com ações de prevenção às arboviroses - Prefeitura da Cidade do Rio de Janeiro
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Another Week of Arboviral Disease Prevention Actions - Rio de Janeiro City Hall
article.articleSummary: Rio de Janeiro health authorities launch this week’s SVS na Rua action to combat arboviruses dengue, Zika, and chikungunya across 19 neighborhoods from July 21–24, 2026, focusing on eliminating mosquito breeding sites and raising environmental awareness. Health Surveillance teams will operate in Caju, Cidade Nova, Andaraí, Manguinhos, Brás de Pina, Curicica, Praça Seca, Vila Kennedy, Ipanema, Maré, Jacaré, Anchieta, Guadalupe, Campo Grande, Guaratiba, Inhoaíba, Santa Cruz, Paciência, and Ilha de Guaratiba. By July 11, 2026, 6,355,015 property inspections were conducted for Aedes aegypti prevention, with 886,531 deposits treated/eliminated; in 2025, 12,297,072 property visits and 1,684,674 containers treated/eliminated. Educational and mobilization efforts are priorities; residents can request inspections or report hotspots via Central 1746.

triage.headline_ja: アルボウイルス感染症予防対策の継続週間 - リオデジャネイロ市役所
triage.triage_reason: 通常のデング熱・ジカ熱・チクングニア熱に対する定期的な蚊対策・予防活動の報告であり、異常な発生や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は定期的な蚊対策キャンペーンの活動報告であり、患者数や異常発生率などの具体的な流行状況データは含まれていない。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations は空とする。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola quarantine center for Americans is up and working in Kenya despite a court ban, activists say
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-07-20, Kenyan activists say authorities are violating a court order from last month that halted the establishment of an American-backed Ebola quarantine center after reports surfaced that Americans are being quarantined in Kenya. The center was intended to receive and quarantine Americans evacuated from the Democratic Republic of Congo, where an Ebola outbreak that began about two months ago has killed at least 930 people out of 2,344 confirmed cases. Activists allege the facility is already operational despite the ban. The Congo outbreak is identified as the infection source for evacuees, highlighting the cross-border public health stakes as authorities manage quarantine arrangements tied to imported cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行によりケニアでアメリカ人向け隔離施設が裁判所の禁止命令に反して運用されていると活動家が指摘
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で発生中のエボラ出血熱は約930人の死者・2,344人の確定例を伴う大規模流行であり、国際的な避難・隔離対応を引き起こしているためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はコンゴ民主共和国で発生しているエボラ流行であり、ケニアとアメリカは避難者の隔離対応地であるため対象国リストに含まれず除外。CFRは約40%と非常に高く、致死率・拡大リスクの観点から緊急性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Циркулирующий в Африке штамм Эболы генетически отличается от вирусов прошлых эпидемий
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola strain circulating in Africa is genetically different from the viruses of past epidemics.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in Africa is caused by the Bundibugyo variant recently analyzed by scientists from the Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda, and other countries. The circulating strain differs significantly from previous outbreaks in 2007 and 2012, with about 1.1% genome divergence. The Ugandan sequence carried 219 single-nucleotide variations, signaling a new evolutionary branch rather than a wholly new virus. Mutations appear in glycoprotein, polymerase, and other proteins involved in replication and immune suppression; these changes could affect cell entry, replication, or immune evasion, but a single genome sequence cannot confirm higher transmissibility or virulence without further cellular, animal, and clinical data. In the current Congo outbreak, 2,344 people have been infected and 930 have died, yielding a case fatality of about 39.7%. There is no specific therapy for Bundibyo Ebola yet, while vaccine efforts are discussed in related reports.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカで流行中のエボラ株は過去の流行株と遺伝的に異なる
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国での大規模なエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行（感染2,344人、死亡930人、致死率約39.7%）に加え、過去株との遺伝的相違が確認され、伝播性・免疫回避能への影響が懸念されるため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 記事中の『ウガンダの配列』は2007年ブンディブギョ株の参照配列として言及されている可能性があり、現在の流行はコンゴ民主共和国での報告のみが明示されているため、ウガンダは verified_locations に含めなかった。有効な治療薬が未確立であり、致死率も高く、遺伝的変異が伝播性・病原性に与える影響については更なる研究が必要とされている。

article.articleHeadline: Commentary: This Ebola outbreak should never have caught the world off guard
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), centered in Ituri province, has reached 2,124 confirmed cases and 828 deaths as of July 15, with the epidemic spreading to four DRC provinces and across the border into Uganda. European and American aid workers are among the infected. Patients are fighting for their lives with fluids and supportive care, as there are no approved treatments or vaccines for Bundibugyo virus. The outbreak has become the world’s fastest-growing Ebola event, surpassing 1,000 confirmed cases within 40 days of response activation, far faster than the 2018 North Kivu outbreak (235 days). Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) responders warn that the lack of therapeutic options reflects a broader, long-standing failure rather than an isolated incident.

triage.headline_ja: コメンタリー：このエボラ出血熱の流行は世界を不意打ちするはずがなかった
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で発生したブンディブギョ型エボラ出血熱が2,124例・828死亡に達し、史上最速の拡大速度でウガンダにも越境しており、治療薬・ワクチンが存在しないため国際的な公衆衛生上の重大な懸念となっている。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。承認された治療薬・ワクチンが存在しない点、MSFが構造的な対応不足を指摘している点も重大な懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda Discharges Final Ebola Patient
article.articleSummary: Uganda discharges its last Ebola patient on 21 July 2026, starting a 42-day monitoring period under World Health Organization guidelines to determine Ebola-free status. Since mid-May, Uganda has recorded 20 Bundibugyo strain Ebola cases, with most infections linked to travelers from the Democratic Republic of Congo. No new case has been reported since 22 June, indicating containment success. If no additional infections occur during the 42-day window, Uganda will be officially declared Ebola-free. Meanwhile, Congo continues to contend with the outbreak, reporting more than 2,000 confirmed cases and dozens of new infections daily. Ugandan health officials credit rigorous surveillance, isolation measures, and cross-border cooperation for preventing wider transmission and limiting cross-border spread of cases.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、最後のエボラ患者を退院させる
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダでは制御に成功したものの、隣国コンゴ民主共和国では2000件超の確定例と連日数十件の新規感染が続いており、国際的拡大とヒトーヒト感染のリスクが高いためフルRRAへの移行が適切。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。記事の主眼はウガンダの終息だが、依然拡大中のDRCの状況がリスクの核心であるため、DRCを対象国として記録。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果伊波拉疫情持續蔓延　確診病例累計達2423例 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to spread; cumulative confirmed cases reach 2,423.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to spread. As of July 21, 2026, cumulative laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases reach 2,423 with 967 deaths. Official data from the Public Health Institute show ongoing transmission in the eastern provinces of Ituri and North Kivu. On Sunday, these two provinces together reported 79 new confirmed Ebola cases, indicating persistent local spread. The figures underscore the outbreak’s sustained severity in the eastern region, as reported by Reuters based on Congolese authorities.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の流行が継続、確認例が累計2,423例に到達
triage.triage_reason: 大規模なエボラ出血熱の流行が継続しており、致死率も高く（967人死亡/2423例）、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクがあるためIHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: イトゥリ州および北キブ州で継続的な感染拡大が報告されており、致死率(約40%)が高い点も懸念される。既存の大規模流行の継続報道であり、フルRRAでの経過確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Dermatologista alerta para alta incidência de hanseníase no Acre e orienta sobre prevenção
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dermatologist warns of a high incidence of leprosy in Acre and provides guidance on prevention.
article.articleSummary: High incidence of Hansen's disease (leprosy) persists in Acre, Brazil, according to dermatologist Dr. Camila Costa in a Médico 24 Horas interview. The Fundação Hospitalar maintains a dedicated leprosy unit, and there is no waiting for suspected cases; if diagnosed, treatment via the SUS begins immediately. Leprosy typically starts with small skin patches and altered sensation, followed by nerve pain; diagnosis is often delayed as symptoms resemble other conditions, with patients initially seeing general clinicians or rheumatologists before dermatologists. The interview reinforces leprosy as a current public health problem in Acre. The Amazon region also reports Jorge Lobo disease (lobomycosis), a fungal infection affecting rural and riverine residents; late care can lead to extensive lesions requiring surgery. Caution against self-medication and emphasis on evidence-based dermatologic care were also highlighted.

triage.headline_ja: 皮膚科医がアクレ州でのハンセン病高発生率について警告、予防を指導
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・アクレ州における既知の風土病（ハンセン病）に関する啓発的な医療インタビュー記事であり、新規性や国際的拡大リスクは見られない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・アクレ州（Pará州ではない）が舞台。ハンセン病は既知の流行病であり、地域の医療体制も確立されている。対象国リストにブラジルはあるが、記事の主題はアクレ州という特定州の慢性的な公衆衛生課題であり、新規シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: République démocratique du Congo : Cluster Sécurité alimentaire - Crise Ebola - sitrep #8 (Du 06 au 19 Juil 2026)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo: Food Security Cluster - Ebola Outbreak - Situation Report #8 (From 6 to 19 July 2026).
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to expand into areas already facing high levels of food insecurity, according to Situation Report #8 covering 6–19 July 2026. Food assistance remains insufficient for confirmed cases, their families, and contacts, hindering the response amid ongoing transmission. Despite partner efforts, 2.62 million people, representing 98% of those directly affected by Ebola, remain to be covered across 34 health zones. The report highlights the dual burden of epidemic spread and acute hunger in the affected regions, emphasizing the critical need to expand relief coverage to communities enduring the outbreak during this period.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：食料安全保障クラスター - エボラ危機 - 状況報告書#8（2026年7月6日～19日）
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC内で継続拡大しており、34の保健区にわたり260万人以上が影響を受け、食料支援も不足している。既知の進行中アウトブレイクであり公衆衛生・人道への深刻な影響が確認される。
triage.notes: 既知の進行中エボラアウトブレイクに関する人道支援状況報告。感染拡大に加え食料不安との複合危機が強調されている。継続的なモニタリングが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Campo Grande registra 11º caso de raiva em morcego neste ano
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Campo Grande records 11th rabies case in a bat this year.
article.articleSummary: Campo Grande, Brazil, reports its 11th bat diagnosed with rabies in 2026, equaling 2025’s total. The animal was found in Vila Nasser and confirmed by laboratory analysis. Other infected bats were collected in Vivendas do Bosque, Centro, Santa Fé, Jardim Campo Alto, Pioneiros, São Francisco, Jardim Bela Vista and Jardim Ouro Preto. Officials say the numbers do not indicate an alarm but reinforce surveillance and preventive measures, notably annual vaccination of dogs and cats. Bats are frugivorous/insectivorous and usually pose no risk in the wild, but can carry rabies and transmit to other mammals, including humans. The last human rabies case in Campo Grande was 1968; Corumbá had one in 2015. If you encounter a bat, do not touch it, isolate it, and contact CCZ. For exposures, seek a 24-hour health unit for post-exposure prophylaxis. CCZ contacts: General 3313-5000; Weekdays 2020-1789/1801; After hours 2020-1794; Av. Filinto Müller 1601, Vila Ipiranga.

triage.headline_ja: カンポグランデ、今年11例目のコウモリの狂犬病感染例を記録
triage.triage_reason: コウモリでの狂犬病確認は例年発生している動物由来事例で、当局も「警戒レベルではない」と説明。人への感染例は直近になく、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 対象国リストにブラジルは含まれないため verified_locations は空配列。人への感染は1968年以来なく、動物間の定期的なサーベイランス事例と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Wabah Ebola di Kongo Tewaskan 930 Orang, Nakes Turut Jadi Korban
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Congo kills 930 people, healthcare workers among the victims.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Congo's Kongo region, declared May 15, 2026, has killed 930 people and infected 2,344 confirmed cases as of July 20, 2026. A surge includes 37 deaths reported July 17–18. Thirty-six health workers involved in care have died. The outbreak is described as the fastest-spreading Ebola event in history, caused by the Bundibugyo virus strain, for which there is no vaccine or treatment. Transmission occurs via body fluids (blood, vomit, semen) and can contaminate surfaces. The most severely affected areas are in a conflict-affected province, hindering response and prompting healthcare strikes over non-payment. The Health Ministry reports 724 patients currently isolated in hospitals, and 22 recoveries in the last 24 hours. On average, 272 new cases and 111 deaths occur weekly; transmission is increasing.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ出血熱流行、930人死亡、医療従事者も被害に
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で複数該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）に加え、WPRO基準も全て該当する重大なエボラ流行であり、フルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: 史上最速の拡大とされるエボラ流行（ブンディブギョ株、ワクチン・治療法なし）。紛争地域での対応困難、医療従事者のストライキ、週平均272例・111人死亡が継続増加中。国際的な支援と厳格な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: DBD Tak Lagi Penyakit Musiman, Ahli Minta Pencegahan Dengue Sepanjang Tahun
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue Fever No Longer a Seasonal Disease, Experts Urge Year-Round Dengue Prevention
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever is now recognized as a year-round threat in Indonesia, not merely a rainy-season illness, according to the Jakarta Dengue Forum and a Takeda press release. Risk of transmission by Aedes aegypti can occur throughout the year, prompting experts to call for continuous, sustained prevention efforts across the country, including Jakarta. Prof. Dr. dr. Sri Rezeki Hadinegoro, Sp.A(K), warns that dengue remains a serious public health challenge and says management must go beyond a narrow set of measures. A comprehensive approach is needed: vector control, strengthened early diagnosis at health facilities, and the use of available medical interventions to prevent cases, hospitalizations, and deaths. The discussion emphasizes moving beyond conventional 3M Plus strategies toward an integrated prevention framework for dengue in Indonesia.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱はもはや季節性疾患ではない、専門家が年間を通じた予防を要請
triage.triage_reason: デング熱はインドネシアで既知の流行病であり、本記事は専門家による年間予防の呼びかけという啓発的内容で、新規異常事態や急性の公衆衛生危機を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 具体的な症例数・死亡者数・地域的アウトブレイクの記述はなく、専門家の一般的な予防提言に関する記事。

article.articleHeadline: Overcrowding at displacement sites increases Ebola risk in DR Congo: UN
article.articleSummary: Overcrowding and limited services in displacement sites across eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri Province) elevate Ebola transmission risk. At least 16 displacement sites housing more than 270,000 people are affected, with Ituri as the outbreak epicenter. As of the latest update, 2,344 confirmed Ebola cases have been reported across five provinces, with Ituri accounting for nearly 90% of cases. UN OCHA and partners are expanding prevention efforts, including installing handwashing stations and conducting community outreach on Ebola prevention. The report highlights the ongoing need for international support to sustain the response and deliver life-saving assistance to displaced communities facing years of conflict and deteriorating living conditions.

triage.headline_ja: 国連:コンゴ民主共和国における避難民キャンプの過密化がエボラ出血熱のリスクを増大
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で2,344例の確定エボラ患者が報告され、避難民キャンプの過密化により感染拡大リスクが高まっている大規模アウトブレイクであり、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: 既存のエボラアウトブレイク（Ituri州中心、5州にまたがる）の継続報道。避難民キャンプの過密化と長期の紛争状況が感染拡大リスクを増大させている点が中心的な懸念事項。

article.articleHeadline: "إيبولا" يتسبب بوفاة 930 شخصاً في الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola kills 930 people in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo has killed at least 930 people as of 21 July 2026, since the outbreak was declared in eastern Congo on 15 May. Ituri Province, the hardest-hit area, has endured at least 12 attacks on health facilities and response teams since the outbreak began, hindering containment. A large number of health workers have gone on strike over unpaid wages, further hampering response efforts. The report states that at least 36 health-care workers have died from Ebola during the outbreak. Security challenges and labor disputes are highlighted as major obstacles to controlling transmission in the affected region.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、コンゴで930人死亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイクで死者930人、医療従事者36人死亡、治安悪化やストライキで対応が困難な状況であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 医療施設への攻撃12件以上、医療従事者のストライキ、36人の医療従事者死亡など、対応能力に深刻な支障が生じている。国際的な支援・介入の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Shillong launches rabies-free pilot
article.articleSummary: Meghalaya launches a One Health pilot in Shillong's Laitumkhrah to eliminate dog-mediated human rabies. The programme, "Implementation of Comprehensive One Health Approach to Eliminate Dog-Mediated Human Rabies in Laitumkhrah Area," starts vaccination and awareness from July 22, with mass dog vaccination, community rabies prevention education, enhanced human–animal surveillance, and responsible pet ownership. Led by NHM Meghalaya, it collaborates with the Health & Family Welfare Department, the Department of Animal Husbandry & Veterinary, and CRE India Foundation. Aims include at least 70% vaccination coverage among local dogs and use of a mobile app to monitor vaccinated animals, featuring colour-coded mapping and illuminated QR-coded collars. Officials like Dr Paul N Chyne and Dr Harish Tiwari emphasize cross-sector coordination and the goal of a rabies-free Meghalaya; Dr Valerie Laloo says the pilot will inform statewide expansion. Laitumkhrah has 13 neighbourhoods, and community leaders pledged support toward the statewide objective by 2030.

triage.headline_ja: シロン、狂犬病撲滅パイロット事業を開始
triage.triage_reason: 新規の感染症発生・アウトブレイクではなく、既存の狂犬病対策プログラム（ワクチン接種・啓発活動）の開始を報じる予防的取り組みの記事であり、緊急性や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は狂犬病の新規発生やアウトブレイクを報じるものではなく、メガラヤ州シロンでの犬媒介性ヒト狂犬病撲滅を目指すOne Healthパイロット事業の立ち上げに関する予防的・行政的な内容。

article.articleHeadline: Rand Paul releases docs that reveal FBI halted border inspection of virus researcher over Wuhan lab links
article.articleSummary: CBP planned to question Peter Daszak, EcoHealth Alliance chief, on his Feb. 5, 2021 return from the WHO SARS‑CoV‑2 origins investigation at JFK, labeling him a 'high person of interest' due to 15+ years of collaboration with the Wuhan Institute of Virology (WIV), ties to its lead researcher Zhengli Shi, and NIH funding for bat coronavirus research. NIH reportedly asked Daszak to retrieve the original WIV type specimen for genetic analysis and return it to the United States, and to explain aspects of his collaboration, including related cell phone data. CBP considered operations in China and contact checks at WIV to assess potential illegal samples. Three days before arrival, the FBI New York Field Office requested halting the stop, so the inspection never occurred. The records reflect interagency disagreement over the investigation into COVID-19 origins and concerns about conflicts of interest.

triage.headline_ja: ランド・ポール議員、FBIがウイルス研究者の武漢研究所との関係を理由に国境検査を停止させたことを示す文書を公開
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は2021年のCOVID-19起源調査に関する政治的・行政的な文書公開についての報道であり、現在進行中の感染症発生や公衆衛生上の新規事象を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はCOVID-19の起源調査に関する過去の政治的対立・文書公開についての報道であり、現在発生している感染症イベントを報告するものではないため、対象国は該当なしとした。

article.articleHeadline: São Bernardo registra primeira morte por febre maculosa no Grande ABC em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Bernardo records first death from spotted fever in Greater ABC in 2026.
article.articleSummary: First death from Brazilian spotted fever in Greater ABC in 2026 occurred in São Bernardo. In São Paulo State, 18 confirmed cases this year, with 17 resulting in death; one case recovered. Probable infection sites: Piracicaba (3), Campinas (3), Sorocaba (3), and São José dos Campos (1); others under investigation. Spotted fever is an acute febrile illness caused by Rickettsia and transmitted by ticks such as the star tick and horse tick; transmission is not person-to-person. Early diagnosis is challenging because initial symptoms resemble dengue, influenza, and leptospirosis; from days 2–5, a rash appears on the palms and soles and spreads inward. Exposure history is crucial. Doxycycline, about seven days, is the treatment of choice for suspected cases and may be stopped after 48–72 hours afebrile with medical assessment. Public health measures include mandatory notification, case investigation, epidemiological monitoring, laboratory strengthening, professional training, and cross-sector surveillance to identify risk areas.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州グレーテルABC地域、サンベルナルドで2026年初のブラジル紅斑熱による死亡例
triage.triage_reason: サンパウロ州でダニ媒介性のブラジル紅斑熱（リケッチア症）の致死率が非常に高い（18例中17死亡）ものの、ヒト-ヒト感染はなく地域的な公衆衛生対応が既に進行中であるため、国際的拡大リスクは低いと判断される。
triage.notes: 本疾患（ブラジル紅斑熱／febre maculosa）はダニ媒介性リケッチア症であり、インフルエンザ・デング熱・レプトスピラ症は鑑別診断として挙げられているのみで実際の発生病原体ではない。致死率が極めて高いが、地域限定的でヒト-ヒト感染はなく、既に通知義務・監視体制が敷かれている。

article.articleHeadline: Kolaborasi Polri dan Tenaga Kesehatan Perkuat Deteksi Dini TBC di Banyumas Lewat Pemeriksaan Massal
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Collaboration between the Indonesian National Police and health workers strengthens early detection of TB in Banyumas through mass screening.
article.articleSummary: On 17 July 2026, Banyumas Regency, Indonesia, intensified early detection of tuberculosis (TB) through integrated tracing under the Free Health Check (CKG) program. The mass screening spans multiple kecamatans, including Sumpiuh, Kemranjen, Purwojati, Lumbir, Kembaran, Sumbang, Wangon, Purwokerto Utara, Karanglewas, and Rawalo. Police–community collaboration involves Bhabinkamtibmas, puskesmas clinics, village administrations, TB Paru cadres, and health staff to reach at-risk residents. Activities include patient accompaniment, close-contact tracing, health examinations, sputum sample collection, family investigations, and follow-up laboratory tests and chest radiographs for symptomatic individuals. In Kemranjen, 100 residents are targeted for screening; in Karanglewas, TB Paru tracers from RSUD Ajibarang screen 100 residents via physical exams, sputum tests, and chest X-rays. Police say their involvement boosts community participation and urges anyone with TB symptoms or contacts to seek screening promptly.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシア国家警察と医療従事者の連携、バニュマスでの集団検査によるTB早期発見を強化
triage.triage_reason: 既知の疾患（結核）に対する通常の公衆衛生活動（集団検診・早期発見プログラム）であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 結核は既知の流行病であり、本記事はインドネシア国内の定例的な早期発見・スクリーニング活動を報じるもので、新規の異常事態やアウトブレイクを示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: People with type 2 diabetes face higher risk of dengue, warns review; experts weigh in
article.articleSummary: Type 2 diabetes patients face higher risk of severe dengue, according to a review slated for publication in the International Journal of Diabetes & Technology. In India, where over 100 million people have diabetes, persistently high glucose impairs immune function and damages blood vessels, increasing risk of dengue hemorrhagic fever and dengue shock syndrome via exaggerated inflammatory responses (cytokine storms). Observational studies and meta-analyses cited suggest diabetics with dengue have greater risk of severe disease and possibly death, though confounding factors like age, obesity, kidney disease, and glycaemic control may contribute. The authors urge integrating dengue vaccination into routine diabetes care in dengue-endemic regions. Prevention emphasizes mosquito bite avoidance and maintaining diabetes control; if dengue occurs, some diabetes medications may require temporary adjustments, with close monitoring of platelet counts, glucose, hydration, and symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: 2型糖尿病患者はデング熱の重症化リスクが高い、レビューが指摘し専門家が見解を示す
triage.triage_reason: 新規の発生や異常な流行を報じるものではなく、糖尿病とデング重症化リスクに関する医学レビューの解説記事であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や社会的関心の高まりを示す要素がない。
triage.notes: 本記事は既存疾患（デング熱）と基礎疾患（糖尿病）の関連性に関する研究レビューの紹介であり、特定のアウトブレイクや発生事例を報告するものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Hacinamiento en campamentos de desplazados aumenta riesgo de ébola en RD del Congo, informa ONU
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Overcrowding in internally displaced persons camps increases Ebola risk in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the UN says.
article.articleSummary: Overcrowding and limited access to basic services in internally displaced persons camps in Ituri province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, are heightening Ebola transmission risk amid an ongoing outbreak. The UN's Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA) confirmed Ebola cases across at least 16 displacement sites hosting more than 270,000 people. As of Saturday, health authorities reported 2,344 confirmed Ebola cases across five provinces, with Ituri accounting for about 90% of cases. UN agencies and partners are deploying prevention measures, including handwashing stations and community awareness campaigns. The UN renewed calls for intensified international support to sustain the response and provide vital aid to displaced communities facing years of conflict and deteriorating living conditions.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国の国内避難民キャンプの過密化がエボラ熱リスクを増大させていると国連が報告
triage.triage_reason: 既にコンゴ民主共和国で2,344人の確定エボラ患者が5州に及んでおり、避難民キャンプの過密化により感染拡大リスクが高まっているとUNが報告。IHR基準複数該当かつ国際支援要請もあり、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: Ituriはコンゴ民主共和国内の州であり、独立した対象国ではないためDRCとして集約。既存のエボラアウトブレイクの継続的悪化を示す続報。

article.articleHeadline: Rio Grande do Sul registra caso de gripe aviária em criação de subsistência | CNN Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rio Grande do Sul records a case of avian influenza in subsistence farming | CNN Brasil
article.articleSummary: Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza (HPAI) detected in backyard poultry in Coqueiros do Sul, Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil. Confirmation announced July 20, 2026, by Seapi after analysis by the Federal Laboratory of Agricultural Defense (LFDA-SP) with samples collected on the property; results disclosed July 17, 2026. The flock was backyard and for family consumption, with no link to commercial poultry production. Brazil’s status as free from HPAI in commercial aviculture remains unchanged, and there are no export restrictions on chicken meat or other poultry products. Official Veterinary Service actions include epidemiological investigations, property inspections within a 10-km radius, enhanced regional surveillance, and biosafety guidance to producers. This follows a May 2025 HPAI focus in a Montenegro farm (Rio Grande do Sul); after 28 days with no new commercial cases and adherence to eradication measures, Brazil restored its sanitary status and normal poultry exports.

article.articleHeadline: Ébola en RD del Congo deja 930 muertos en el brote más rápido registrado
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC leaves 930 dead in the fastest-recorded outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo is driven by Bundibugyo virus, the fastest-growing outbreak to date, declared on May 15. By July 20, 2026, the country reports 2,344 lab-confirmed cases and 930 deaths across five eastern provinces, with Ituri hardest hit. The situation features rapid weekly increases (roughly 272 new cases and 111 deaths per week) and 80% of new infections arising from unknown transmission chains, suggesting widespread transmission. There is no approved vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo Ebola. Health workers are disproportionately affected: at least 36 deaths among healthcare workers; 724 patients are in isolation or hospital care; 22 recoveries in the last 24 hours. Security concerns hinder response in Ituri and other provinces, including 12 attacks on health facilities since May amid staff protests over pay. Transmission occurs via contact with bodily fluids and contaminated surfaces; animal reservoirs can seed infections.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ、史上最速の流行で死者930人に
triage.triage_reason: IHR4基準のうち複数該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な拡大速度、国際拡大リスク）し、社会的関心・国際支援の必要性も高いためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Response Turns to Existing Vaccines to Protect Medics (1)
article.articleSummary: as of 20 July 2026, frontline health workers in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo may be offered an experimental vaccine against the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola. Researchers are launching a study to see whether Merck's Ervebo vaccine, which targets the Zaire strain, followed by an experimental vaccine against Sudan Ebola, can elicit an immune response that provides at least partial protection against Bundibugyo, while a strain-specific vaccine remains months away. The Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention, in collaboration with local health authorities, is coordinating the effort. The strategy aims to bolster protection for medics amid the ongoing Ebola response by leveraging existing vaccines to broaden protection against diverse Ebola strains. No trial results or case counts are reported in the excerpt.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ対応、医療従事者保護のため既存ワクチンの活用へ (1)
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部でブンディブギョ株によるエボラ対応が進行中であり、致死率の高い疾患で医療従事者への感染防御が課題となっているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン戦略に関する内容で、症例数や現地の流行規模の詳細は記載されていない。ブンディブギョ株は過去の発生頻度が低く、進行中のエボラ対応の一部として注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: DR Kongo: Zahl der Ebola-Infizierten steigt weiter
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: Number of Ebola infections continues to rise.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak in Ituri province, including Bunia, is escalating, with over 2,300 infections and 930 deaths; daily cases exceed 40. Reported in May, the outbreak is hard to contain amid security instability and mistrust. Hospital strikes in Ituri disrupt response. Ebola remains highly infectious after death, requiring strict burial hygiene, yet many funerals occur without measures, and corpses are moved across regions, risking further spread. Late detection allowed weeks of undetected transmission; many infections and contacts remain unknown. Contact tracing is challenging: 60–90% of contacts are identified, but regional gaps persist, especially in conflict zones. Bundibugyo Ebola virus has no licensed vaccine or specific therapy. WHO warns true case numbers may be 2–4 times higher than reported. Lab capacity has improved with more PCR devices and mobile labs; rapid tests remain unavailable. WHO began a study of Remdesivir, MBP134, and their combination; Obeldesivir for contacts is planned.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴ:エボラ感染者数が増加を続ける
triage.triage_reason: DRコンゴ・イチュリ州で2,300人超の感染・930人の死亡という大規模なエボラ流行が継続し、治安不安・医療スト・不十分な埋葬対応により国際的拡大リスクが高く、IHR基準複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスク）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスにはライセンス済みワクチン・特異的治療法がなく、WHOは実際の感染者数が報告の2〜4倍に達する可能性を指摘。治安不安・医療スト・埋葬時の感染対策不徹底・遺体の地域間移動が拡大リスクを増大させている。

article.articleHeadline: 5 khu vực công cộng trẻ dễ lây bệnh truyền nhiễm
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Five public places where children are at risk of contracting infectious diseases.
article.articleSummary: Five public places where children are at risk of infectious diseases: ball pits, shared soft fabric toys, public swimming pools, public toilets, and cinema, gym, and dressing areas. Ball pits are crowded, enclosed spaces; a 2019 Georgia study found 31 bacterial species on balls, with infrequent cleaning increasing transmission, potentially spreading hand-foot-mouth disease, influenza, adenovirus, RSV, varicella, rotavirus, norovirus, and skin infections. Shared plush toys (teddy bears, pillows) can harbor dirt and secretions; they require thorough washing and drying; risks include respiratory infections, conjunctivitis, hand-foot-mouth, and fungal skin infections. Public pools with communal facilities can transmit pathogens via water or surfaces; Vietnam’s National Pediatric Hospital reported adenovirus infections linked to a public pool in late July. Public toilets can spread Rotavirus, Norovirus, Hepatitis A, and hand-foot-mouth; cinema, gym, and dressing areas enable transmission if not disinfected regularly. Emphasize ventilation, cleaning, hand hygiene, vaccination, avoiding sick children, and vaccination before school.

UN OCHA calls for intensified international support to combat the outbreak, noting there is no vaccine or approved treatment for the Bundibugyo strain driving this transmission. The situation indicates ongoing transmission in eastern DRC, prompting public health and humanitarian responses amid a protracted outbreak.

article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached 967 deaths and 2,423 confirmed cases as of July 21, 2026, with 79 new infections recorded in Ituri and North Kivu. The UN warns of a heightened risk of spread in eastern refugee camps, noting confirmed cases across 16 camps in Ituri, where more than 270,000 people are displaced. article.articleHeadline: เตือนระวัง! ชายไทยวัย 37 ติดฝีดาษวานร MPOX Clade 1b "หมอมนูญ" เผยอาการเริ่มต้นและวิธีรักษา
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Warning! A 37-year-old Thai man infected with mpox (Mpox) Clade 1b; Dr. Manoon reveals the initial symptoms and treatment.
article.articleSummary: On 21 July 2026, a 37-year-old Thai man with HIV on long-term antiretroviral therapy and a history of syphilis presented to Vichaiyut Hospital in Bangkok with fever, rigors, myalgia and fatigue for three days, followed by widespread small pustules on the face, trunk, limbs, genitals, and perianal area; eyes and mouth mucosa were spared. He reported sex with a foreign male partner about one month earlier. Bilateral inguinal lymphadenopathy was noted; no fever at examination. PCR of vesicular fluid and the upper lesion skin confirmed Monkeypox (Mpox) Clade 1b. Diagnosis: Mpox Clade 1b with HIV infection. Treatment: Tecovirimat given twice daily for 14 days; the patient tolerated therapy and lesions decreased. He was advised home isolation for three weeks until crusts healed and new skin covered the previous lesions to prevent transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 警告！37歳のタイ人男性がMPOXクレードIbに感染 ～マノーン医師が初期症状と治療法を解説

article.articleHeadline: H5N1-Virus erstmals in Neuseeland nachgewiesen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: H5N1 virus detected in New Zealand for the first time
article.articleSummary: New Zealand reports its first high-pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) H5N1 detection in a wild brown skua near Wellington; the virus belongs to clade 2.3.4.4b. No poultry infections detected; public health risk is low and poultry products are safe. A Poultry Council was established in September to coordinate MPI and industry biosafety measures. Nepal reports 91 infected poultry outbreaks, with over 733,000 birds affected; 40 new outbreaks occurred in Bagmati, including eight exotic birds dying at a Lalitpur zoo. Vietnam records 50 outbreaks in Jan–Jun 2026, with about 240,000 birds culled or dead (7.7× 2025). The Philippines has 27 active H5N1 outbreaks in Ilocos and Central Luzon. Australia reports two more wild-bird HPAI H5N1 outbreaks, seven total in six locations, with no poultry cases yet. Korea’s H5N1 wave involves numerous farms and millions of birds; Japan ends a major HPAI wave after 24 outbreaks (Oct 2025–May 2026).

triage.headline_ja: H5N1ウイルス、ニュージーランドで初めて検出

article.articleHeadline: 长期不规则发热、肝脾肿大易误诊！暑期出行务必警惕黑热病
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chronic irregular fever and hepatosplenomegaly are easily misdiagnosed! Be vigilant for visceral leishmaniasis (kala-azar) during summer travel.
article.articleSummary: Visceral leishmaniasis (kala-azar) is a chronic parasitic disease caused by Leishmania, primarily affecting the liver and spleen. In China, transmission persists in limited areas of Beijing, Hebei, Shanxi, Shaanxi, Henan, Gansu, Xinjiang and Sichuan, with summer as the peak season due to sandfly activity. Sandflies (Phlebotomus) bite mainly at dusk to dawn, after feeding on infected dogs, enabling transmission in a dog-sandfly-human cycle involving wildlife. Incubation is 3–6 months; key symptoms include prolonged irregular fever, hepatosplenomegaly, and anemia, often non-specific and prone to misdiagnosis. Diagnosis combines travel history with laboratory tests such as bone marrow aspirate, rk39 rapid test, or PCR. Imported travel-associated cases may occur; early treatment saves lives. First-line therapy is sodium stibogluconate; amphotericin B is an option for resistant or special patients. Prevention emphasizes long-lasting nets, protective clothing, DEET, and testing pet dogs within 6 months of returning from endemic areas.

triage.headline_ja: 長期不規則発熱・肝脾腫は誤診しやすい！夏の旅行では黒熱病（内臓リーシュマニア症）に要警戒
triage.triage_reason: 中国の一部地域で流行が続く既知の風土病に関する啓発記事であり、異常な増加や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は既知の風土病（黒熱病）に関する予防啓発情報であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常発生を示すものではない。ベクター（サシチョウバエ）媒介の慢性感染症で夏季に流行することは既知の疫学パターン。

article.articleHeadline: New COVID variant detected in India: Omicron RF.5 Sub-Variant is spreading rapidly - Can existing vaccines still protect you?
article.articleSummary: Omicron RF.5, a sub-lineage of SARS-CoV-2’s Omicron variant, has been detected in Andhra Pradesh and is spreading rapidly across India. RF.5 is not a new variant; it previously appeared in Singapore and parts of Southeast Asia. WHO is monitoring the situation, with no evidence yet that RF.5 causes more severe illness or higher hospitalizations than other circulating Omicron variants. Health Minister Satya Kumar Yadav urged calm and noted the lack of increased severity. Vaccines remain highly effective at reducing severe illness, hospitalization, and death, though protection against infection may be reduced for RF.5. Common COVID-19 symptoms apply; gastrointestinal symptoms like nausea or diarrhea may occur but are less common. Emphasizes genome sequencing to track evolving strains; no concrete case or death counts are provided in the report.

triage.headline_ja: インドで新型COVID変異株を検出：オミクロンRF.5亜系統が急速に拡大 - 既存のワクチンは有効か？
triage.triage_reason: オミクロンRF.5がインド国内で急速に拡大しており、保健当局・メディアの関心が高いため、重症度エビデンスは乏しいものの続報確認のためフルRRAへの移行が適切と判断。
triage.notes: RF.5はシンガポール・東南アジアで既に確認されていた既存系統であり、WHOも重症度上昇の証拠なしとしている。インド保健大臣も冷静な対応を呼びかけているが、感染拡大の速さと報道量から経過観察が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 暑假游玩多注意：被这种昆虫叮了，可能感染寄生虫！
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Be careful during summer vacation: A bite from this insect could cause a parasitic infection.
article.articleSummary: Visceral leishmaniasis, or black fever, is a chronic parasitic disease caused by Leishmania transmitted by Phlebotomine sandflies. In China, transmission persists in Beijing, Hebei, Shanxi, Shaanxi, Henan, Gansu, Xinjiang, and Sichuan, with sporadic cases still reported. Summer (May–September) brings peak sandfly activity, especially June–July, increasing risk for travelers, campers, farmers, and visitors returning from endemic areas. Incubation is typically 3–6 months; patients may present with prolonged fever, hepatosplenomegaly, and anemia and are often misdiagnosed. Diagnosis relies on epidemiologic history and lab tests such as bone marrow aspiration, rk39 rapid test, or PCR. Treatment is effective when started early: sodium stibogluconate (SSG) or amphotericin B for resistant cases, under medical supervision. Preventive measures include insect nets, protective clothing, DEET-based repellents, and pet dog antibody screening after visits to endemic regions.

article.articleHeadline: DRC: bijna duizend doden door ebola-uitbraak
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Nearly a Thousand Deaths from an Ebola Outbreak.
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak: As of 21 July 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo reports 2,423 confirmed Ebola cases and 967 deaths. The latest update cites 79 new cases in the eastern provinces of Ituri and North Kivu. Last week, authorities had counted 754 deaths, with the World Health Organization warning the outbreak could be two to four times larger than known. Containment efforts have shown limited effect so far. There is concern the virus could spread to South Sudan. The article notes laboratory-confirmed cases but provides no further detail on infection sources or imported/exported cases. The data highlight ongoing transmission across eastern DRC and underscore the need for intensified surveillance and regional cooperation.

triage.headline_ja: DRC: エボラ出血熱の流行によりほぼ1000人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱による死者967人・確定例2423人と大規模で、封じ込めが効果を示していない上、南スーダンへの拡大懸念があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 南スーダンへの拡大懸念が記載されているが、南スーダンは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。WHOは実際の規模が報告の2〜4倍に及ぶ可能性を指摘しており、封じ込め策の効果が限定的である点も重大。

article.articleHeadline: बरसात में जरा सी लापरवाही जानलेवा, गाय-भैंसों को बीमारियों से बचाने के उपाय
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: During the monsoon, a little negligence can be life-threatening: measures to protect cows and buffaloes from diseases.
article.articleSummary: As of July 21, 2026, in Khandwa, Madhya Pradesh, India, the monsoon raises disease risk for cows and buffaloes. Mastitis (thunela) spreads rapidly; after milking, keep animals off damp floors and clean the teats. Vaccinate on schedule against Foot-and-Mouth Disease (khurpka-muhpaka) and galghontu (throat infection). Humidity, mud, and filth increase pneumonia, diarrhea, fever, skin infections, and calf illnesses, with newborns most vulnerable; seek veterinary guidance promptly. Dr. Hemant Shah emphasizes dry, clean, ventilated shelters; if an animal gets drenched, move it to a dry area. Calves require colostrum within an hour of birth. Feeding should avoid spoiled fodder; mix green fodder with dry hay to aid digestion. Mosquitoes, flies and parasites proliferate in rain, so prevent water stagnation and maintain hygiene, using medicines as needed.

triage.headline_ja: 雨季における少しの不注意が命取りに:牛・水牛を病気から守るための対策

article.articleHeadline: 荆州已有4例输入病例！紧急提醒
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: There are already 4 imported cases in Jingzhou! Urgent reminder.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-07-21, Jingzhou, China, has reported 4 imported dengue fever cases since May, with infections traced to travelers from Indonesia, Cambodia and Malaysia. Dengue is among the three summer-mosquito transmitted illnesses highlighted in the article, alongside chikungunya and Zika, all spread principally by Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus. Dengue typically presents with abrupt high fever, myalgia, rash and possible bleeding; chikungunya with fever and intense joint pain; Zika often mild but poses pregnancy-related risks. The piece urges preventive measures during hot, humid summer: use repellents, wear protective clothing, sleep under nets with screens, eliminate indoor and outdoor standing water, and prefer air-conditioned accommodations. Post-travel monitoring for 14 days is advised; seek medical care promptly if fever, joint pain, or rash occurs and report travel and exposure history.

triage.headline_ja: 荆州で既に4例の輸入病例！緊急提醒
triage.triage_reason: 中国荆州でデング熱の輸入例4件が報告されているが、地域内での二次感染（土着感染）の報告はなく、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は現時点では限定的。渡航者由来の輸入例のみで、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 輸入例はカンボジア・マレーシアからも報告されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。インドネシアは対象国であり輸入元として明記されているため含めた。夏季の蚊媒介感染症予防に関する一般的な注意喚起記事であり、大規模流行の兆候は記事内に確認できない。
